zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: Wand 应用的增强与互操作扩展工具
zh.what: WandEnhancer 是一个开源工具，用于扩展 Wand 应用的本地配置和用户体验。它通过修改本地安装文件来增强功能，如布局主题定制、AI 功能、远程网页控制面板等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 .NET 补丁程序、version.dll 代理、远程网页面板源码以及相关文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C#/.NET，利用 Electron 的 ASAR 完整性 fuse 字节修改，可选集成 Tailscale 等 VPN 工具。
zh.hot: 因其强大的功能扩展和易用性而迅速走红，今日新增 582 星，总星数达 23k+。
uses: Wand 应用用户希望获得更高级的界面定制和主题选项。
需要远程控制 Wand 功能的用户，通过手机网页面板实现。
对 AI 功能感兴趣的用户，希望集成到游戏修改工具中。

en.tag: Advanced UX and interoperability extension for Wand (WeMod) app
en.what: WandEnhancer is an open-source tool that extends the local configuration and UX of the Wand app. It modifies local installation files to add features like layout/theme customization, AI features, and a remote web panel.
en.content: The repository contains a .NET patcher, a version.dll proxy, the remote web panel source, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily C#/.NET, modifies Electron's ASAR-integrity fuse byte, optionally integrates with Tailscale for remote access.
en.hot: Rapidly gained popularity due to its powerful feature enhancements and ease of use, with 582 stars added today and over 23k total.
uses: Wand app users seeking advanced UI customization and theme options.
Users who need remote control of Wand features via a mobile web panel.
Users interested in AI features integrated into a game modding tool.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 一键部署本地 AI 服务器，集成推理、聊天、语音、RAG 与生图
zh.what: ODS 是一个部署系统，能将普通电脑变成私有 AI 服务器，自动安装并整合 Ollama、Open WebUI、n8n、ComfyUI 等工具。它提供本地模型推理、浏览器聊天界面、控制仪表盘、语音代理工作流、RAG 检索和图像生成，无需云服务或订阅。
zh.content: 仓库根目录包含 README、安装器、安全策略和 GitHub Actions；`ods/` 目录包含产品运行时，包括服务、安装阶段、compose 覆盖、仪表盘、CLI、测试和运维文档。当前稳定版为 v2.6.0，`main` 分支用于开发。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Docker Compose 编排多个开源服务（如 Ollama、Open WebUI、n8n、ComfyUI），并包含自定义 CLI 和仪表盘。
zh.hot: 凭借近 5000 星和日增 35 星登上趋势榜，因为它解决了本地 AI 部署的痛点——无需手动拼装多工具，一键安装并统一管理，同时强调隐私和数据自主。
uses: 希望完全掌控数据、避免云端依赖的个人开发者或隐私爱好者
需要快速搭建本地 AI 实验环境的研究人员或学生
希望在自有硬件上运行 AI 服务的小型团队或企业
对 AI 工具链感兴趣但不想花时间配置的爱好者

en.tag: Turn your PC/Mac/Linux into a private AI server with LLM, chat, voice, agents, RAG, and image gen
en.what: ODS is a deployment system that turns a regular computer into a private AI server, automatically installing and wiring together tools like Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, and ComfyUI. It offers local model inference, a browser-based chat UI, a control dashboard, voice agents and workflows, RAG retrieval, and image generation—no cloud or subscriptions required.
en.content: The repo root holds the README, installers, security policy, and GitHub workflows; the `ods/` directory contains the product runtime: services, installer phases, compose overlays, dashboard, CLI, tests, and operator docs. Stable release is v2.6.0, with `main` for active development.
en.stack: Python-based, orchestrates multiple open-source services (Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, ComfyUI) via Docker Compose, with a custom CLI and dashboard.
en.hot: With nearly 5k stars and +35 today, it's trending because it solves the pain of local AI setup—no manual assembly of tools, one-command install with unified management, and a strong privacy/data-ownership pitch.
uses: Individual developers or privacy enthusiasts who want full data control without cloud dependency
Researchers or students needing a quick local AI experimentation environment
Small teams or enterprises wanting to run AI services on their own hardware
Hobbyists interested in AI toolchains but unwilling to spend time on configuration

zh.tag: Java 代码规范检查工具，支持 Google/Sun 标准
zh.what: Checkstyle 是一款开发工具，帮助程序员编写符合编码标准的 Java 代码。默认支持 Google Java Style Guide 和 Sun Code Conventions，并且高度可配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Checkstyle 的源代码、文档、配置示例和构建脚本。提供命令行工具和 ANT 任务，支持通过 XML 配置自定义检查规则。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，使用 Maven 构建，依赖 Ant 等工具。支持多种 CI 集成，如 AppVeyor、CircleCI 等。
zh.hot: 今日新增 115 星，总星数 9203，登上 GitHub 日榜。作为长期维护的经典工具，持续获得开发者关注。
uses: Java 开发者：在编码时自动检查代码风格，确保符合团队或行业标准。
项目维护者：集成到 CI 流程中，自动执行代码规范检查，提升代码质量。
教育场景：用于教学 Java 编码规范，帮助学生养成良好编码习惯。

en.tag: Java code style checker supporting Google/Sun standards
en.what: Checkstyle is a development tool that helps programmers write Java code adhering to a coding standard. It supports Google Java Style Guide and Sun Code Conventions by default, and is highly configurable.
en.content: The repository contains Checkstyle's source code, documentation, configuration examples, and build scripts. It provides command-line tools and ANT tasks, with customizable check rules via XML configuration.
en.stack: Developed in Java, built with Maven, and integrates with Ant. Supports various CI systems like AppVeyor, CircleCI, etc.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars today, total 9203, trending on GitHub daily. As a long-maintained classic tool, it continues to attract developers.
uses: Java developers: automatically check code style during coding to ensure compliance with team or industry standards.
Project maintainers: integrate into CI pipelines to enforce code standards and improve code quality.
Educational settings: teach Java coding conventions and help students develop good coding habits.

zh.tag: AI 驱动的逆向/渗透测试技能路由与工具链自举包
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程客户端（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）设计的技能路由包，当遇到 APK、二进制、前端 JS 加密、CTF 或渗透测试目标时，它会自动路由到正确的方法论，检查可用工具，并执行可重复的工作流，而不是猜测命令。它支持按需自举工具链，并拥有自动进化的知识库。
zh.content: 仓库包含主路由脚本（master-route.ps1）、规则文件（RULES.md）、场景技能模块、工具/MCP 配置、运维契约（ops）以及自动进化的经验库，并配有中文和英文文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 PowerShell 编写路由脚本，依赖 AI 客户端的技能调用机制，可能涉及 MCP 工具集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增超过 1 万 star，总 star 接近 2 万，跃居 GitHub Trending 周榜第一。它精准解决了 AI 在安全测试中缺乏结构化方法论的问题，将逆向和渗透测试流程标准化，极大提升了 AI 代理的实用性和效率。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 辅助进行逆向工程和漏洞分析，提高效率。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中，快速引导 AI 执行标准化的渗透流程。
CTF 玩家：借助 AI 路由解决逆向和密码学挑战。
AI 工具开发者：参考其架构，为特定领域构建技能路由包。

en.tag: AI-driven skill router & toolchain bootstrapper for reverse engineering and pentesting
en.what: This is a skill router package for AI coding clients (like Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) that, upon encountering APKs, binaries, frontend JS encryption, CTF challenges, or pentesting targets, routes to the right methodology, checks available tools, and executes repeatable workflows instead of guessing commands. It supports on-demand toolchain bootstrapping and features a self-evolving knowledge base.
en.content: The repo includes a master routing script (master-route.ps1), rules file (RULES.md), scenario skill modules, tool/MCP configurations, ops contracts, and a self-evolving knowledge base, with documentation in both Chinese and English.
en.stack: Primarily written in PowerShell for routing scripts, leverages AI client skill invocation mechanisms, and may integrate with MCP tools.
en.hot: Gained over 10k stars this week, approaching 20k total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending weekly. It precisely addresses the lack of structured methodology for AI in security testing, standardizing reverse engineering and pentesting workflows, greatly enhancing AI agents' practicality and efficiency.
uses: Security researchers: Use AI-assisted reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis to boost efficiency.
Penetration testers: Guide AI to execute standardized pentesting workflows in authorized engagements.
CTF players: Leverage AI routing to solve reverse engineering and crypto challenges.
AI tool developers: Reference its architecture to build skill routers for other domains.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 邮箱与用户名 OSINT 深度情报套件
zh.what: 这是一个二合一的开源情报（OSINT）工具，只需一个邮箱或用户名，就能在 455+ 个扫描向量（175+ 邮箱站点、280+ 用户名平台）中深度提取数据，用于安全研究、调查和数字足迹分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 工具，支持跨平台（Termux、Windows、Linux），提供丰富的元数据抓取（头像、简介等），并有 Discord 社区和赞助商支持。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python，依赖 requests、beautifulsoup4 等常用库，支持 pip 安装，并针对 Termux 和桌面系统进行了测试。
zh.hot: 凭借 455+ 扫描向量和深度 OSINT 能力，在 GitHub 上获得 3565 星，今日新增 39 星，位列日榜第 17，吸引安全研究人员和调查人员关注。
uses: 安全研究人员用于漏洞评估和渗透测试中的信息收集。
调查记者或执法机构用于追踪数字足迹和验证账户注册。
个人用户用于检查自己的在线隐私暴露情况。

en.tag: 2-in-1 Email & Username OSINT suite for deep digital footprint analysis
en.what: A 2-in-1 OSINT suite that extracts deep data from a single email or username across 455+ scan vectors (175+ email sites, 280+ username platforms) for security research, investigations, and digital footprinting.
en.content: The repo contains a full Python tool with cross-platform support (Termux, Windows, Linux), rich metadata scraping (avatars, bios, etc.), and a Discord community plus sponsor backing.
en.stack: Built on Python with common libraries like requests and beautifulsoup4, installable via pip, tested on Termux, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: With 455+ scan vectors and deep OSINT capabilities, it has gained 3565 stars (39 today) and ranks #17 on the daily trending list, attracting security researchers and investigators.
uses: Security researchers use it for information gathering in vulnerability assessments and penetration testing.
Investigative journalists or law enforcement use it to trace digital footprints and verify account registrations.
Individuals use it to check their own online privacy exposure.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 中国专利智能助手：挖掘专利点、编写交底书、通俗解读
zh.what: 这是一个面向中国专利的 Agent 技能，帮助研发人员从项目材料中挖掘可申请的专利点，编写发明、实用新型、外观设计的交底书，并支持多轮迭代修改。它还能将公开专利解读成通俗笔记和知识图谱，沉淀为个人专利知识库，并辅助审查答复和政策嗅探。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义（SKILL.md）、安装说明（INSTALL.md）、设计文档、示例输出（如交底书、Mermaid 图、线稿图）以及相关代码。核心功能模块包括专利点挖掘、交底书生成与迭代、专利通俗解读（输出到 Obsidian）、审查答复辅助等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.9+，使用 Playwright 与 CNIPA（中国国家知识产权局）交互，遵循 AgentSkills 标准，集成 Obsidian CLI 和 Bases 生态，支持 Mermaid 图表生成。
zh.hot: 5.6k stars 且日增 62，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13，因为精准解决了研发人员写专利交底书的痛点，将专利解读与知识库结合，实用性强且演示效果直观。
uses: 研发工程师：从项目代码和方案中快速挖掘专利点，生成规范交底书
专利代理人/IPR：辅助审查答复、多轮修订交底书，并跟踪政策动向
技术管理者：将公开专利解读为通俗笔记，构建团队私有专利知识库
创新爱好者：学习专利撰写技巧，理解复杂专利的技术细节

en.tag: China patent skill: mine patent points, draft disclosures, plain-language analysis
en.what: This is an Agent skill for Chinese patents, helping R&D personnel mine patentable points from project materials, draft invention, utility model, and design patent disclosures, with multi-round iteration support. It also interprets public patents into plain-language notes and knowledge graphs, building a personal patent knowledge base, and assists with office action responses and policy tracking.
en.content: The repo includes skill definition (SKILL.md), installation guide (INSTALL.md), design docs, sample outputs (disclosures, Mermaid diagrams, line drawings), and code. Core modules cover patent point mining, disclosure generation and iteration, plain-language interpretation (into Obsidian), and office action assistance.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.9+, uses Playwright for CNIPA interaction, follows AgentSkills standard, integrates Obsidian CLI and Bases ecosystem, and supports Mermaid diagram generation.
en.hot: With 5.6k stars and +62 today, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending daily, it addresses the pain point of drafting patent disclosures for engineers, combining interpretation with knowledge base, highly practical with clear demos.
uses: R&D engineers: quickly mine patent points from code and designs, generate standard disclosures
Patent attorneys/IPR: assist with office actions, multi-round revisions, and policy tracking
Tech managers: interpret public patents into plain notes, build team patent knowledge base
Innovation enthusiasts: learn patent drafting skills and understand complex patent details

zh.tag: 超快 Rust PDF 检测与文本提取库
zh.what: pdf-inspector 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 PDF 处理库，能快速检测 PDF 是扫描版还是文本版，并提取带位置信息的文本，转换为干净的 Markdown。它内置智能分类功能，可在几十毫秒内判断 PDF 类型，并支持选择性 OCR，从而避免不必要的昂贵 OCR 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python/Node.js 绑定、浏览器 WebAssembly 版本，以及 CLI 工具。提供文本提取、Markdown 转换、表格检测、多栏布局处理、CID 字体支持等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖 PDFium 和 ONNX Runtime（用于 OCR），支持 Python、Node.js 和 WebAssembly。OCR 集成使用 PP-OCRv6 Small 模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 15341 星，总星数达 17007，位居 GitHub 趋势榜第二。其极快的速度和智能分类能力解决了 PDF 处理中的痛点，且由 Firecrawl 团队开发，信誉度高。
uses: 开发者需要快速将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或提取文本，用于 RAG 或数据管道。
处理大量 PDF 的文档管理系统，需要区分扫描件和文本件以优化流程。
需要本地化、低延迟 PDF 解析的浏览器应用或边缘计算场景。

en.tag: Ultra-fast Rust library for PDF inspection and text extraction
en.what: pdf-inspector is a high-performance Rust library for PDF processing that quickly detects whether a PDF is scanned or text-based, extracts position-aware text, and converts it to clean Markdown. It features smart classification in tens of milliseconds and supports selective OCR to avoid unnecessary expensive OCR services.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library, Python/Node.js bindings, browser WebAssembly build, and a CLI tool. It offers text extraction, Markdown conversion, table detection, multi-column layout handling, CID font support, and more.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with PDFium and ONNX Runtime for OCR, and bindings for Python, Node.js, and WebAssembly. OCR uses PP-OCRv6 Small model.
en.hot: Gained 15,341 stars this month, reaching 17,007 total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending. Its blazing speed and smart classification solve a common pain point, backed by the reputable Firecrawl team.
uses: Developers needing fast PDF-to-Markdown conversion or text extraction for RAG or data pipelines.
Document management systems processing large volumes of PDFs, needing to distinguish scanned vs text-based for workflow optimization.
Browser or edge applications requiring local, low-latency PDF parsing without server round trips.

zh.tag: 微型双足机器人 Microduck 的强化学习训练环境
zh.what: 该项目为约 800 克、25 厘米高的双足机器人 Microduck 提供强化学习训练环境，基于 MuJoCo Warp 和 PPO 算法，在 50 Hz 频率下训练策略，并导出为 ONNX 格式部署到真实机器人上。它完整实现了 sim2real 流程，包括执行器物理、域随机化和奖励设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含多种训练任务（如行走、跌倒恢复、站立等），提供训练、播放、导出和推理脚本，以及 Hugging Face Jobs 远程训练支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 MuJoCo Warp（需要 CUDA GPU）、PPO 算法、uv 包管理器，以及 ONNX 导出。
zh.hot: 今日新增 168 星，总星数 796，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名。其 sim2real 方法和真实机器人演示视频吸引了大量关注。
uses: 机器人研究人员：用于双足机器人强化学习训练和 sim2real 迁移研究
强化学习开发者：学习如何为真实机器人设计奖励函数和训练环境
对微型机器人感兴趣的爱好者：可观看真实机器人演示并尝试训练策略

en.tag: RL training environments for the Microduck bipedal robot
en.what: This project provides RL training environments for Microduck, an ~800g, ~25cm tall bipedal robot, built on MuJoCo Warp with PPO. Policies are trained at 50 Hz, exported to ONNX, and deployed on the real robot. It encodes the full sim2real recipe, including actuator physics, domain randomization, and reward design.
en.content: The repo includes multiple training tasks (e.g., walking, fall recovery, standing), scripts for training, playing, exporting, and inference, plus support for remote training via Hugging Face Jobs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on MuJoCo Warp (requires CUDA GPU), PPO algorithm, uv package manager, and ONNX export.
en.hot: Gained 168 stars today, total 796, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending. Its sim2real approach and real-robot demo videos attract significant attention.
uses: Robotics researchers: for RL training and sim2real transfer on bipedal robots
RL developers: to learn reward design and training environments for real robots
Hobbyists interested in miniature robots: to watch real demos and try training policies

zh.tag: 用编码智能体剪辑视频，全开源
zh.what: video-use 是一个开源工具，让用户通过 Claude Code 等编码智能体以对话方式剪辑视频。用户将原始素材放入文件夹，与智能体聊天，即可获得最终视频。它支持自动去除填充词、调色、字幕、动画叠加等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、SKILL.md 使用说明、helpers/ 目录下的编辑脚本，以及用于动画生成的集成模块（HyperFrames、Remotion、Manim、PIL）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 ffmpeg 进行视频处理，使用 ElevenLabs API 进行语音相关功能，并支持多种动画生成库。
zh.hot: 它让视频剪辑变得像聊天一样简单，结合了 AI 智能体的自动化能力，上线即获得 2.2 万星标，日增近 600，成为 Python 趋势榜第 8 名。
uses: 内容创作者：快速剪辑 talking head 视频，自动去除口头禅和停顿。
教程制作者：将原始录屏自动剪辑成带字幕和调色的成品教程。
开发者：希望用编码智能体自动化视频处理流程，可定制 ffmpeg 链和动画。

en.tag: Edit videos with coding agents, fully open source
en.what: video-use is an open-source tool that lets users edit videos by chatting with coding agents like Claude Code. Drop raw footage in a folder, chat, and get a final video. It automates filler word removal, color grading, subtitles, and animation overlays.
en.content: The repo contains install scripts, SKILL.md usage guide, editing scripts in helpers/, and integrations for animation generation (HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim, PIL).
en.stack: Built on Python, relies on ffmpeg for video processing, uses ElevenLabs API for voice-related features, and supports multiple animation libraries.
en.hot: It makes video editing as simple as chatting, leveraging AI agent automation. It gained 22k stars quickly with ~600 daily, ranking #8 on Python trending.
uses: Content creators: quickly edit talking-head videos, auto-remove filler words and pauses.
Tutorial makers: turn raw screen recordings into finished tutorials with subtitles and color grading.
Developers: automate video pipelines with coding agents, customizing ffmpeg chains and animations.

zh.tag: 为 LLM 打造的开源网络爬虫与抓取工具
zh.what: Crawl4AI 是一个开源网络爬虫和抓取工具，专为大型语言模型设计。它能将网页转换为干净、结构化的 Markdown 格式，方便用于 RAG、AI 代理和数据管道。该工具强调速度、可控性和易用性，并拥有超过 50k 星标的社区支持。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库、Docker API 服务器、Playwright 集成、内存自适应调度器、GPU 支持，以及详细的文档和示例。最新版本 v0.9.2 修复了内存泄漏和 Docker 认证问题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器自动化，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用对高质量数据的需求激增，Crawl4AI 提供了专门为 LLM 优化的爬虫解决方案，star 数已超 8 万，今日新增 221，跻身 GitHub 趋势榜第 6。
uses: AI 开发者：为 RAG 系统或 AI 代理抓取网页并转换为干净的 Markdown 数据。
数据工程师：构建数据管道，从网站提取结构化内容用于分析和训练。
研究人员：快速收集和整理网页信息，用于学术研究或市场调研。

en.tag: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler & scraper for clean Markdown
en.what: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler and scraper designed specifically for large language models. It converts web pages into clean, structured Markdown, making it easy to use for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It emphasizes speed, controllability, and ease of use, backed by a community of over 50k stars.
en.content: The repository includes a Python library, Docker API server, Playwright integration, memory-adaptive dispatcher, GPU support, and extensive documentation and examples. The latest v0.9.2 fixes memory leaks and Docker authentication issues.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging Playwright for browser automation, Docker for deployment, and optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: With the surge in demand for high-quality data for LLM applications, Crawl4AI offers a crawler solution specifically optimized for LLMs, amassing over 80k stars and 221 new stars today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI developers: crawl web pages and convert to clean Markdown for RAG systems or AI agents.
Data engineers: build data pipelines to extract structured content from websites for analysis and training.
Researchers: quickly collect and organize web information for academic research or market analysis.

zh.tag: 开源OSINT自动化工具，用于威胁情报与攻击面测绘
zh.what: SpiderFoot 是一个开源情报（OSINT）自动化工具，集成众多数据源并运用多种分析方法，帮助用户收集和分析公开信息。它提供 Web 界面和命令行两种使用方式，支持威胁情报收集、攻击面测绘等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SpiderFoot 的完整源代码，包括 200 多个模块、基于 YAML 的关联引擎（含 37 条预定义规则）、Web 界面、CLI、SQLite 后端、导出功能（CSV/JSON/GEXF）、Dockerfile 以及文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.7+ 开发，使用 SQLite 作为后端数据库，支持 TOR 集成，可通过 Docker 部署，并能调用 DNSTwist、Whatweb、Nmap 等外部工具。
zh.hot: SpiderFoot 已持续开发超过 10 年，拥有 21.6k 星标，今日新增 77 星并登上 GitHub 趋势榜。其强大的 OSINT 自动化和攻击面测绘能力深受安全研究人员和渗透测试者喜爱。
uses: 安全分析师：用于威胁情报收集和攻击面监控，快速识别潜在风险。

网络安全爱好者：学习 OSINT 技术，探索公开信息分析的方法。

en.tag: Open-source OSINT automation for threat intelligence and attack surface mapping
en.what: SpiderFoot is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) automation tool that integrates with numerous data sources and employs various analysis methods to help users collect and analyze public information. It offers both a web interface and command-line usage, supporting threat intelligence gathering and attack surface mapping.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SpiderFoot, including over 200 modules, a YAML-configurable correlation engine with 37 pre-defined rules, a web UI, CLI, SQLite backend, export features (CSV/JSON/GEXF), Dockerfile, and documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Python 3.7+, uses SQLite as the backend database, supports TOR integration, can be deployed via Docker, and can call external tools like DNSTwist, Whatweb, Nmap, and CMSeeK.
en.hot: SpiderFoot has been actively developed for over 10 years, with 21.6k stars and 77 new stars today, making it to the GitHub trending list. Its powerful OSINT automation and attack surface mapping capabilities are popular among security researchers and penetration testers.
uses: Security analysts: use it for threat intelligence gathering and attack surface monitoring to quickly identify potential risks.
Penetration testers: automate information gathering during authorized tests to improve efficiency.
Cybersecurity enthusiasts: learn OSINT techniques and explore methods of analyzing public information.

zh.tag: 自托管、隐私优先的个人财务管理工具
zh.what: Securo 是一款开源的个人财务管理器，强调数据自主权，让用户在自己的基础设施上运行，完全掌控账户、支出和习惯，不向第三方泄露任何数据。它提供多账户管理、交易管理、自动分类、预算、目标追踪等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端、后端、文档和安装脚本，提供 Docker 镜像和 Helm chart，支持快速部署。主要目录包括 docs、src 等，包含完整的应用代码和测试。

技术爱好者或开发者，喜欢自托管服务并愿意自行部署和维护。
小型团队或家庭，需要集中管理多账户和预算，同时避免第三方服务。

en.tag: Self-hosted, privacy-first personal finance manager
en.what: Securo is an open-source personal finance manager that emphasizes data sovereignty, allowing users to run it on their own infrastructure, gaining full visibility into accounts, spending, and habits without surrendering data to third parties. It offers multi-account management, transaction management, auto-categorization, budgets, and goal tracking.
en.content: The repository contains frontend, backend, documentation, and installation scripts, with Docker images and Helm charts for quick deployment. Main directories include docs, src, etc., containing full application code and tests.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, frontend likely uses JavaScript/TypeScript, relies on Docker or Podman for containerized deployment, and supports multiple file formats (OFX, QIF, CAMT, CSV).

Tech enthusiasts or developers who prefer self-hosted services and are willing to deploy and maintain them.
Small teams or families needing centralized multi-account and budget management without third-party services.

zh.tag: AI驱动的量化投资平台，从研究到生产全流程
zh.what: Qlib 是一个面向 AI 的量化投资平台，旨在利用 AI 技术赋能量化研究，从想法探索到生产实现。它支持多种机器学习建模范式，包括监督学习、市场动态建模和强化学习，并集成了 RD-Agent 来自动化研发流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的量化投资工具链，包括数据层、因子库、模型库、回测系统和实盘模拟等模块，以及 RD-Agent 的集成示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch、LightGBM、pandas、numpy 等机器学习库，支持 Linux/Windows/macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的量化平台，Qlib 已积累 4.8 万+ star，近期因集成 RD-Agent 实现自动化因子挖掘和模型优化而再次受到关注，今日新增 51 star。

机器学习工程师：在金融数据上应用监督学习、强化学习等前沿模型。
金融科技开发者：基于 Qlib 构建生产级量化交易系统。
学术研究者：研究市场动态建模和自动化研发框架。

en.tag: AI-oriented quant investment platform, from research to production
en.what: Qlib is an AI-oriented quant investment platform that leverages AI to empower quant research, from idea exploration to production deployment. en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on PyTorch, LightGBM, pandas, numpy, and other ML libraries; supports Linux, Windows, and macOS.

ML engineers: apply cutting-edge models like supervised learning and RL on financial data.
Fintech developers: build production-grade quant trading systems on Qlib.
Academic researchers: study market dynamics modeling and automated R&D frameworks.

zh.tag: AI 代理搜索引擎，聚合多平台真实用户信号生成摘要
zh.what: 这是一个 AI 代理技能，能够并行搜索 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 等平台，根据点赞、投票和真实资金等信号对结果进行评分，并由 AI 代理法官综合成一份简洁的摘要。它旨在提供比传统搜索引擎更贴近真实用户关注点的信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义文件（SKILL.md）、安装脚本、多语言 README 以及演示媒体资源。核心是 SKILL.md，它定义了命令和设置行为，支持通过插件市场或 npx 安装到多种 AI 代理宿主。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖各平台的 API 和浏览器会话，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 50 多种代理宿主。零配置即可使用 Reddit、HN、Polymarket 和 GitHub，通过设置向导可解锁更多平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 6 万+ 星标和日增 230 星，它解决了信息过载问题，提供跨平台真实用户信号的综合摘要，这种能力是单一 AI 或搜索引擎无法提供的，因此迅速成为开发者关注的焦点。
uses: 需要快速了解某话题在多个社交平台真实热度的市场研究员或记者
希望获取竞争对手或行业人物最新动态的产品经理和创业者
对 AI 代理技术感兴趣，想体验跨平台搜索能力的开发者

en.tag: AI agent-led search engine that aggregates real user signals across platforms
en.what: This is an AI agent skill that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web in parallel, scores results by upvotes, likes, and real-money signals, and synthesizes a concise brief via an AI agent judge. It aims to surface what real people actually engage with, unlike traditional search engines.

en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging platform APIs and browser sessions, compatible with 50+ agent hosts like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Zero-config for Reddit, HN, Polymarket, GitHub; setup wizard unlocks more platforms.
en.hot: With 60K+ stars and +230 daily, it addresses information overload by synthesizing cross-platform real-user signals, a capability no single AI or search engine offers, making it a trending developer favorite.
uses: Market researchers or journalists needing quick cross-platform sentiment on a topic
Product managers and entrepreneurs tracking competitors or industry figures
Developers interested in AI agent technology and cross-platform search capabilities

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室：克隆、配音、转录一站式
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源、完全本地运行的语音工具套件，可作为 ElevenLabs 的替代品。它支持语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。核心工作流无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，注重隐私和离线可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（支持 macOS、Windows、Linux）、本地 REST/SSE/WebSocket API、OpenAI 兼容音频 API 和 MCP 服务器。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供模型目录和快速切换功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，支持 CUDA、Apple Silicon MPS/MLX、ROCm 和 CPU 计算，可选远程工作节点。依赖多种 TTS/ASR 引擎，并采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 12k+ 星标和月增 2781 星，VoiceStudio 在 GitHub 趋势榜上迅速走红。其本地优先、多引擎、多语言的特点吸引了注重隐私和灵活性的用户，成为商业服务的开源替代。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频、播客或有声书生成高质量配音，且希望完全离线处理。
隐私敏感用户：不愿将语音数据上传到云端，要求本地处理以保护敏感信息。
开发者：需要集成语音功能到应用中，利用 OpenAI 兼容 API 或 MCP 服务器。
多语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行语言学习、听力训练或翻译辅助。

en.tag: Local-first all-in-one voice studio: cloning, dubbing, transcription & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local voice toolkit that serves as an ElevenLabs alternative. It supports voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. The core workflow requires no account, API key, or subscription, emphasizing privacy and offline usability.
en.content: The repository includes a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux), local REST/SSE/WebSocket API, OpenAI-compatible audio API, and MCP server. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, with a model catalogue and quick-switch functionality.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, supporting CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS/MLX, ROCm, and CPU compute, with optional remote workers. It leverages multiple TTS/ASR engines and is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and a monthly increase of 2,781, VoiceStudio is rapidly rising on GitHub Trending. Its local-first, multi-engine, multi-language approach attracts privacy-conscious and flexibility-seeking users as an open-source alternative to commercial services.
uses: Content creators: need high-quality voiceovers for videos, podcasts, or audiobooks, preferring fully offline processing.
Privacy-conscious users: avoid uploading voice data to the cloud, requiring local processing to protect sensitive information.
Developers: integrate voice capabilities into apps using OpenAI-compatible API or MCP server.
Language learners: leverage 646-language support for language practice, listening training, or translation assistance.

zh.tag: Python 数据管道编排框架，让脚本秒变生产级工作流
zh.what: Prefect 是一个用于构建弹性数据管道的 Python 工作流编排框架。它通过调度、缓存、重试和事件驱动自动化等功能，让数据团队用几行代码就能将脚本提升为生产级工作流。工作流活动可被追踪，并通过自托管 Prefect server 或托管的 Prefect Cloud 仪表盘监控。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prefect 的核心 Python 库，提供 Flow 和 Task 抽象、调度器、事件系统、UI 仪表盘（通过 Prefect server 或 Cloud），以及丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python，依赖 pydantic、httpx、croniter 等库，支持异步和同步工作流，可与常见数据工具集成。
zh.hot: 拥有 23.7k 星标，因其简化数据管道编排、提供弹性重试和事件驱动而广受欢迎，今日新增 13 星，位列 Python 趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: 数据工程师：构建可监控、可重试的 ETL/ELT 管道，替代 Airflow 等复杂工具。
数据科学家：将训练脚本或数据处理流程自动化，实现定时运行和异常恢复。
平台团队：作为工作流引擎，集成到内部数据平台，提供统一调度和监控。

en.tag: Python workflow orchestration framework to turn scripts into production pipelines
en.what: Prefect is a Python workflow orchestration framework for building resilient data pipelines. It elevates scripts into production workflows with features like scheduling, caching, retries, and event-based automations, all trackable via a self-hosted server or Prefect Cloud dashboard.
en.content: The repo contains the core Prefect Python library, offering Flow and Task abstractions, scheduling, event system, UI dashboards (via server or Cloud), plus extensive docs and examples.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, leveraging pydantic, httpx, croniter, etc., supporting both async and sync workflows, and integrating with common data tools.
en.hot: With 23.7k stars, it's popular for simplifying data pipeline orchestration with resilient retries and event-driven automation; gained 13 stars today, ranking #15 on Python trending.
uses: Data engineers: build monitorable, retryable ETL/ELT pipelines as a simpler alternative to Airflow.
Data scientists: automate training scripts or data processing with scheduling and failure recovery.
Platform teams: integrate as a workflow engine in internal data platforms for unified scheduling and monitoring.

zh.tag: 跨平台本地运行的语音交互 Live2D 虚拟主播助手
zh.what: Open-LLM-VTuber 是一个让用户通过语音与任意大语言模型（LLM）进行免提对话的开源项目。它支持语音打断、Live2D 形象实时面部追踪，并能在本地跨平台运行，提供沉浸式的虚拟角色交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 代码库，涵盖语音识别、LLM 推理、语音合成和 Live2D 渲染模块，并提供 Docker 镜像、文档和示例配置。

zh.hot: 凭借 13.5k+ stars 和日增 18 的热度，它满足了用户对个性化 AI 虚拟形象和语音交互的需求，且完全本地运行，隐私友好。

对本地隐私保护有要求，希望离线运行 LLM 对话的用户
教育或娱乐领域，用于制作互动式虚拟角色

en.tag: Cross-platform local voice-interactive Live2D VTuber assistant for any LLM
en.what: Open-LLM-VTuber is an open-source project that enables hands-free voice conversations with any LLM. It features voice interruption, Live2D avatar with real-time face tracking, and runs locally across platforms for an immersive virtual character interaction.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python codebase with modules for speech recognition, LLM inference, TTS, and Live2D rendering, along with Docker images, documentation, and sample configs.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging speech libraries (e.g., faster-whisper, edge-tts) and Live2D rendering, supporting multiple LLM backends, deployable via Docker.

Hands-free voice interaction for smart home or in-car scenarios
Users requiring local privacy protection and offline LLM conversations
Educational or entertainment purposes for interactive virtual characters

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。

产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.

Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 让 Claude 变身安全分析师的一站式 CVE 情报 MCP 服务器
zh.what: 这是一个生产级的 MCP 服务器，为 Claude 提供 28 个安全情报工具，覆盖 24 个 API，包括 CVE 查询、EPSS 评分、CISA KEV、MITRE ATT&CK、Shodan、VirusTotal 等。通过一个 `triage_cve` 编排器，用户只需提问即可获得关联情报和优先级建议，无需在多个网站间手动切换。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 MCP 服务器实现，包括架构文档、28 个工具的目录、安装指南、API 密钥设置、配置说明、快速入门和用法示例。代码基于 Python 和 FastMCP，支持异步并发请求。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Python 3.10+、FastMCP、httpx、aiosqlite、Pydantic v2 和 defusedxml。依赖这些库实现异步 HTTP 请求、SQLite 缓存、数据验证和 XML 安全解析。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 上迅速走红，今日新增 30 星，总星数达 1334。它解决了安全分析师处理 CVE 时的效率痛点，将多个数据源整合到一个 MCP 服务器中，大幅简化了工作流程。
uses: 安全分析师：快速评估 CVE 风险，获取综合评分和补丁建议。
开发运维人员：在 CI/CD 流程中集成漏洞情报，自动预警。
AI 应用开发者：为 Claude 等助手扩展安全能力，实现智能问答。

en.tag: Production-grade MCP server that turns Claude into a full-spectrum security analyst with 28 tools across 24 APIs.
en.what: This is a production-grade MCP server that gives Claude 28 security intelligence tools across 24 APIs, including CVE lookup, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV, MITRE ATT&CK, Shodan, VirusTotal, and more. With a one-call `triage_cve` orchestrator, users can ask a question and get correlated intelligence and prioritized recommendations without manually juggling multiple websites.
en.content: The repository contains a complete MCP server implementation, including architecture documentation, a catalog of 28 tools, installation guide, API keys setup, configuration, quick start, and usage examples. The code is based on Python and FastMCP, supporting asynchronous concurrent requests.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Python 3.10+, FastMCP, httpx, aiosqlite, Pydantic v2, and defusedxml. These libraries enable async HTTP requests, SQLite caching, data validation, and secure XML parsing.
en.hot: The project is gaining traction on GitHub Trending, with 30 new stars today and 1,334 total. It addresses the pain point of security analysts triaging CVEs by consolidating multiple data sources into one MCP server, significantly streamlining the workflow.
uses: Security analysts: quickly assess CVE risk with composite scores and patch recommendations.
DevOps engineers: integrate vulnerability intelligence into CI/CD pipelines for automated alerts.
AI application developers: extend assistants like Claude with security capabilities for intelligent Q&A.

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，无需SSH和复杂配置
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，旨在简化大语言模型的微调和后训练流程。用户只需编写一个 YAML 配置文件，然后执行一条命令即可完成训练，无需管理 SSH 或处理复杂的配置。它支持在普通笔记本电脑 GPU（如 4GB 显存）上训练 8B 参数的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包（soup-cli），提供命令行接口、配置解析、训练引擎（基于分层流式训练）以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，使用 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构，通过 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 以 4198 星且单日新增 326 星登上趋势榜，因其大幅降低了 LLM 微调的门槛，让普通开发者也能在消费级硬件上训练大模型。
uses: 希望在自己的笔记本上微调大模型的研究者和开发者
需要快速迭代模型原型、不想折腾基础设施的 AI 工程师
教学场景中用于演示 LLM 微调流程的教师和学生

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs with one command, no SSH or config hell
en.what: Soup is a command-line tool that simplifies fine-tuning and post-training of large language models. Users write a single YAML config and run one command to train, without SSH or complex configuration. It supports training 8B models on a 4GB laptop GPU.

教育场景中用于演示解释器工作原理

en.tag: A Python interpreter written in Rust, with WebAssembly support
en.what: RustPython is a Python 3 interpreter written in Rust, aiming for compatibility with CPython 3.14+. It can run in the browser via WebAssembly or as a standalone command-line program. This project opens new possibilities for integrating Python and Rust ecosystems.
en.content: The repository contains the interpreter core, standard library (Lib/), documentation, and examples. It supports an interactive shell, script execution, and an online demo via WebAssembly.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, relying on the Rust standard library and several crates, with support for WebAssembly compilation. Requires the latest stable Rust.
en.hot: RustPython has over 22k stars on GitHub, gaining attention for its innovative rewrite of the Python interpreter in Rust, especially with unique advantages in WebAssembly scenarios.
uses: Developers interested in both Rust and Python, to learn interpreter implementation principles
Web developers needing to run Python code in the browser
Engineers wanting to embed Python in Rust applications or optimize performance
Educational contexts for demonstrating interpreter internals

zh.tag: Web 项目一体化工具链，提供格式化与代码检查
zh.what: Biome 是一个为 Web 项目设计的工具链，旨在提供维护项目所需的功能。它通过 CLI 和 LSP 提供格式化和代码检查能力，帮助开发者保持代码风格一致并发现潜在问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心工具，提供命令行接口和语言服务器协议（LSP）支持，同时有 npm 包和 VS Code 扩展等集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，提供 npm 包（@biomejs/biome）和 VS Code 扩展，支持多种语言（如 JavaScript、TypeScript、JSON 等）。
zh.hot: Biome 作为 Prettier 和 ESLint 的高性能替代品，凭借 Rust 带来的速度和一体化设计，在开发者中广受欢迎，star 数已超 2.5 万。
uses: 前端开发者希望统一代码风格并减少配置负担，可使用 Biome 替代多个工具。
团队需要快速、低内存占用的代码检查工具，适合集成到 CI/CD 流程。
使用 VS Code 等编辑器的开发者，可通过 LSP 获得实时格式化与错误提示。

en.tag: All-in-one toolchain for web projects with formatter and linter
en.what: Biome is a toolchain for web projects, aimed to provide functionalities to maintain them. It offers formatter and linter, usable via CLI and LSP, helping developers keep code style consistent and catch potential issues.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based core tool with CLI and LSP support, along with npm packages and VS Code extension integrations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, offering npm packages (@biomejs/biome) and VS Code extension, supporting multiple languages like JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, etc.
en.hot: Biome is popular as a high-performance alternative to Prettier and ESLint, thanks to its Rust-based speed and all-in-one design, with over 25k stars.
uses: Frontend developers who want to unify code style and reduce configuration overhead can use Biome to replace multiple tools.
Teams needing a fast, low-memory linter suitable for CI/CD integration.
Developers using editors like VS Code can get real-time formatting and error hints via LSP.

zh.tag: 终端里的开源编码代理，用 Rust 打造
zh.what: CodeWhale 是一个运行在终端中的开源编码代理，能够理解自然语言指令，自动读取仓库、编辑文件、执行命令并持续迭代直到完成任务。它支持多种模型提供商和本地模型，并提供不同的权限模式让用户控制代理的访问范围。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、安装脚本、文档（多语言 README）、CI 配置，以及通过 crates.io 和 npm 分发的 CLI 工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持通过 npm、Cargo、Docker 等方式安装，可连接 Ollama、vLLM、SGLang 等本地模型服务，并支持 MCP 服务器和技能扩展。
zh.hot: 凭借 4 万+ Star 和活跃的社区贡献，CodeWhale 在 Rust 趋势榜上名列前茅，其终端原生体验和高度可定制性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端内快速执行编码任务，如修复测试、重构代码等。
团队需要可审计、可控权限的 AI 编码助手，用于日常开发流程。
喜欢 Rust 生态和开源工具链的用户，希望深度定制自己的 AI 代理。

en.tag: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust
en.what: CodeWhale is an open-source coding agent that runs in your terminal, understanding natural language commands to read repositories, edit files, run commands, and iterate until tasks are done. It supports various model providers and local models, with approval modes to control agent access.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, installation scripts, documentation (multi-language READMEs), CI config, and CLI tools distributed via crates.io and npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, installable via npm, Cargo, Docker, etc., and can connect to local model services like Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, with support for MCP servers and skills.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and active community contributions, CodeWhale ranks high on the Rust trending list, attracting developers with its terminal-native experience and high customizability.
uses: Developers who want to quickly execute coding tasks in the terminal, like fixing tests or refactoring code.
Teams needing an auditable, permission-controlled AI coding assistant for daily workflows.
Users who love the Rust ecosystem and open-source toolchains, wanting to deeply customize their AI agent.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的 GNU coreutils，跨平台替代品
zh.what: uutils coreutils 是一个用 Rust 重新实现的 GNU coreutils 工具集，目标是成为 GNU 工具的即插即用替代品。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等多种平台，并尽可能与 GNU 行为保持一致。
zh.content: 仓库包含所有核心工具的实现，如 ls、cat、cp 等，并提供预编译二进制、man 手册和 shell 补全。文档包括用户手册和开发者文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 上的库，支持多种操作系统，包括 Linux、macOS、BSD、Windows 和 WASI。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中备受关注的项目，拥有 24k+ star，因其跨平台特性和对 GNU 兼容性的追求而受欢迎，且已被 Ubuntu 默认集成。
uses: 系统管理员和开发者需要在不同操作系统上使用一致的命令行工具
Rust 爱好者希望研究或贡献一个大型 Rust 项目
需要更安全、更现代的工具替代传统 GNU 工具的用户

en.tag: Cross-platform Rust rewrite of GNU coreutils as a drop-in replacement
en.what: uutils coreutils is a Rust reimplementation of the GNU coreutils, aiming to be a drop-in replacement. It supports multiple platforms like Linux, macOS, and Windows, and strives for exact compatibility with GNU behavior.
en.content: The repository contains implementations of all core utilities like ls, cat, cp, etc., along with prebuilt binaries, manpages, and shell completions. Documentation includes user and developer manuals.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging crates.io libraries, supporting multiple OSes including Linux, macOS, BSD, Windows, and WASI.
en.hot: With over 24k stars, it's a popular Rust project, valued for cross-platform support and GNU compatibility, and is now shipped by default on Ubuntu.
uses: System administrators and developers needing consistent CLI tools across different OSes
Rust enthusiasts interested in studying or contributing to a large Rust project
Users seeking safer, more modern alternatives to traditional GNU tools

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing

zh.tag: 本地优先的研究代理工作台，支持并行探索与自动研究
zh.what: OpenResearch 是一个本地优先的研究代理工作台，可将 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 转变为研究代理，用于文献综述、假设开发、实验运行和研究产物生成。它支持并行探索、可复现实验和证据上下文关联，并允许用户选择代理和计算资源。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供桌面应用下载、文档和安装脚本。核心功能包括并行探索（每个研究方向独立代理会话和 git worktree）、可复现实验（git 原生实验树）、证据上下文关联，以及自动研究（autoresearch）能力。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 git 进行版本控制和实验追踪。支持多种计算后端（本地、SSH、Slurm、Kubernetes、Ray、Modal 等），并集成 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等代理。
zh.hot: 今日新增 63 星，登上 Rust 日榜第 8 名，因其为研究自动化提供了灵活、本地优先的解决方案，支持任意模型和并行代理，满足 AI 研究社区对可复现和自主实验的需求。
uses: 科研人员：可并行探索多个研究方向，自动运行实验并追踪结果，提升研究效率。
AI 开发者：集成 Claude Code 等代理，快速构建和测试研究假设，生成研究产物。
团队协作：通过 git 原生实验树共享和复现实验，确保研究可追溯性。

en.tag: Local-first workspace for research agents with parallel exploration and autoresearch
en.what: OpenResearch is a local-first workspace for research agents, turning Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode into agents that can review literature, develop hypotheses, run experiments, and produce research artifacts. It supports parallel exploration, reproducible experiments, and evidence-in-context, with user choice of agent and compute.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust CLI tool, with desktop app download, docs, and install script. Key features include parallel exploration (independent agent sessions and isolated git worktrees per direction), reproducible experiments (git-native experiment tree), evidence-in-context, and autoresearch capability.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging git for version control and experiment tracking. Supports multiple compute backends (local, SSH, Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray, Modal, etc.) and integrates agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.
en.hot: Gained 63 stars today, ranking #8 on Rust daily trending, as it offers a flexible, local-first solution for research automation with any model and parallel agents, meeting the AI research community's need for reproducible and autonomous experiments.
uses: Researchers: explore multiple directions in parallel, run experiments automatically, and track results to boost productivity.
AI developers: integrate agents like Claude Code to quickly build and test hypotheses, producing research artifacts.
Teams: share and reproduce experiments via git-native experiment tree, ensuring traceability.

zh.tag: 超快图数据库，为 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）而生
zh.what: FalkorDB 是一个基于 Rust 的超快图数据库，利用稀疏矩阵和线性代数实现高性能查询。它专为大型语言模型（LLM）设计，旨在提供极低延迟的知识图谱支持，适用于生成式 AI、代理记忆、云安全和欺诈检测等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的图数据库实现，包括稀疏矩阵表示、线性代数查询引擎、属性图模型支持以及 OpenCypher 兼容的查询语言。还提供了 Docker 镜像、云服务入口和详细的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，底层依赖 GraphBLAS 进行稀疏矩阵运算。支持 OpenCypher 查询语言，并提供 Docker 部署方式。
zh.hot: 随着 GraphRAG 的兴起，FalkorDB 作为专为 LLM 设计的图数据库，解决了知识图谱的延迟问题。今日新增 21 星，总星数达 5749，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 9，显示出开发者对高性能图数据库的强烈需求。
uses: 构建 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）应用，实现低延迟的上下文检索。
为 AI 代理提供持久化记忆存储，支持多租户场景。
用于云安全分析和欺诈检测，处理复杂关系数据。
作为传统图数据库的替代，提升查询性能。

en.tag: Ultra-fast graph database for LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG)
en.what: FalkorDB is an ultra-fast graph database built in Rust, leveraging sparse matrices and linear algebra for high-performance queries. It is designed for large language models (LLMs), aiming to provide extremely low-latency knowledge graph support for generative AI, agent memory, cloud security, and fraud detection.
en.content: The repository contains a full graph database implementation, including sparse matrix representation, linear algebra query engine, property graph model support, and OpenCypher-compatible query language. It also provides Docker images, cloud service entry, and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging GraphBLAS for sparse matrix operations. Supports OpenCypher query language and offers Docker deployment.
en.hot: With the rise of GraphRAG, FalkorDB, as a graph database designed specifically for LLMs, addresses the latency issues of knowledge graphs. Gaining 21 stars today, reaching 5749 total, it ranks #9 on the Rust trending list, reflecting strong developer demand for high-performance graph databases.
uses: Build LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG) for low-latency context retrieval.
Provide persistent memory storage for AI agents, supporting multi-tenant scenarios.
Use in cloud security analytics and fraud detection to handle complex relational data.
Serve as a high-performance alternative to traditional graph databases.

zh.tag: 跨平台自主AI个人助理基础设施，Rust实现，可部署任意处
zh.what: ZeroClaw是一个代理运行时，用单个Rust二进制文件配置和运行。它连接多种LLM提供商（如Anthropic、OpenAI、Ollama等），通过30多个渠道（如Discord、Telegram、Matrix、邮件、语音、Webhooks、CLI）与世界交互，并通过工具（如shell、浏览器、HTTP、硬件、自定义MCP服务器）执行操作。所有内容都在你的机器上运行，使用你的密钥，在你的工作空间中。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust源码、文档（包括哲学、快速入门、架构指南）、安装脚本（Unix和Windows）、以及CI工作流。核心是一个可配置的代理运行时，支持多种LLM和渠道。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust（2024版），依赖包括LLM提供商SDK、消息渠道集成、工具执行模块。支持通过安装脚本快速部署。
zh.hot: 因其自主AI助理基础设施的概念而火爆，强调用户拥有代理、数据和运行机器。32.7k星标表明社区高度认可，今日新增11星，位列Rust趋势榜第10。
uses: 希望自托管AI助理并完全掌控数据隐私的个人开发者或技术爱好者。
需要跨平台（任何OS）且可部署到任何环境的自动化代理场景。
对Rust生态感兴趣，想探索高性能代理运行时实现的开发者。

en.tag: Fast, small, fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform
en.what: ZeroClaw is an agent runtime — a single Rust binary you configure and run. It talks to LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and ~20 others), reaches the world through 30+ channels (Discord, Telegram, Matrix, email, voice, webhooks, your own CLI), and acts through tools (shell, browser, HTTP, hardware, custom MCP servers). Everything runs on your machine, with your keys, in your workspace.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (philosophy, quickstart, architecture), install scripts for Unix and Windows, and CI workflows. The core is a configurable agent runtime supporting multiple LLMs and channels.
en.stack: Primarily Rust (2024 edition), with dependencies for LLM provider SDKs, messaging channel integrations, and tool execution modules. Quick deployment via install scripts.
en.hot: Hot due to its concept of autonomous AI assistant infrastructure, emphasizing user ownership of agent, data, and machine. 32.7k stars show high community approval, with 11 new stars today, ranking #10 on Rust trending.
uses: Individual developers or tech enthusiasts who want to self-host an AI assistant with full data privacy control.
Automation scenarios requiring cross-platform (any OS) and deployable to any environment.
Developers interested in Rust ecosystem and exploring high-performance agent runtime implementations.

zh.tag: Python 超快类型检查器与语言服务器
zh.what: Pyrefly 是 Facebook 开源的 Python 类型检查器和语言服务器，提供极速的类型检查以及代码导航、语义高亮、自动补全等 IDE 功能。它支持命令行工具和多种编辑器扩展，已在 Meta 的 2000 万行代码库中生产验证。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心类型检查器、语言服务器协议实现、CLI 工具（pyrefly）、VS Code/Neovim/Zed 等编辑器扩展，以及迁移工具（pyrefly init/suppress/infer）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python 包（PyPI）和 VS Code 扩展，依赖 LSP 协议，支持 Pydantic、Django、pytest 等框架。
zh.hot: 凭借每秒检查 185 万行代码的速度，比 Mypy 和 Pyright 快 15 倍，且已被 PyTorch、JAX 等大型项目采用，star 数达 6921，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: Python 开发者希望获得更快的类型检查体验，提升开发效率
大型 Python 项目团队需要可扩展、生产级的类型检查工具
IDE 用户想要开箱即用的代码导航、补全和语义高亮功能
从 Mypy 或 Pyright 迁移的团队，需要平滑的迁移路径

en.tag: A lightning-fast type checker and language server for Python
en.what: Pyrefly is Facebook's open-source Python type checker and language server, offering lightning-fast type checking along with IDE features like code navigation, semantic highlighting, and autocomplete. It is available as a CLI tool and editor extensions, production-proven on Meta's 20-million-line codebase.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust-based core type checker, language server protocol implementation, CLI tool (pyrefly), editor extensions for VS Code/Neovim/Zed, and migration utilities (pyrefly init/suppress/infer).
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, distributed as a Python package (PyPI) and VS Code extension, uses LSP protocol, with built-in support for Pydantic, Django, and pytest.
en.hot: With a speed of 1.85 million lines per second, 15x faster than Mypy and Pyright, and adopted by PyTorch and JAX, it has gained 6,921 stars and continues to attract attention.
uses: Python developers seeking faster type checking to boost productivity
Teams with large Python codebases needing scalable, production-grade type checking
IDE users wanting out-of-the-box code navigation, autocomplete, and semantic highlighting
Teams migrating from Mypy or Pyright who need a smooth transition path

zh.tag: 智能间隔重复记忆卡程序，开源桌面版
zh.what: Anki 是一款基于间隔重复算法的智能记忆卡片程序，帮助用户高效记忆。该仓库包含 Anki 桌面版的完整源代码，支持自定义卡片、同步和插件扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Anki 桌面版的源代码，包括核心算法、用户界面、同步功能以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，同时涉及 Python、TypeScript 等，依赖 Qt 框架。
zh.hot: Anki 是知名的学习工具，拥有庞大用户群，近期因 Rust 重写和持续更新而保持热度，今日新增 21 星。
uses: 语言学习者：通过间隔重复高效记忆单词和短语。
医学生和律师：记忆大量专业术语和知识点。
终身学习者：自定义卡片学习任何学科内容。

en.tag: Smart spaced repetition flashcard program, open-source desktop version
en.what: Anki is a smart spaced repetition flashcard program that helps users memorize efficiently. This repository contains the full source code for the desktop version, supporting custom cards, synchronization, and add-ons.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for Anki desktop, including core algorithms, user interface, synchronization, and documentation/contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python and TypeScript, relying on the Qt framework.
en.hot: Anki is a well-known learning tool with a large user base, staying hot due to Rust rewrite and continuous updates, gaining 21 stars today.
uses: Language learners: efficiently memorize vocabulary and phrases with spaced repetition.
Medical and law students: memorize vast professional terms and concepts.
Lifelong learners: create custom cards to study any subject.

zh.tag: 本地 Git 代理，用 AI 把关代码质量，自动开干净 PR
zh.what: no-mistakes 是一个本地 Git 代理，位于你的真实远程仓库之前。当你推送到 no-mistakes 而不是 origin 时，它会创建一个临时工作区，运行 AI 驱动的验证流程（审查、测试、文档、lint、推送、PR、CI），只有所有检查通过后才会将分支转发到配置的推送目标，并自动打开一个干净的 PR。整个过程非阻塞，不会干扰你的正常工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，提供 `git push no-mistakes` 命令，以及完整的文档、演示 GIF 和 GitHub Actions 发布流程。它支持多种 AI 代理（如 claude、codex、grok 等），并允许通过 `/no-mistakes` 命令让代理执行任务并把关。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 AI 代理（如 Claude、Codex 等），支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 平台。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 2，今日新增 236 星，总星数达 8208。它解决了开发者常见的痛点：在推送代码前自动进行 AI 驱动的质量检查，减少低质量 PR，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 个人开发者：在推送代码前自动进行 AI 审查，提升代码质量。
团队协作：确保 PR 干净、通过所有检查，减少人工审查负担。
AI 代理用户：让代理自动完成任务并把关，人保持最终控制。

en.tag: Local git proxy with AI-driven validation to raise clean PRs
en.what: no-mistakes is a local git proxy that sits in front of your real remote. When you push to no-mistakes instead of origin, it spins up a disposable worktree, runs an AI-driven validation pipeline (review, test, docs, lint, push, PR, CI), and only forwards the branch to the configured push target after all checks pass, then opens a clean PR automatically. It's non-blocking and doesn't disrupt your work.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool that provides the `git push no-mistakes` command, along with full documentation, a demo GIF, and GitHub Actions release workflow. It supports multiple AI agents (claude, codex, grok, etc.) and allows agents to run tasks and gate them via the `/no-mistakes` command.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it depends on Git and AI agents (e.g., Claude, Codex), supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: Ranked #2 on GitHub Trending (Go) with 236 stars today and 8,208 total, it addresses a common pain point: automatically running AI-driven quality checks before pushing code to reduce sloppy PRs, gaining significant attention.
uses: Individual developers: automatically run AI review before pushing code to improve quality.
Teams: ensure clean PRs that pass all checks, reducing manual review burden.
AI agent users: let agents complete tasks and gate them while humans stay in control.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网工具
zh.what: Tailscale 是一个基于 WireGuard 的现代 VPN 服务，让用户能在任何地方安全地访问自己的设备。它简化了 WireGuard 的配置，并集成了双因素认证（2FA），提供最简便、最安全的组网方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tailscale 的大部分开源代码，包括核心守护进程 tailscaled 和命令行工具 tailscale。支持 Linux、Windows、macOS、FreeBSD 和 OpenBSD，并提供构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 WireGuard 协议。构建需要最新版 Go（目前为 1.27），并提供了 build_dist.sh 脚本用于打包发行。
zh.hot: Tailscale 因其易用性和安全性广受欢迎，star 数已达 35.7k，今日新增 44 个。它解决了 VPN 配置复杂的痛点，成为远程办公和自托管用户的首选。
uses: 远程办公人员：安全访问公司内网资源，无需复杂配置。
自托管爱好者：将家庭服务器、NAS 等设备组成私有网络，随时随地访问。
开发者：快速搭建跨地域的开发环境，或用于测试分布式应用。

en.tag: Zero-config secure networking built on WireGuard
en.what: Tailscale is a modern VPN service built on WireGuard, allowing users to securely access their devices from anywhere. It simplifies WireGuard configuration and integrates two-factor authentication (2FA), offering the easiest and most secure way to create private networks.
en.content: This repository contains the majority of Tailscale's open source code, including the core daemon tailscaled and the CLI tool tailscale. It supports Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and OpenBSD, and includes build scripts and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the WireGuard protocol. Building requires the latest Go release (currently 1.27), and a build_dist.sh script is provided for distribution packaging.
en.hot: Tailscale is popular for its ease of use and security, with 35.7k stars and 44 new today. It solves the pain point of complex VPN configuration, making it a top choice for remote work and self-hosted users.
uses: Remote workers: securely access corporate intranet resources without complex setup.
Self-hosters: connect home servers, NAS, and other devices into a private network accessible from anywhere.
Developers: quickly set up cross-region development environments or test distributed applications.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理会话搜索与分析工具
zh.what: AgentsView 是一个本地优先的工具，用于浏览、搜索和跟踪所有 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等 20 多种）的会话记录和成本。它无需账户，所有数据都存储在本地，提供 Web UI 和命令行接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的二进制文件，提供 serve、daemon、session、usage 等子命令，支持 SQLite 存储、S3 集成、Docker 部署，以及桌面应用（macOS/Windows）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 SQLite 数据库，支持 S3 兼容对象存储，提供 Docker 镜像和 Homebrew 安装方式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要统一管理多个代理的会话和成本，AgentsView 提供了本地优先的解决方案，因此在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 142 星。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，希望集中查看会话历史和 token 消耗。
需要监控 AI 编程成本并生成使用报告的个人或团队。
对数据隐私敏感，希望所有会话数据保留在本地的用户。
希望通过 S3 同步或 Docker 部署实现跨设备会话管理的用户。

en.tag: Local-first session search, analytics, and token usage stats for AI coding agents
en.what: AgentsView is a local-first tool for browsing, searching, and tracking sessions and costs across all your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and 20+ others). No accounts required; all data stays local, with a web UI and CLI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go binary with subcommands like serve, daemon, session, usage; supports SQLite storage, S3 integration, Docker deployment, and a desktop app (macOS/Windows).
en.stack: Primarily Go, with SQLite database, S3-compatible object storage support, Docker image, and Homebrew cask.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need a unified way to manage sessions and costs across multiple agents; AgentsView offers a local-first solution, gaining rapid traction with 142 stars today.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who want a unified view of session history and token usage.
Individuals or teams needing to monitor AI coding costs and generate usage reports.
Privacy-conscious users who want all session data to remain local.
Users who want cross-device session management via S3 sync or Docker deployment.

zh.tag: 为智能体系统打造的毫秒级模型路由，仅改端点即可降本40-70%
zh.what: workweave/router 是一个专为智能体系统设计的模型路由层。它能在 50 毫秒内将每个提示词路由到最合适的模型，用户只需更改 API 端点即可接入，无需改动现有代码。通过智能选择性价比最高的模型，它可帮助团队降低 40-70% 的模型调用成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心路由引擎，提供与 OpenAI 兼容的 API 接口，可无缝替换现有模型调用。项目包含配置示例、路由策略文档及性能基准测试，便于快速部署和调优。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库及少量第三方库，支持与主流 LLM API 集成。

uses: 使用多个 LLM API 的智能体应用，希望自动选择最优模型以降低成本。

对模型路由延迟敏感，要求毫秒级响应的高并发场景。

en.tag: Millisecond model router for agentic systems; cut costs 40-70% with just an endpoint change.
en.what: workweave/router is a model routing layer designed for agentic systems. It routes every prompt to the most suitable model in under 50ms, requiring only an endpoint change to integrate. By intelligently selecting the most cost-effective model, it helps teams cut model costs by 40-70%.
en.content: The repository contains a core routing engine written in Go, offering an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless replacement of existing model calls. It includes configuration examples, routing strategy documentation, and performance benchmarks for quick deployment and tuning.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the standard library and a few third-party libraries, with support for integration with major LLM APIs.
en.hot: Gained 693 stars today, reaching 2,443 total and ranking #3 on GitHub's Go trending list. Its direct solution to AI cost pain points, with minimal integration and significant cost reduction, quickly captured developers' attention.
uses: Agentic applications using multiple LLM APIs that want to automatically select the best model to reduce costs.
Teams needing to switch or optimize model calls without changing business code.
High-concurrency scenarios sensitive to routing latency, requiring millisecond-level responses.

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，支持多协议与多平台
zh.what: sing-box 是一个通用代理平台，提供高性能的网络代理功能，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、Trojan 等）和平台（包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 等）。它旨在为用户提供灵活、可配置的代理解决方案，适用于各种网络环境。

zh.hot: sing-box 因其强大的功能和灵活性在 GitHub 上获得 37k+ 星标，今日新增 30 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 19 名，持续受到网络代理用户的关注。

适用于开发者或系统管理员，用于搭建自定义代理服务器或集成到现有网络架构中。

en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform that provides high-performance network proxying capabilities, supporting multiple proxy protocols (such as Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan, etc.) and platforms (including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, etc.).
