Suitable for developers or system administrators to set up custom proxy servers or integrate into existing network infrastructure.
Great for users with high privacy and security requirements, encrypting traffic to protect data.

zh.tag: 无需控制面的点对点加密网络工具
zh.what: Tailcat 是 Tailscale 开源组件的重混，类似 netcat，但通过 Tailscale 数据面（magicsock）实现点对点 WireGuard 加密隧道，使用 DERP 作为 NAT 穿透辅助和中继。它不需要 Tailscale 账户或 root 权限，所有连接元数据通过带外方式交换。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 库（可导入为 github.com/tailscale/tailcat）和命令行工具 cmd/tailcat，以及一个实验性的 WebAssembly 浏览器演示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Tailscale 的 magicsock 数据面、WireGuard 加密、DERP 中继，支持 Nix flakes 安装。
zh.hot: 今日新增 965 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。它提供了一种无需 Tailscale 控制面的轻量级安全连接方式，吸引了开发者的关注。
uses: 需要临时在两台机器间安全传输数据或管道的开发者，无需配置复杂 VPN。
希望在没有 Tailscale 账户或 root 权限的情况下建立加密点对点连接的用户。
对 Tailscale 内部数据面机制感兴趣，想研究或复用其开源组件的技术人员。
需要快速暴露本地端口或进行端口转发的场景，但希望避免传统 netcat 的不安全性。

en.tag: P2P encrypted networking tool without control plane
en.what: Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane (magicsock) for point-to-point WireGuard-encrypted tunnels, with DERP as NAT-hole-punching side channel and relay. It requires no Tailscale account or root access, and all connection metadata is exchanged out of band.
en.content: The repo contains a Go library (importable as github.com/tailscale/tailcat) and a CLI tool cmd/tailcat, plus an experimental WebAssembly browser demo.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging Tailscale's magicsock data plane, WireGuard encryption, DERP relay, with Nix flakes support.
en.hot: Gained 965 stars today, ranking #11 on GitHub Trending. It offers a lightweight secure connection method without Tailscale's control plane, attracting developers.
uses: Developers needing secure data transfer or piping between two machines without complex VPN setup.
Users who want encrypted P2P connections without a Tailscale account or root access.
Tech enthusiasts interested in Tailscale's internal data plane mechanisms for research or reuse.
Scenarios requiring quick local port exposure or forwarding with better security than traditional netcat.

zh.tag: 自托管 Tailscale 控制服务器，构建私有网络
zh.what: Headscale 是 Tailscale 控制服务器的开源自托管实现，允许用户在自己的基础设施上管理 WireGuard 网络。它负责节点密钥交换、IP 分配和网络边界管理，提供类似 Tailscale 的 VPN 体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的控制服务器、命令行工具、配置文件示例、Nix 模块和文档。支持多种客户端操作系统，并提供稳定版和开发版文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 WireGuard 协议，支持 SQLite 或 PostgreSQL 存储，可通过容器或二进制部署。
zh.hot: 作为 Tailscale 控制服务器的开源替代，满足自托管和隐私需求，star 数达 43k，今日新增 43，持续受到关注。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的 VPN 网络，避免依赖第三方服务。
小型组织或实验室需要低成本、自托管的网络解决方案。
开发者希望深入理解 Tailscale 控制平面或进行二次开发。

en.tag: Self-hosted Tailscale control server for private networks
en.what: Headscale is an open-source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server, enabling users to manage WireGuard networks on their own infrastructure. It handles key exchange, IP assignment, and network boundaries, providing a Tailscale-like VPN experience.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based control server, CLI tools, configuration examples, Nix modules, and documentation. It supports various client OSes and offers stable and development docs.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging WireGuard protocol, with SQLite or PostgreSQL storage, deployable via containers or binaries.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Tailscale's control server, it addresses self-hosting and privacy needs, with 43k stars and 43 new today, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Individuals seeking full control over their VPN network without third-party dependence.
Small organizations or labs needing a low-cost, self-hosted networking solution.
Developers interested in understanding or extending the Tailscale control plane.

zh.tag: 基于 DNS 隧道的抗审查 VPN，低开销 ARQ 与负载均衡
zh.what: MasterDnsVPN 是一个科研导向的 DNS 隧道项目，通过 DNS 查询和响应承载 TCP 流量，实现绕过审查。它采用自定义协议和 ARQ 机制，优化了丢包稳定性和速度，比 DNSTT 和 SlipStream 更先进。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 实现，包括客户端、服务端、配置文件、多语言 README（英、法、俄、中、西、意）以及与其他项目的对比表。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，使用自定义协议和 ARQ（自动重传请求），支持 DNS 隧道和 VPN 模式，依赖 KCP/Noise 等（对比中提及）。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 上获得 6946 星，今日新增 6 星，位列 Go 日榜第 9。因其在抗审查领域的创新性和实用性，受到广泛关注。
uses: 网络受限地区的用户，用于绕过 DNS 污染和防火墙，安全访问互联网。
安全研究人员和开发者，学习 DNS 隧道技术及高级协议实现。
需要稳定连接的高丢包环境，如卫星或移动网络，利用 ARQ 优化。

en.tag: Advanced DNS tunneling VPN for censorship bypass with low-overhead ARQ and resolver load balancing
en.what: MasterDnsVPN is a research-oriented DNS tunneling project that carries TCP traffic through DNS queries and responses to bypass censorship. It uses a custom protocol with ARQ for low overhead, resolver load balancing, and high stability under packet loss, outperforming DNSTT and SlipStream.
en.content: The repository contains a full Go implementation with client, server, config files, multi-language READMEs (EN, FA, RU, ZH, ES, IT), and a comparison table with similar projects.
en.stack: Built with Go, featuring a custom protocol with ARQ, supporting DNS tunneling and VPN modes, with dependencies like KCP/Noise (mentioned in comparison).
en.hot: With 6946 stars and 6 new today, ranking #9 on Go daily trending, it gains attention for its innovative approach to censorship circumvention and practical utility.
uses: Users in restricted networks to bypass DNS pollution and firewalls for secure internet access.
Security researchers and developers studying DNS tunneling and advanced protocol implementations.
Environments with high packet loss like satellite or mobile networks, benefiting from ARQ optimization.

zh.tag: 终端文件管理器，颜值与功能兼备

Go developers interested in terminal UI design, who can learn from its implementation.

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。

en.tag: OSINT framework for phone number reconnaissance
en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. macOS or Linux users seeking a cross-platform solution.

zh.tag: Keenetic 路由器上的 AmneziaWG 隧道 Web 管理器
zh.what: AWG Manager 是一个为 Keenetic 路由器设计的开源 Web 界面，用于管理 AmneziaWG 和 Sing-box VPN 隧道。它允许用户通过浏览器添加、删除和监控 peer，创建服务器，并查看实时流量和速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端、Web 前端界面、安装脚本和文档。提供通过 Entware (OPKG) 的安装方式，支持稳定版和开发版。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Keenetic 的 Entware 环境，集成 AmneziaWG 和 Sing-box 协议，使用 busybox wget 或 curl 进行安装。
zh.hot: 随着 AmneziaWG 的流行，用户需要便捷的管理工具。该项目在 GitHub 上获得 566 星，今日新增 8 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 13 名，反映了社区对路由器 VPN 管理的需求。
uses: Keenetic 路由器用户希望使用 AmneziaWG 或 Sing-box 搭建 VPN 隧道。
需要图形化界面管理 VPN 配置，而不想使用命令行。
对自托管 VPN 感兴趣，并希望监控流量和速度。

en.tag: Web-based AmneziaWG tunnel manager for Keenetic routers
en.what: AWG Manager is an open-source web interface for managing AmneziaWG and Sing-box VPN tunnels on Keenetic routers. It allows users to add, remove, and monitor peers, create servers, and view real-time traffic and speed.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, web frontend, installation scripts, and documentation. It provides installation via Entware (OPKG) for stable and development versions.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on Keenetic's Entware environment, integrates AmneziaWG and Sing-box protocols, and uses busybox wget or curl for installation.
en.hot: With the rise of AmneziaWG, users need convenient management tools. The project has gained 566 stars, 8 new today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending for Go, reflecting community demand for router VPN management.
uses: Keenetic router users who want to set up AmneziaWG or Sing-box VPN tunnels.
Those who prefer a graphical interface over CLI for VPN management.
Self-hosting enthusiasts interested in monitoring traffic and speed.

zh.tag: 开源自托管邮件服务器与营销平台
zh.what: BillionMail 是一个开源的邮件服务器和邮件营销平台，支持自托管，提供新闻通讯和邮件营销功能。它让用户完全掌控邮件发送，包括高级分析和客户管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、Docker 配置、管理脚本（如 bm help、bm default）以及集成的 RoundCube WebMail。提供在线演示和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 部署，也提供 aaPanel 一键安装。依赖包括邮件服务器组件和 WebMail 集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 15.5k 星标和今日新增 9 星，BillionMail 因提供免费、自托管的邮件营销解决方案而受到关注，避免了月费和高成本。
uses: 适合希望自建邮件服务器并节省成本的中小企业或开发者。
用于发送新闻通讯、促销邮件和事务性邮件，并跟踪分析效果。
需要完全掌控邮件数据和发送流程的团队或个人。

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted mail server and email marketing platform
en.what: BillionMail is an open-source mail server and email marketing platform that supports self-hosting, offering newsletter and email marketing features. It gives users full control over email sending, including advanced analytics and customer management.
en.content: The repository includes installation scripts, Docker configuration, management scripts (like bm help, bm default), and integrated RoundCube WebMail. It offers a live demo and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports Docker deployment, and offers one-click installation via aaPanel. Dependencies include mail server components and WebMail integration.
en.hot: With 15.5k stars and 9 new stars today, BillionMail gains attention for offering a free, self-hosted email marketing solution, avoiding monthly fees and high costs.
uses: For SMBs or developers who want to self-host their mail server and save costs.
For sending newsletters, promotional emails, and transactional emails with tracking and analytics.
For teams or individuals needing full control over email data and sending processes.

zh.tag: 拦截AI爬虫的HTTP请求守卫
zh.what: Anubis 是一个用 Go 编写的反向代理，通过工作量证明（Proof-of-Work）挑战来验证 HTTP 请求是否来自真实用户，从而阻止 AI 爬虫和恶意机器人访问网站。它能够识别并过滤掉那些不遵守 robots.txt 的 AI 抓取工具，保护网站内容不被未经授权的抓取。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的代理服务器核心代码、Web 界面（用于展示挑战页面）、Docker 部署配置、文档和示例配置。项目结构清晰，包含 cmd、internal、web 等目录，并提供预构建的 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖标准库和少量第三方库（如 chi 路由器）。支持 Docker 部署，并集成 Prometheus 监控指标。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 爬虫日益泛滥，网站管理员急需有效的防护工具。Anubis 以 2.2 万星标和每日新增 100+ 的速度迅速走红，成为 GitHub Go 趋势榜常客，反映了社区对反爬虫解决方案的强烈需求。
uses: 网站管理员：保护个人博客或小型网站免受 AI 爬虫抓取内容
开发者：集成到现有服务中，作为反向代理层过滤恶意机器人
运维团队：通过 Docker 快速部署，为多个站点提供统一防护

en.tag: HTTP request guardian that blocks AI crawlers
en.what: Anubis is a Go-based reverse proxy that uses Proof-of-Work challenges to verify if HTTP requests come from real users, thereby blocking AI crawlers and malicious bots. It identifies and filters out AI scraping tools that ignore robots.txt, protecting website content from unauthorized scraping.
en.content: The repository contains the Go proxy server core code, a web interface for displaying challenge pages, Docker deployment configs, documentation, and example configurations. The project has a clear structure with cmd, internal, web directories, and provides pre-built Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using the standard library and a few third-party libraries (e.g., chi router). Supports Docker deployment and integrates Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: With the proliferation of AI crawlers, website administrators urgently need effective protection tools. Anubis has gained 22k stars and adds 100+ daily, becoming a regular on GitHub Go trending, reflecting the community's strong demand for anti-crawler solutions.
uses: Website admins: Protect personal blogs or small sites from AI crawlers scraping content
Developers: Integrate into existing services as a reverse proxy layer to filter malicious bots
Ops teams: Deploy quickly via Docker to provide unified protection for multiple sites

zh.tag: 超轻量 Go 个人 AI 助手，10 美元硬件即可运行
zh.what: PicoClaw 是一个用 Go 从零构建的超轻量个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 NanoBot，但完全独立开发。它能在 10 美元硬件、10MB 内存下运行，启动仅需毫秒级，旨在自动化琐碎任务并释放创造力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、文档（多语言 README）、logo 和演示 GIF，以及用于构建和部署的配置。项目采用自举方式开发，AI Agent 驱动了架构迁移和代码优化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 1.25+，支持 x86_64、ARM64、MIPS、RISC-V、LoongArch 等多种架构，依赖极简，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 以极低资源消耗（10MB 内存、10 美元硬件）实现 AI 助手，对比 OpenClaw 等节省 99% 内存，引发开发者关注；29.9k stars 显示其高人气。
uses: 嵌入式开发者和极客：在树莓派、RISC-V 板等低成本设备上部署个人 AI 助手
自动化爱好者：用 AI 自动化日常琐碎任务，如邮件处理、日程管理
Go 语言学习者：研究如何用 Go 构建轻量级 AI 应用和自举开发流程

en.tag: Ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant in Go, runs on $10 hardware
en.what: PicoClaw is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant built from scratch in Go, inspired by NanoBot but fully independent. It runs on $10 hardware with 10MB RAM and millisecond boot, aiming to automate mundane tasks and unleash creativity.
en.content: The repo contains full Go source code, multi-language README docs, logo and demo GIFs, plus build and deployment configs. It was developed via a self-bootstrapping process where the AI agent drove architecture migration and optimization.
en.stack: Built with Go 1.25+, supports x86_64, ARM64, MIPS, RISC-V, LoongArch; minimal dependencies, MIT license.
en.hot: Achieves an AI assistant with ultra-low resource usage (10MB RAM, $10 hardware), saving 99% memory vs OpenClaw, sparking developer interest; 29.9k stars show its popularity.
uses: Embedded devs and makers: deploy personal AI on low-cost devices like Raspberry Pi or RISC-V boards
Automation enthusiasts: use AI to automate mundane tasks like email and scheduling
Go learners: study building lightweight AI apps and self-bootstrapping dev process

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编程代理，现已迁移至 Crush
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个基于 Go 的终端 AI 助手，提供 TUI 界面，支持多种 AI 模型，帮助开发者完成编码、调试等任务。项目已归档，后续开发转移到 Crush。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、TUI 界面、会话管理、工具集成、SQLite 存储、LSP 支持等。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言，基于 Bubble Tea 构建 TUI，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等多家 AI 提供商，使用 SQLite 存储。
zh.hot: 尽管已归档，但凭借强大的终端 AI 编程体验，仍积累了 13.7k stars，今日新增 7 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 17。
uses: 开发者希望在终端内获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
喜欢 TUI 和命令行工具的用户，追求高效工作流
关注 AI 编程代理发展，想了解 OpenCode 后续 Crush 项目的用户

en.tag: Terminal-based AI coding agent, now moved to Crush
en.what: OpenCode is a Go-based terminal AI assistant with a TUI, supporting multiple AI models for coding and debugging. The project is archived, with development continuing as Crush.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, TUI, session management, tool integration, SQLite storage, and LSP support.
en.stack: Built with Go, using Bubble Tea for TUI, supporting multiple AI providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and using SQLite for storage.
en.hot: Despite being archived, it has amassed 13.7k stars due to its powerful terminal AI coding experience, with 7 new stars today, ranking #17 on Go trending.
uses: Developers seeking AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Users who prefer TUI and command-line tools for efficient workflows
Those interested in AI coding agents and the evolution of OpenCode into Crush

zh.tag: 把 iPhone 的 Continuity 功能桥接到 Linux 桌面
zh.what: Tether 是一个开源项目，旨在让 Linux 用户使用 iPhone 的 Continuity 功能，如剪贴板同步、文件传输、短信/iMessage 收发和通知镜像。它通过 iOS 应用、浏览器扩展和邮件扩展实现跨设备集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的核心服务、iOS 应用（App Store 可下载）、Firefox/Thunderbird 扩展以及安装脚本，支持 Arch、Fedora、Debian 和 Ubuntu。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Wayland 和 TLS 1.2 加密通信，支持 WiFi 和蓝牙两种连接方式。
zh.hot: 今日新增 180 星，总星数 1077，登顶 C++ 趋势榜，因为填补了 Linux 用户使用 iPhone 的生态空白，功能实用且持续更新。
uses: 从 macOS 迁移到 Linux 但仍使用 iPhone 的用户，希望保留生态联动功能。
Linux 桌面用户需要跨设备剪贴板同步、文件传输和短信回复的便捷体验。
开发者或技术爱好者对 Apple Continuity 逆向工程和开源实现感兴趣。

en.tag: Bridge Apple Continuity features to Linux desktop
en.what: Tether is an open-source project that brings Apple Continuity features to Linux users, including clipboard sync, file transfer, SMS/iMessage messaging, and notification mirroring. It uses an iOS app, browser extension, and mail extension for cross-device integration.
en.content: The repository contains a C++ core service, an iOS app (available on the App Store), Firefox/Thunderbird extensions, and installation scripts for Arch, Fedora, Debian, and Ubuntu.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on Wayland and TLS 1.2 encryption, supports WiFi and Bluetooth connections.
en.hot: Gained 180 stars today, total 1077, topping the C++ trending list, as it fills the gap for Linux users with iPhones, offering practical features and active development.
uses: Users who migrated from macOS to Linux but still use an iPhone, wanting ecosystem integration.
Linux desktop users needing seamless clipboard sync, file transfer, and SMS replies across devices.
Developers or tech enthusiasts interested in reverse engineering and open-source implementation of Apple Continuity.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 翻译层，让 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上流畅运行
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 翻译层，允许使用 Wine 在 Linux 上运行 3D 应用程序。它将 Direct3D API 调用转换为 Vulkan，从而提供更好的性能和兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DXVK 的源代码、构建脚本和文档。主要组件是 DLL 文件（d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll），用户将其复制到 Wine 前缀中并配置 DLL 覆盖即可使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境。构建系统采用 Meson，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: DXVK 是 Linux 游戏生态的关键组件，被 Steam Play、Lutris 等工具广泛使用。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 17972 个 star 反映了其在 Linux 玩家中的高认可度。
uses: Linux 玩家希望通过 Wine 运行 Windows 游戏，获得更好的性能和兼容性。
游戏开发者或测试人员需要在 Linux 上测试 Direct3D 游戏。
使用 Steam Play、Lutris、Bottles 等工具的用户，这些工具自动集成 DXVK。

en.tag: Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D, enabling Windows games on Linux
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11, allowing 3D applications to run on Linux via Wine. It translates Direct3D API calls to Vulkan, offering better performance and compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts, and documentation for DXVK. The main components are DLL files (d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll) that users copy into a Wine prefix and configure DLL overrides.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Vulkan API and Wine environment. Build system uses Meson, supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: DXVK is a key component in the Linux gaming ecosystem, widely used by Steam Play, Lutris, and other tools. Despite modest daily star growth, its 17,972 stars reflect high recognition among Linux gamers.
uses: Linux gamers who want to run Windows games via Wine with better performance and compatibility.
Game developers or testers who need to test Direct3D games on Linux.
Users of Steam Play, Lutris, Bottles, etc., which integrate DXVK automatically.

zh.tag: 快速本地神经文本转语音引擎
zh.what: Piper 是一个快速、本地运行的神经文本转语音（TTS）引擎，利用 espeak-ng 进行音素化处理。它支持多种语言和声音，提供命令行、Web 服务器、Python API 和 C/C++ API 等多种接口，并允许用户训练自定义声音。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Piper 的完整源代码、文档（CLI、API、训练指南等）、预训练声音列表以及示例音频和演示。项目结构包括核心引擎、libpiper 库、Python 绑定和训练脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 espeak-ng 进行音素化，支持 Python 绑定（通过 pip 安装）。还提供 Java JNI 绑定，并集成到 Home Assistant、NVDA 等项目中。
zh.hot: Piper 因其快速、本地运行、隐私友好的特性而广受欢迎，尤其在智能家居和辅助技术领域。当前在 GitHub Trending 上排名 C++ 第 4，今日新增 45 星，总星数达 5405，反映了持续增长的社区关注。
uses: 智能家居系统（如 Home Assistant）的语音助手和通知播报
辅助技术（如 NVDA 屏幕阅读器）的语音输出
开发本地 TTS 应用的开发者，需要离线、低延迟的语音合成
研究人员和爱好者，用于训练自定义声音或探索 TTS 技术

en.tag: Fast local neural text-to-speech engine
en.what: Piper is a fast, local neural text-to-speech (TTS) engine that uses espeak-ng for phonemization. It supports multiple languages and voices, offering CLI, web server, Python API, and C/C++ API interfaces, and allows training custom voices.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation (CLI, API, training guides, etc.), pre-trained voice lists, and sample audio and demos. The project structure includes the core engine, libpiper library, Python bindings, and training scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on espeak-ng for phonemization, and supports Python bindings (installable via pip). It also offers Java JNI bindings and is integrated into projects like Home Assistant and NVDA.
en.hot: Piper is popular for its speed, local operation, and privacy-friendly nature, especially in smart home and assistive technology. It ranks #4 in C++ on GitHub Trending today with 45 new stars, reaching 5405 total, reflecting growing community interest.
uses: Voice assistants and notification announcements in smart home systems like Home Assistant
Speech output for assistive technologies such as NVDA screen reader
Developers building local TTS applications needing offline, low-latency synthesis
Researchers and hobbyists training custom voices or exploring TTS technology

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 单文件分发运行大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: llamafile 将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，把大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，用户无需安装即可在多数操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，实现单文件的语音转文字功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源码、构建系统、文档以及预构建的 llamafile 可执行文件示例。它基于 llama.cpp 和 whisper.cpp，并支持多种模型格式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Cosmopolitan Libc 实现跨平台可执行性，并集成 llama.cpp 和 whisper.cpp。
zh.hot: 凭借单文件运行大模型的极简体验，llamafile 获得近 2.6 万星标，今日新增 48，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 8，深受开发者喜爱。
uses: 开发者：快速分发和测试 LLM 应用，无需配置复杂环境。
终端用户：在个人电脑上轻松运行聊天或语音转文字模型。
教育场景：演示 LLM 能力，降低学习门槛。

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs as a single cross-platform executable
en.what: llamafile combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package LLMs into a single executable that runs locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool.
en.content: The repo contains source code, build system, docs, and pre-built llamafile executables. It's based on llama.cpp and whisper.cpp, supporting multiple model formats.
en.stack: Primarily C++, leveraging Cosmopolitan Libc for cross-platform executables, integrating llama.cpp and whisper.cpp.
en.hot: With its minimalist single-file LLM execution, llamafile has gained ~26k stars, +48 today, ranking #8 on C++ trending, beloved by developers.
uses: Developers: quickly distribute and test LLM apps without complex setup.
End users: easily run chat or speech-to-text models on personal computers.
Educational: demonstrate LLM capabilities with low barrier to entry.

zh.tag: 跨平台 PSP 模拟器，C++ 编写，支持多平台
zh.what: PPSSPP 是一款快速且可移植的 PSP 模拟器，无需 BIOS 文件即可运行游戏。它采用 HLE 模拟方式，默认设置兼顾兼容性与速度，支持多平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，包括核心模拟逻辑、图形渲染器、UI 界面、Ad-hoc 多人联机功能以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖图形 API（如 OpenGL、Vulkan）、音频库等，支持多平台构建。
zh.hot: 作为长期维护的知名 PSP 模拟器，拥有 14k+ 星标，近期更新频繁，新增多人联机与纹理放大等特性，吸引大量玩家和开发者关注。
uses: PSP 游戏玩家：在手机或电脑上重温 PSP 经典游戏，无需实体主机。
模拟器开发者：研究 HLE 模拟、图形渲染和跨平台移植的参考实现。
游戏测试人员：利用社区兼容性反馈报告，协助测试和报告游戏问题。

en.tag: Cross-platform PSP emulator written in C++ for Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS
en.what: PPSSPP is a fast and portable PSP emulator that runs games without requiring a BIOS file. It uses HLE emulation, with default settings balancing compatibility and speed, and supports multiple platforms.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, including core emulation logic, graphics renderers, UI, ad-hoc multiplayer, documentation, and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan) and audio libraries, with multi-platform build support.
en.hot: As a long-maintained and well-known PSP emulator with 14k+ stars, it has frequent updates, adding multiplayer and texture upscaling features, attracting many players and developers.
uses: PSP gamers: Relive classic PSP games on mobile or PC without the original console.
Emulator developers: Reference implementation for HLE emulation, graphics rendering, and cross-platform porting.
Game testers: Use community compatibility reports to help test and report game issues.

zh.tag: 实验性 PS Vita 模拟器，跨平台运行
zh.what: Vita3K 是一个实验性的 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，支持在 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android 上运行。目前可以运行大部分自制软件和商业游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的源代码、构建脚本、文档和截图，以及兼容性列表的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Unicorn 等外部库，采用 GPLv2 许可证。
zh.hot: 作为少数可用的 PS Vita 模拟器，持续吸引玩家关注，今日新增 2 星，总星数达 5677，位列 C++ 日榜第 8。
uses: 想在 PC 或手机上体验 PS Vita 游戏的玩家
对模拟器开发感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构
需要测试自制软件或游戏的开发人员

en.tag: Experimental PS Vita emulator for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android
en.what: Vita3K is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator that runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android. It can currently run most homebrew programs and commercial games.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator's source code, build scripts, documentation, screenshots, and links to compatibility lists.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on external libraries like Unicorn, and is licensed under GPLv2.
en.hot: As one of the few PS Vita emulators, it continues to attract gamers, gaining 2 stars today to reach 5677 total, ranking 8th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Gamers who want to experience PS Vita games on PC or mobile
Developers interested in emulator development to learn its architecture
Developers who need to test homebrew software or games

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流主机，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务器，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将游戏从自己的电脑远程串流到其他设备，无需依赖第三方云服务。支持低延迟、高画质的游戏体验，并可通过 Web 界面进行配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Sunshine 源代码、构建脚本、Docker 镜像配置、文档以及用于 Web UI 的前端资源。项目采用 C++ 编写，并附带多种安装方式（如 Docker、Flatpak、Winget）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA/NVENC、AMF 等硬件编码库，以及 WebSocket 和 HTTP 服务器库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 随着云游戏和远程办公需求增长，自托管串流方案备受青睐。Sunshine 拥有 4 万+ Star，本周新增 265，持续活跃，社区生态完善。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到客厅电视、手机或平板，享受低延迟体验。
远程工作者：通过 Moonlight 客户端远程访问工作站，进行图形密集型任务。
自托管爱好者：搭建完全自主可控的串流服务器，摆脱商业云服务限制。

en.tag: Self-hosted game stream host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It lets users stream games from their own PC to other devices remotely without relying on third-party cloud services. It offers low-latency, high-quality gameplay and can be configured via a web interface.
en.content: The repository contains the full Sunshine source code, build scripts, Docker image configurations, documentation, and frontend assets for the web UI. The project is written in C++ and offers multiple installation methods (e.g., Docker, Flatpak, Winget).
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on FFmpeg, CUDA/NVENC, AMF for hardware encoding, and WebSocket/HTTP server libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: With the rise of cloud gaming and remote work, self-hosted streaming solutions are in demand. Sunshine has 40k+ stars, adding 265 this week, and remains highly active with a mature community.
uses: Gamers: Stream PC games to living room TVs, phones, or tablets with low latency.
Remote workers: Access workstations remotely via Moonlight client for graphics-intensive tasks.
Self-hosting enthusiasts: Build a fully controlled streaming server, free from commercial cloud constraints.

zh.tag: 基于 Lua 的快速、可嵌入、渐进类型脚本语言
zh.what: Luau 是一种基于 Lua 5.1 的快速、小巧、安全的可嵌入脚本语言，由 Roblox 开发并开源。它增加了类型注解和先进类型推断系统，同时保持与 Lua 5.1 的向后兼容性，并融入了未来 Lua 版本的一些特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含语言运行时（基于 Lua 5.1 运行时的大量修改）、完全重写的解释器、命令行工具（luau REPL 和 luau-analyze 类型检查器/静态分析器），以及相关工具链。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，依赖 Lua 5.1 运行时，并包含用于构建和测试的 CMake 和 GitHub Actions 工作流。
zh.hot: Luau 被 Roblox 广泛使用，并已被 Alan Wake 2、Farming Simulator 2025 等知名游戏采用，尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 5821 星显示了其持续关注度。
uses: 游戏开发者：在 Roblox 或支持 Luau 的引擎中编写游戏逻辑，利用类型检查提升代码质量。
嵌入式系统开发者：将 Luau 作为可嵌入脚本语言，为应用提供快速、安全的脚本扩展能力。
工具链开发者：使用 luau-analyze 进行静态分析，或基于 Luau 构建语言服务器（如 luau-lsp）。

en.tag: A fast, embeddable, gradually typed scripting language derived from Lua
en.what: Luau is a fast, small, safe, and embeddable scripting language derived from Lua 5.1, developed by Roblox and open-sourced. It adds type annotations and a state-of-the-art type inference system while maintaining backward compatibility with Lua 5.1 and incorporating features from future Lua releases.
en.content: The repository hosts the language runtime (a heavily modified Lua 5.1 runtime), a completely rewritten interpreter, command-line tools (luau REPL and luau-analyze type checker/linter), and associated tooling.
en.stack: Implemented primarily in C++, building on the Lua 5.1 runtime, with CMake for build and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Luau is widely used by Roblox and has been adopted by notable games like Alan Wake 2 and Farming Simulator 2025; despite modest daily stars, its 5821 total stars reflect sustained interest.
uses: Game developers: write game logic in Roblox or other engines supporting Luau, leveraging type checking for code quality.
Embedded systems developers: embed Luau as a scripting language to add fast, safe scripting capabilities to applications.
Tooling developers: use luau-analyze for static analysis or build language servers on top of Luau (e.g., luau-lsp).

zh.tag: 全球首个免费开源的 PS3 模拟器与调试器
zh.what: RPCS3 是一个用 C++ 编写的 PlayStation 3 模拟器和调试器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它允许用户在 PC 上运行 PS3 游戏，并提供调试功能，帮助开发者分析和改进游戏兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建脚本、文档（如 BUILDING.md）、以及用于游戏兼容性报告的 Wiki 和论坛链接。项目还设有 Discord 服务器和 Patreon 赞助渠道，支持社区贡献和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 进行 GUI，支持跨平台构建（Windows/Linux/macOS/FreeBSD）。项目使用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成，并依赖 Vulkan 等图形 API 实现 GPU 模拟。
zh.hot: 作为 PS3 模拟器的先驱，RPCS3 持续吸引大量关注，拥有近 2 万星标。近期因 AI 贡献政策调整和社区活跃度提升，再次登上趋势榜，成为 C++ 项目中的热门。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 上体验 PS3 独占游戏，无需购买主机。
开发者：研究 PS3 硬件架构和游戏逆向工程，参与模拟器开发。
测试人员：通过测试游戏并提交 bug 报告，帮助提升兼容性。

en.tag: World's first free and open-source PS3 emulator and debugger
en.what: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It allows users to run PS3 games on PC and provides debugging features to help developers analyze and improve game compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation (e.g., BUILDING.md), and links to the Wiki and forums for game compatibility reports. It also has a Discord server and Patreon sponsorship channel, supporting community contributions and testing.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, using Qt for the GUI, with cross-platform builds for Windows/Linux/macOS/FreeBSD. The project uses GitHub Actions for CI and relies on graphics APIs like Vulkan for GPU emulation.
en.hot: As a pioneer in PS3 emulation, RPCS3 consistently attracts attention with nearly 20k stars. Recently, due to AI contribution policy updates and increased community activity, it has re-entered the trending list, becoming a hot C++ project.
uses: Gamers: Experience PS3 exclusive titles on PC without owning a console.
Developers: Research PS3 hardware architecture and game reverse engineering, contribute to emulator development.
Testers: Help improve compatibility by testing games and submitting bug reports.

zh.tag: 免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器
zh.what: PCSX2 是一个免费开源的 PS2 模拟器，通过模拟 PS2 硬件，让玩家在 PC 上运行 PS2 游戏。它结合了 MIPS CPU 解释器、动态重编译器和虚拟机来管理硬件状态和系统内存。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建配置（支持 Windows/Linux/Mac）、文档、兼容性列表链接，以及用于翻译的 Crowdin 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用 wxWidgets 或 Qt 等 GUI 框架（具体取决于版本）。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 20 年历史，兼容性列表已测试 2500+ 游戏，近期在 GitHub Trending 上热度上升，日增 10 星。
uses: 怀旧玩家：在 PC 上重温 PS2 经典游戏，如《最终幻想 X》和《鬼泣 3》。
游戏开发者：测试游戏兼容性或研究主机模拟技术。
技术爱好者：学习模拟器开发、MIPS 架构和动态重编译。

en.tag: Free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator
en.what: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PS2 emulator that emulates PS2 hardware to let you play PS2 games on your PC. It uses a combination of MIPS CPU interpreters, recompilers, and a virtual machine to manage hardware states and system memory.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build configurations for Windows/Linux/Mac, documentation, compatibility list links, and Crowdin integration for translations.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses CMake build system, and relies on GUI frameworks like wxWidgets or Qt depending on the version.
en.hot: With over 20 years of development and 2500+ tested games, it's gaining traction on GitHub Trending with 10 stars added today.
uses: Retro gamers: replay classic PS2 titles like Final Fantasy X and Devil May Cry 3 on PC.
Game developers: test game compatibility or study console emulation techniques.
Tech enthusiasts: learn about emulator development, MIPS architecture, and dynamic recompilation.

zh.tag: 跨GPU统一超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个工具，允许你在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分器，并管理帧生成（包括通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用）。它提供广泛的定制选项，适用于包括 Nvidia DLSS 用户在内的所有玩家。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、预编译的稳定版和夜间版发布、详细的 Wiki 文档、Discord 社区链接以及赞助渠道。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 GPU 厂商的 SDK（如 DLSS、FSR、XeSS）以及 DirectX 12 等图形 API。
zh.hot: 本周新增 151 星，总星数突破 1 万，位列 C++ 周榜第 15。它解决了跨 GPU 使用超分和帧生成的痛点，受到游戏玩家和 mod 社区欢迎。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 超分或帧生成，提升游戏画质和流畅度。
Mod 开发者：利用其 API 和文档集成自定义超分或帧生成方案。
技术爱好者：探索不同超分和帧生成技术的兼容性与性能表现。

en.tag: Bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs, replacing native upscalers
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation (including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG). It offers extensive customization for all users, including Nvidia DLSS users.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, precompiled stable and nightly releases, detailed Wiki documentation, Discord community links, and sponsorship channels.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging GPU vendor SDKs (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) and graphics APIs like DirectX 12.
en.hot: Gained 151 stars this week, surpassing 10k total, ranking #15 on C++ weekly. It solves cross-GPU upscaling/frame gen pain points, popular among gamers and modders.
uses: Gamers: Use DLSS upscaling or frame gen on non-Nvidia GPUs to enhance visuals and smoothness.
Mod developers: Integrate custom upscaling or frame gen solutions via its API and docs.
Tech enthusiasts: Explore compatibility and performance of various upscaling/frame gen technologies.

zh.tag: 免费开源的跨平台DJ混音软件
zh.what: Mixxx 是一款免费开源的 DJ 混音软件，提供现场混音所需的一切功能。它支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS 系统，适合专业和业余 DJ 使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mixxx 的完整源代码、构建说明、贡献指南、文档链接以及社区资源。代码主要用 C++ 编写，并包含多种语言的翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 框架，支持跨平台构建。项目使用 CMake 构建系统，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: Mixxx 拥有 7104 颗星，今日新增 11 颗，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 C++ 第 14 名。作为免费开源的 DJ 软件，它吸引了大量 DJ 和开发者，社区活跃。
uses: 现场 DJ 混音表演，提供专业级功能，如节拍匹配、循环和效果器。
学习和练习 DJ 技巧，无需购买昂贵的硬件或软件。
开发者和贡献者参与开源项目，改进功能或修复 bug。
音乐爱好者进行音乐混音创作，支持多种音频格式和硬件控制器。

en.tag: Free, open-source, cross-platform DJ mixing software
en.what: Mixxx is a free and open-source DJ mixing software that provides everything needed for live mixes. It runs on GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS, suitable for both professional and hobbyist DJs.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Mixxx, build instructions, contribution guidelines, documentation links, and community resources. The code is primarily written in C++ and includes translation files for multiple languages.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on the Qt framework for cross-platform support. The project uses CMake as its build system and integrates GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: With 7,104 stars and 11 new stars today, Mixxx ranks 14th on GitHub Trending for C++. As a free and open-source DJ software, it attracts many DJs and developers, fostering an active community.
uses: Live DJ mixing performances with professional features like beat matching, looping, and effects.
Learning and practicing DJ skills without purchasing expensive hardware or software.
Developers and contributors participating in an open-source project to improve features or fix bugs.
Music enthusiasts creating mixes with support for various audio formats and hardware controllers.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 基于GZDoom的现代DOOM引擎增强移植版
zh.what: UZDoom 是一款基于 GZDoom 的现代 DOOM 引擎增强移植版，为经典 DOOM 游戏提供高清画质、动态光照、3D 地板等高级特性，并支持强大的脚本和模组功能。它是 ZDoom 和 GZDoom 的延续，由社区维护，免费开源。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源代码、构建脚本、品牌资源（如 SVG 图标和横幅）、翻译文件（通过 Weblate 管理）以及详细的文档和 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖现代 OpenGL 和 Vulkan 渲染器，支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 凭借对经典 DOOM 的现代化改造和强大的模组支持，UZDoom 在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 12 颗星，总星数达 2163，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 16 名。
uses: DOOM 玩家：想要以高清画质和现代特性重温经典游戏的玩家。
模组开发者：需要强大脚本和渲染能力来创作自定义内容的模组制作者。
开源爱好者：对游戏引擎开发和社区协作感兴趣的技术人员。

en.tag: A modern feature-centric DOOM engine source port based on GZDoom
en.what: UZDoom is a modern, feature-rich source port for the classic game DOOM, based on GZDoom. It enhances the original engine with high-resolution graphics, dynamic lighting, 3D floors, and extensive modding support, along with powerful scripting capabilities. It continues the legacy of ZDoom and GZDoom, built by a dedicated community.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, build scripts, branding assets (like SVG logos and banners), translation files (managed via Weblate), and links to documentation and wiki.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging modern OpenGL and Vulkan renderers, with support for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
en.hot: With its modernized take on classic DOOM and robust modding support, UZDoom has quickly gained traction on GitHub, adding 12 stars today and reaching 2163 total, ranking #16 on the C++ trending list.
uses: DOOM players: Those who want to revisit the classic game with high-resolution graphics and modern features.
Mod developers: Creators who need powerful scripting and rendering capabilities for custom content.
Open-source enthusiasts: Technically minded people interested in game engine development and community collaboration.

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，头文件或编译版可选
zh.what: spdlog 是一个极快的 C++ 日志库，支持格式化、异步模式、多种输出目标（控制台、文件、syslog 等）。它易于使用和扩展，性能卓越。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件库（include/spdlog）、示例（example）、CMake 构建配置和基准测试。支持多种平台和包管理器安装。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11，依赖 fmt 库进行格式化。支持 CMake 构建，可选编译模式。

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方大规模 Transformer 训练库，支持多种并行策略与混合精度
zh.what: Megatron-LM 是 NVIDIA 开源的用于大规模训练 Transformer 模型的 GPU 优化库，包含 Megatron-LM 参考示例和 Megatron Core 可组合库。它提供张量并行、流水线并行、数据并行、专家并行和上下文并行等高级并行策略，并支持 FP16、BF16、FP8 和 FP4 混合精度训练。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Megatron-LM（参考实现，含预配置训练脚本）和 Megatron Core（可组合库，提供 Transformer 构建模块、并行策略、混合精度支持和模型架构）。还提供 Megatron Bridge 用于 Hugging Face 与 Megatron 之间的检查点转换。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，基于 PyTorch 和 NVIDIA CUDA 生态，支持分布式训练框架（如 NCCL）。可通过 PyPI 安装，或从源码构建（需注意内存限制）。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方的大规模训练库，本周新增 155 星，总星数 17675，持续受到 AI 研究和工程社区关注。近期支持 DeepSeek-V4 等前沿模型，进一步推动热度。
uses: 研究团队：用于大规模 Transformer 模型的预训练和实验，快速验证新架构。
机器学习工程师：构建自定义训练流程，利用高级并行策略和混合精度优化性能。
框架开发者：基于 Megatron Core 的可组合模块，开发定制化训练框架。
学习分布式训练：通过参考示例和文档，理解大规模模型训练的并行技术。

en.tag: NVIDIA's GPU-optimized library for training transformer models at scale with advanced parallelism
en.what: Megatron-LM is NVIDIA's open-source GPU-optimized library for training transformer models at scale, comprising Megatron-LM reference examples and Megatron Core composable library. It offers advanced parallelism strategies (TP, PP, DP, EP, CP) and mixed precision support (FP16, BF16, FP8, FP4).
en.content: The repository contains Megatron-LM (reference implementation with pre-configured training scripts) and Megatron Core (composable library with transformer building blocks, parallelism strategies, mixed precision support, and model architectures). Megatron Bridge provides checkpoint conversion between Hugging Face and Megatron.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on PyTorch and NVIDIA CUDA ecosystem, supporting distributed training frameworks like NCCL. Installable via PyPI or from source (mind memory limits).
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official large-scale training library, it gained 155 stars this week (total 17,675), consistently popular in AI research and engineering. Recent support for DeepSeek-V4 and other frontier models boosts its appeal.
uses: Research teams: for pretraining and experimenting with large-scale transformer models, quickly validating new architectures.
ML engineers: building custom training pipelines, leveraging advanced parallelism and mixed precision for performance.
Framework developers: using Megatron Core's composable modules to develop customized training frameworks.
Learners of distributed training: understanding parallel techniques via reference examples and documentation.

zh.tag: Claude Skills 精选清单，赋能 AI 工作流定制
zh.what: 这是一个精选的 Claude Skills 资源列表，包含 1000+ 生产级实用的技能和插件，用于增强 Claude.ai、Claude Code 以及 Codex、Cursor 等编码代理的生产力。它帮助用户发现和集成各种技能，让 AI 代理执行真实世界的操作，如发送邮件、创建问题、发布到 Slack 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能分类目录（如文档处理）、快速入门指南、插件安装说明，以及 Composio MCP 网关的推广内容。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，依赖 Claude 生态和 Composio 平台，支持 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 拥有 74k+ 星标，周增 1039，因其全面收录 Claude Skills 并集成真实应用操作，成为 AI 工作流定制的一站式资源。
uses: 开发者快速查找并集成 Claude Skills 到自己的 AI 工作流中
团队利用 MCP 网关安全连接 1000+ 应用，提升自动化效率
AI 爱好者探索 Claude 生态，学习如何定制 AI 代理行为

en.tag: Curated list of Claude Skills for customizing AI workflows
en.what: A curated list of 1000+ production-ready Claude Skills and plugins to boost productivity across Claude.ai, Claude Code, and coding agents like Codex and Cursor. It helps users discover and integrate skills that enable AI agents to perform real-world actions like sending emails, creating issues, and posting to Slack.
en.content: The repo includes categorized skill lists (e.g., document processing), quickstart guides, plugin installation instructions, and promotional content for Composio's MCP Gateway.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging the Claude ecosystem and Composio platform, with MCP protocol support.
en.hot: With 74k+ stars and 1,039 weekly additions, it's a one-stop resource for Claude Skills with real-world app integrations, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers quickly find and integrate Claude Skills into their AI workflows
Teams use the MCP Gateway to securely connect 1000+ apps, boosting automation efficiency
AI enthusiasts explore the Claude ecosystem and learn to customize AI agent behaviors

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 实时语音与多模态 AI 代理的开源框架
zh.what: Pipecat 是一个用于构建实时语音和多模态对话代理的 Python 框架。它支持构建单个语音代理或完整的多代理系统，其中专业代理可以交接、并行扩展，并通过共享总线进行协调，支持本地或跨进程/机器分布式部署。它简化了音频/视频、AI 服务、传输和对话管道的编排，让开发者专注于代理的独特功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、客户端 SDK（JavaScript、React、React Native、Swift、Kotlin、C++）、文档、示例和快速入门指南。框架提供可插拔的 AI 服务集成、可组合的管道组件，以及支持 WebSockets 和 WebRTC 等实时传输。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种 AI 服务（如语音识别、文本转语音）和传输协议（WebSockets、WebRTC）。支持与多种 AI 服务和工具集成，并提供了多语言客户端 SDK。
zh.hot: Pipecat 在 GitHub 上获得了 14952 颗星，本周新增 491 颗，位列 Python 周榜第 13 名。其热度源于对实时语音和多模态 AI 代理的专注，提供了可组合的管道和多代理支持，满足了开发者对低延迟、可扩展对话系统的需求。
uses: 构建语音助手、AI 伴侣、会议助手等实时对话应用
开发多代理系统，实现专业代理间的交接、并行扩展和协调
创建多模态交互界面，集成语音、视频、图像等多种输入输出
用于客户服务、支持机器人、引导式流程等业务场景

en.tag: Open-source framework for real-time voice & multimodal AI agents
en.what: Pipecat is a Python framework for building real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents. It enables building single voice agents or full multi-agent systems where specialists hand off, fan out in parallel, and coordinate over a shared bus, locally or distributed across processes and machines. It streamlines orchestration of audio/video, AI services, transports, and conversation pipelines, letting developers focus on what makes their agents unique.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, client SDKs (JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, C++), documentation, examples, and a quickstart guide. The framework offers pluggable AI service integrations, composable pipeline components, and real-time transports like WebSockets and WebRTC.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python, it integrates with various AI services (e.g., speech recognition, text-to-speech) and transport protocols (WebSockets, WebRTC). It supports integration with many AI services and tools, and offers client SDKs in multiple languages.
en.hot: Pipecat has 14,952 stars with 491 added this week, ranking #13 on the Python weekly trending list. Its popularity stems from its focus on real-time voice and multimodal AI agents, offering composable pipelines and multi-agent support that meet developers' needs for low-latency, scalable conversational systems.
uses: Build real-time conversational apps like voice assistants, AI companions, and meeting assistants
Develop multi-agent systems with handoff, parallel fan-out, and coordination among specialist agents
Create multimodal interfaces integrating voice, video, images, and more
Apply to business scenarios such as customer intake, support bots, and guided flows

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 高质量 TypeScript 类型定义仓库
zh.what: DefinitelyTyped 是 TypeScript 社区维护的高质量类型定义仓库，为没有自带类型的 npm 包提供 .d.ts 文件。它通过社区贡献和严格审查，确保类型定义的准确性和可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个包的 @types 定义，采用 pnpm monorepo 结构，每个包独立管理，并有完善的贡献指南和自动化检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，dtslint 进行类型检查和 lint，GitHub Actions 用于 CI。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基础设施，star 数高达 51k，虽今日新增不多，但持续被开发者依赖和贡献。
uses: TypeScript 开发者：为缺少类型的 npm 包安装 @types 定义，提升开发体验。
库作者：通过贡献类型定义，让更多用户受益，同时提升自身库的可用性。
维护者/贡献者：参与社区审查，确保类型定义质量，积累开源经验。

en.tag: High-quality TypeScript type definitions repository
en.what: DefinitelyTyped is a community-maintained repository providing high-quality TypeScript type definitions (.d.ts files) for npm packages that lack built-in types. It relies on community contributions and rigorous review to ensure accuracy and usability.
en.content: The repo contains thousands of @types definitions for various packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo with independent package management, comprehensive contribution guidelines, and automated checks.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript, uses pnpm for dependency management, dtslint for type-checking and linting, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As a foundational piece of the TypeScript ecosystem, it has 51k stars; despite modest daily growth, it remains heavily relied upon and contributed to by developers.
uses: TypeScript developers: install @types definitions for packages lacking types to improve DX.
Library authors: contribute type definitions to benefit users and enhance library usability.
Maintainers/contributors: participate in community review to ensure quality and gain OSS experience.

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 面向开发者的 Markdown 演示文稿工具
zh.what: Slidev 是一个专为开发者设计的演示文稿工具，允许用户使用 Markdown 编写幻灯片，并支持代码高亮、实时编码、主题定制和交互组件。它旨在将开发者的工作流（如代码编辑器和版本控制）与演示文稿创建无缝集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CLI、Vue 组件、主题系统、文档和示例，以及用于导出、录制和编辑器的集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 和 Vue 3，使用 Vite 作为构建工具，支持 UnoCSS 进行样式处理，并集成 Mermaid 和 LaTeX 等库。
zh.hot: Slidev 拥有超过 48k 的 star，因其将 Markdown 的简洁性与开发者的工具链结合，成为开发者制作演示文稿的首选，本周新增 167 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 技术演讲者希望快速创建包含代码示例的幻灯片
开发团队用于内部技术分享和培训材料
教育工作者制作编程课程或教程演示
开源贡献者展示项目或撰写技术博客配套演示

en.tag: Markdown-based presentation tool for developers
en.what: Slidev is a presentation tool designed for developers, allowing users to write slides in Markdown with features like code highlighting, live coding, theming, and interactive components. It aims to integrate seamlessly with developer workflows such as code editors and version control.
en.content: The repository includes the core CLI, Vue components, theming system, documentation, and examples, along with integrations for exporting, recording, and editors.
en.stack: Built on Node.js and Vue 3, using Vite as the build tool, with UnoCSS for styling, and integrations for Mermaid and LaTeX.
en.hot: With over 48k stars, Slidev is a top choice for developers creating presentations due to its blend of Markdown simplicity and developer tooling, gaining 167 stars this week and remaining popular.
uses: Tech speakers who want to quickly create slides with code examples
Development teams for internal tech talks and training materials
Educators creating programming courses or tutorial presentations
Open-source contributors showcasing projects or accompanying tech blog posts

zh.tag: 有状态、有记忆、能自我进化的 AI 代理框架
zh.what: Letta Code 是一个有状态的代理框架，旨在创建更像人而非工具的 AI 代理。这些代理拥有记忆、身份和随时间积累的经验，能够通过重写自身记忆、技能、提示甚至框架本身来学习和进化。它支持交互式使用，也可用于始终在线的主动代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理运行时、CLI、桌面应用、浏览器客户端、消息集成（Telegram、Slack、Discord 等），以及丰富的功能如自我改进、消息搜索、MemFS、技能系统、子代理和多代理支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js 生态，依赖 git 进行上下文版本控制，支持多种消息平台集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 3152 颗星和本周新增 67 颗，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 9 名。其独特的“类人”代理概念和强大的自我进化能力吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 开发者构建具有长期记忆和自适应能力的 AI 代理，用于自动化复杂任务。
团队集成到 Slack、Discord 等平台，实现主动式 AI 助手。
研究人员探索代理的自我改进和持续学习机制。
个人用户通过 CLI 或桌面应用体验个性化 AI 代理。

en.tag: Stateful AI agent framework with memory, identity, and self-evolution
en.what: Letta Code is a stateful agent harness for creating agents that are more like people than tools. These agents have memory, identity, and a sense of experience over time, learning and evolving through rewriting their own memory, skills, prompts, and even the harness itself. It can be used interactively or to power always-on agents that work proactively.
en.content: The repository includes a full agent runtime, CLI, desktop app, browser client, messaging integrations (Telegram, Slack, Discord, etc.), and features like self-improvement, message search, MemFS, skills, subagents, and multi-agent support.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on the Node.js ecosystem, uses git for context versioning, and supports integrations with various messaging platforms.
en.hot: With 3152 stars and 67 new this week, it ranks 9th on GitHub Trending weekly for TypeScript. Its unique 'human-like' agent concept and powerful self-evolution capabilities attract developers.
uses: Developers building AI agents with long-term memory and adaptability for automating complex tasks.
Teams integrating proactive AI assistants into platforms like Slack, Discord, and more.
Researchers exploring self-improvement and continuous learning mechanisms in agents.
Individual users experiencing personalized AI agents via CLI or desktop app.

zh.tag: 为人类设计的优雅 TypeScript 后端框架，由 Bun 驱动
zh.what: Elysia 是一个专为 Bun 运行时设计的 TypeScript Web 框架，强调端到端类型安全、类型完整性和出色的开发者体验。它旨在提供比 Express 快 18 倍的性能，同时保持代码简洁优雅。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、文档、贡献指南和行为准则。提供类似 Express 的 API，但集成了先进的 TypeScript 类型系统、前端 RPC 连接器、GraphQL 支持等特性。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Bun 运行时，遵循 WinterCG 标准。依赖 Bun 的原生 API 实现高性能。
zh.hot: 凭借其极致的类型安全和性能优势，在 Bun 生态中迅速走红。本周新增 87 星，总星数达 19032，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 15 名。
uses: 希望利用 Bun 的高性能构建后端服务的开发者
追求端到端类型安全、减少运行时错误的 TypeScript 团队

en.what: Elysia is a TypeScript web framework built for the Bun runtime, emphasizing end-to-end type safety, type integrity, and exceptional developer experience. It aims to be 18x faster than Express while keeping code concise and elegant.
en.content: The repository contains the framework's core source code, documentation, contributing guide, and code of conduct. It offers an Express-like API but integrates advanced TypeScript type system, frontend RPC connector, GraphQL support, and more.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Bun runtime, compliant with WinterCG standards. Leverages Bun's native APIs for high performance.
en.hot: It's gaining popularity in the Bun ecosystem due to its extreme type safety and performance advantages. With 87 new stars this week and 19,032 total, it ranks #15 on the TypeScript weekly trending list.

TypeScript teams seeking end-to-end type safety to reduce runtime errors
Full-stack engineers needing rapid API development with great DX
Early adopters interested in emerging frameworks and cutting-edge tech

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 ChatGPT 替代品，支持离线运行 LLM
zh.what: Jan 是一个开源的 ChatGPT 替代品，完全在本地运行，保护隐私。用户可以下载并运行各种开源大语言模型（如 Llama、Gemma、Qwen），也可以连接云端模型服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码（支持 Windows、macOS、Linux），提供模型管理、聊天界面、本地推理引擎等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Electron 构建桌面应用，集成 HuggingFace 模型下载和多种推理后端。
zh.hot: 44k+ 星标，本周新增 172，因其提供离线、隐私保护的 AI 助手而受到关注，成为开源社区的热门选择。

开发者，需要本地运行和测试开源大语言模型
企业用户，需要在内部部署 AI 工具而不依赖外部服务

en.tag: Open-source ChatGPT alternative that runs 100% offline with local AI models
en.what: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT alternative that runs entirely offline on your computer, ensuring privacy. Users can download and run various open-source LLMs (like Llama, Gemma, Qwen) or connect to cloud model services.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for a desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) with model management, chat UI, and local inference engine.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Electron for the desktop app, integrating HuggingFace model downloads and multiple inference backends.
en.hot: With 44k+ stars and 172 new this week, it's popular for offering an offline, privacy-focused AI assistant, making it a top choice in the open-source community.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want an AI assistant without internet connection
Developers who need to run and test open-source LLMs locally
Enterprises that require on-premise AI tools without external dependencies

zh.tag: 微软开源的跨平台代码编辑器，全球开发者必备工具
zh.what: Visual Studio Code 是微软开发的开源代码编辑器，基于 Code - OSS 仓库，提供代码编辑、导航、理解支持，以及轻量级调试和丰富的扩展模型。它每月更新，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.content: 仓库包含 VS Code 的完整源代码、文档、路线图、迭代计划和贡献指南。主要目录包括 src（核心代码）、extensions（内置扩展）、test（测试）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Electron 框架，依赖 Node.js 和 Web 技术。
zh.hot: 作为全球最流行的代码编辑器，拥有 19 万+ stars，本周新增 850，持续霸榜，因其免费、开源、跨平台且扩展生态丰富。
uses: 适合各类开发者进行日常编码、调试和版本控制，支持多种语言和框架。
适用于需要高度可定制编辑器的团队，可通过扩展市场扩展功能。
适合学习开源项目结构和大型 TypeScript 代码库的开发者。

en.tag: Microsoft's open-source cross-platform code editor, essential for developers worldwide
en.what: Visual Studio Code is an open-source code editor developed by Microsoft, based on the Code - OSS repository. It provides comprehensive code editing, navigation, and understanding support, along with lightweight debugging and a rich extensibility model. It is updated monthly and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, roadmap, iteration plans, and contribution guidelines for VS Code. Key directories include src (core code), extensions (built-in extensions), and test (tests).
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on Electron, leveraging Node.js and web technologies.
en.hot: As the world's most popular code editor, it has over 190k stars, with 850 added this week, consistently trending due to its free, open-source, cross-platform nature and rich extension ecosystem.
uses: Ideal for developers of all kinds for daily coding, debugging, and version control, supporting multiple languages and frameworks.
Suitable for teams needing a highly customizable editor, with functionality extendable via the marketplace.
Great for developers learning open-source project structure and large TypeScript codebases.

zh.tag: TypeScript 优先的 schema 校验与类型推断库
zh.what: Zod 是一个 TypeScript 优先的校验库，通过定义 schema 来解析数据，并返回强类型、经过验证的结果。它支持静态类型推断，让开发者无需重复定义类型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zod 库的源代码、文档、测试以及示例。核心功能包括 schema 定义、解析、类型推断、JSON Schema 转换等。
zh.stack: TypeScript 编写，零外部依赖，支持 Node.js 和现代浏览器，核心包 gzipped 后仅 2kb。
zh.hot: Zod 在 TypeScript 生态中广受欢迎，因其简洁的 API 和强大的类型推断能力，star 数已达 43k，今日新增 31，持续在 GitHub 趋势榜上。
uses: 适用于 TypeScript 项目中的表单验证、API 请求/响应校验等场景。
适合需要运行时数据校验和静态类型安全的前端开发者。
可用于构建数据管道、配置解析等需要严格类型保证的后端服务。

en.tag: TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference
en.what: Zod is a TypeScript-first validation library that lets you define schemas and parse data, returning strongly-typed, validated results. It provides static type inference, eliminating the need for duplicate type definitions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, tests, and examples for the Zod library. Core features include schema definition, parsing, type inference, and JSON Schema conversion.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, zero external dependencies, works in Node.js and all modern browsers, core bundle is 2kb gzipped.
en.hot: Zod is widely popular in the TypeScript ecosystem for its concise API and powerful type inference, with 43k stars and 31 new stars today, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Ideal for form validation, API request/response validation in TypeScript projects.
Suitable for frontend developers needing runtime data validation and static type safety.
Useful for building data pipelines, config parsing, and backend services requiring strict type guarantees.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的幻灯片框架，自然语言生成演示文稿
zh.what: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 代理设计的幻灯片框架。用户用自然语言描述演示内容，编码代理自动生成 React 代码，框架负责画布、缩放、导航、热重载和演示模式。每张幻灯片渲染为固定的 1920×1080 画布，页面是任意 React 组件，不受限于特定 DSL。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 脚手架（npx @open-slide/cli init）、内置代理技能（/create-slide、/slide-authoring）、浏览器内检查器、资源管理器、演示模式、静态导出和幻灯片管理器。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 React 渲染幻灯片，支持热重载和静态导出。集成 svgl 图标搜索，依赖 Vercel 开源计划。
zh.hot: 本周新增 485 星，总星数 7333，登上 TypeScript 周榜第 17。它填补了 AI 代理生成演示文稿的空白，让用户无需离开聊天即可获得精美幻灯片。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code、Codex 等代理快速生成演示文稿，只需描述内容即可。
需要频繁制作幻灯片的技术演讲者或产品经理，可借助代理自动排版。
教育或培训场景，教师可用自然语言生成教学课件，节省时间。
团队协作演示时，通过浏览器内注释和 /apply-comments 循环迭代修改。

en.tag: A slide framework built for agents: describe in natural language, agents write the React.
en.what: open-slide is a slide framework built for agents. Users describe a deck in natural language, and coding agents write the React code. The framework handles canvas, scaling, navigation, hot reload, and present mode. Every slide renders into a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, and pages are arbitrary React components, not a constrained DSL.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI scaffolder (npx @open-slide/cli init), built-in agent skills (/create-slide, /slide-authoring), an in-browser inspector, assets manager, present mode, static export, and a slide manager.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses React for rendering, supports hot reload and static export. Integrates svgl logo search and is part of the Vercel OSS Program.
en.hot: Gained 485 stars this week, reaching 7333 total and #17 on the TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for AI-agent-generated presentations, letting users get polished decks without leaving the chat.
uses: Developers using agents like Claude Code or Codex to quickly generate presentations from natural language descriptions.
Technical speakers or product managers who need frequent slide creation and want automated layout via agents.
Educators or trainers who can generate course materials in natural language, saving time.
Teams collaborating on presentations, iterating with in-browser comments and /apply-comments loop.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理提供跨会话持久记忆与上下文压缩注入
zh.what: claude-mem 是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）设计的持久记忆系统。它捕获代理在会话中的所有操作，利用 AI 进行压缩，并在未来的会话中注入相关上下文，从而实现跨会话的连续性和个性化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心记忆压缩引擎、与多种代理的集成适配器、CLI 工具、文档（支持多语言）以及配置示例。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js（>=20），依赖 AI 模型进行压缩和检索，支持多种代理平台。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的普及，跨会话记忆成为关键需求，该项目以 91.7k 星标迅速走红，本周新增 794 星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 12。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 等代理进行长期项目开发，希望代理记住项目上下文和决策。
团队希望共享代理记忆，实现知识沉淀和协作效率提升。
需要为代理定制记忆策略，如压缩频率、上下文注入方式的高级用户。

en.what: claude-mem is a persistent memory system for AI agents like Claude Code and Codex. It captures everything an agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions, enabling continuity and personalization across sessions.
en.content: The repository includes the core memory compression engine, integration adapters for various agents, CLI tools, documentation (multi-language), and configuration examples.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js (>=20), relies on AI models for compression and retrieval, supports multiple agent platforms.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, cross-session memory is a critical need; the project gained 91.7k stars, +794 this week, ranking #12 on the JavaScript weekly trending list.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or similar agents for long-term projects, wanting the agent to remember project context and decisions.
Teams looking to share agent memory for knowledge accumulation and improved collaboration efficiency.
Advanced users who want to customize memory strategies, such as compression frequency and context injection methods.

zh.tag: 本地多智能体编排，让终端 CLI 变成你的克隆员工
zh.what: Munder Difflin 是一个本地多智能体编排工具，能将你已有的终端编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等）包装成可协作的智能体团队。它由你的克隆体 Michael 作为主管，为每个智能体分配长期记忆、邮箱和办公桌，并在 2D 办公楼层上可视化他们的工作状态。

uses: 开发者：希望利用现有 AI 编码工具实现自动化任务，如代码审查、测试执行等。
团队：需要并行处理多个编码任务，通过智能体协作提高效率。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体系统，可视化观察智能体协作过程。

en.what: Munder Difflin is a local multi-agent harness that wraps existing terminal coding CLIs (like Claude Code, Codex, Grok, etc.) into a collaborative agent team. en.hot: Debuted at #2 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 306 stars in one day and surpassing 2,000 total. Its creative concept of turning terminal CLIs into a clone office, combined with being free and open source, has captured developers' attention.

Teams: Parallelize multiple coding tasks and boost efficiency through agent collaboration.
AI enthusiasts: Explore multi-agent systems and visualize agent collaboration in action.

en.hot: With 78K+ stars and 400+ daily additions, it hits the pain point of aesthetic fatigue in AI-generated content, ranking #3 on the JavaScript trending list.

Frontend engineers: seek design inspiration or reusable patterns for crafting more polished UIs.
AI agent platforms: integrate Taste-Skill as a skill to enhance the aesthetic output of generated content.

zh.tag: 拒绝白板面试的友好公司清单
zh.what: 这是一个收集不使用白板面试的公司的开源清单，旨在推广更贴近实际工作的招聘方式。它列出了那些采用真实问题讨论、结对编程或家庭作业等面试形式的公司，并鼓励社区贡献和反馈。
