Designers: Rapidly prototype presentations using rich layouts and components.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: Vercel 官方 AI 编码代理技能集，含优化、React、设计、写作等
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编码代理提供的技能集合，技能是打包的指令和脚本，用于扩展代理能力。目前包含 Vercel 项目优化、React 最佳实践、Web 设计指南和写作指南等技能，每个技能都包含详细的规则和使用场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能目录，每个技能包含规则文件和脚本，如 vercel-optimize 用于审计 Vercel 项目，react-best-practices 提供 40+ 条优化规则，web-design-guidelines 覆盖 100+ 条 UI 规则，writing-guidelines 包含 80+ 条写作规则。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，遵循 Agent Skills 格式，可能依赖 Vercel 平台和 AI 代理工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 Vercel 官方发布的技能集，在 AI 代理快速发展的背景下，为开发者提供了即插即用的最佳实践，star 数已超 3 万，本周新增 301，持续受到关注。
uses: 开发者使用 AI 编码代理时，希望优化 Vercel 项目性能与成本，可调用 vercel-optimize 技能。
React/Next.js 开发者需要性能优化指导，可参考 react-best-practices 技能中的 40+ 条规则。
前端工程师审查 UI 代码时，可利用 web-design-guidelines 技能检查可访问性和用户体验。
技术文档写作者需要符合 Vercel 写作规范，可使用 writing-guidelines 技能进行审计。

en.tag: Vercel's official collection of agent skills for AI coding agents, covering optimization, React, design, writing, and more
en.what: A collection of skills for AI coding agents, where skills are packaged instructions and scripts that extend agent capabilities. Currently includes skills for Vercel project optimization, React best practices, web design guidelines, and writing guidelines, each with detailed rules and use cases.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill directories, each with rule files and scripts, such as vercel-optimize for auditing Vercel projects, react-best-practices with 40+ optimization rules, web-design-guidelines covering 100+ UI rules, and writing-guidelines with 80+ writing rules.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, following the Agent Skills format, likely leveraging Vercel platform and AI agent tooling.
en.hot: As an official Vercel release, it offers plug-and-play best practices for AI agents amid rapid AI agent development, with over 30k stars and 301 added this week, continuing to gain attention.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents to optimize Vercel project performance and cost can invoke the vercel-optimize skill.
React/Next.js developers needing performance optimization guidance can refer to the 40+ rules in react-best-practices.
Frontend engineers reviewing UI code can use web-design-guidelines to check accessibility and UX.
Technical writers needing to comply with Vercel writing standards can use writing-guidelines for audits.

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编码工具用量监控桌面小组件
zh.what: Token Monitor 是一个桌面小组件，用于实时监控 29+ 款 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等）的 token 用量、费用和账户限制。它支持多设备同步、历史趋势分析，并按工具、设备、模型、会话或项目维度进行统计。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、安装包（支持 Windows/macOS/Linux）、演示 GIF、以及多语言 README（中/英/日/韩等）。核心功能包括实时用量监控、多设备同步、历史趋势和工具/设备/模型/会话/项目维度统计。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，桌面应用跨平台支持 Windows 10+、macOS 12+ 和 Linux x64。依赖本地数据路径读取（如 ~/.claude、~/.codex）实现无侵入监控，并集成多设备同步机制。
zh.hot: 本月新增 677 星（总星数 1323），登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 17 名。随着 AI 编码工具激增，开发者对用量透明化和成本控制的需求强烈，该工具填补了这一空白。
uses: 重度 AI 编码工具用户：实时监控 token 消耗，避免超出账户限制
团队管理者：跨设备同步用量数据，统一管理多成员的成本
成本敏感型开发者：按项目/模型/会话分析历史趋势，优化支出
自托管爱好者：本地优先存储，数据隐私可控

en.tag: Local-first desktop widget for tracking AI coding tool usage
en.what: Token Monitor is a desktop widget that provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and account limits across 29+ AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. It features multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project.
en.content: The repository includes desktop app source code, installers for Windows/macOS/Linux, demo GIF, and multilingual READMEs (EN/CN/JP/KR etc.). Core features include live usage monitoring, multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool/device/model/session/project.
en.stack: Built primarily with JavaScript, the desktop app supports Windows 10+, macOS 12+, and Linux x64. It reads local data paths (e.g., ~/.claude, ~/.codex) for non-intrusive monitoring and integrates multi-device sync.
en.hot: Gained 677 stars this month (total 1323), ranking #17 on GitHub Trending monthly (JavaScript). With the proliferation of AI coding tools, developers strongly need usage transparency and cost control, and this tool fills that gap.
uses: Heavy AI coding tool users: monitor token consumption in real-time to avoid hitting account limits
Team managers: sync usage data across devices to manage costs for multiple members
Cost-conscious developers: analyze historical trends by project/model/session to optimize spending
Self-hosting enthusiasts: local-first storage for data privacy control

zh.tag: 一站式流媒体中心，自由观影的官方 Web 界面
zh.what: Stremio Web 是 Stremio 的官方网页版界面，让用户通过插件发现电影、剧集和频道，并在各设备间同步观看进度。它基于 React 构建，核心逻辑由 Rust 引擎编译为 WebAssembly 在后台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码，包括 UI 组件、状态管理、与 stremio-core 的交互层，以及 PWA 支持。还提供开发脚本、构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/React，依赖 stremio-core（Rust 编译为 WASM）和 stremio-video 播放器。使用 pnpm 管理依赖，Node.js 22+。
zh.hot: Stremio 本身拥有庞大用户群，Web 版让用户无需安装即可使用，且支持插件生态和跨设备同步，近期在 GitHub 上获得 1.29 万星标，日增 50，进入趋势榜。
uses: 喜欢 Stremio 但不想安装桌面应用，希望直接在浏览器中观看的用户。
开发人员想了解如何用 Rust/WASM 构建高性能前端应用。
需要跨设备同步观看进度和媒体库的流媒体爱好者。

en.tag: Official web UI for Stremio, a one-stop media center for streaming freedom
en.what: Stremio Web is the official web UI of Stremio, allowing users to discover movies, series, and channels via addons, with synced watch progress across devices. It's built with React, with core logic in Rust compiled to WebAssembly running in a Web Worker.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code of the web app, including UI components, state management, interaction layer with stremio-core, and PWA support. It also includes development scripts, build config, and docs.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript/React, with stremio-core (Rust→WASM) and stremio-video for playback. Uses pnpm for dependencies, Node.js 22+.
en.hot: Stremio has a large user base, and the web version allows instant access without installation, with addon ecosystem and cross-device sync. It has 12.9k stars, +50 today, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users who prefer Stremio in the browser without installing a desktop app.
Developers interested in building high-performance frontends with Rust/WASM.
Streaming enthusiasts who need cross-device sync of watch progress and library.

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的浏览器端 PDF 工具箱
zh.what: BentoPDF 是一个功能强大的 PDF 工具集，完全在浏览器端运行，无需服务器处理，确保文件隐私安全。支持合并、拆分、编辑、转换、加密等多种 PDF 操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码，提供多种 PDF 工具，如组织管理、编辑修改、格式转换、安全优化等。支持 Docker 部署、静态托管和本地自托管。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端框架可能为 React 或 Vue，利用 WebAssembly (WASM) 处理 PDF，支持 Docker 和 Podman 部署。
zh.hot: 因其隐私保护特性（文件不上传服务器）和丰富的功能而广受欢迎，14.9k 星标表明用户对本地化 PDF 工具需求强烈。
uses: 注重隐私的用户，希望 PDF 处理完全在本地完成，避免数据泄露。
需要快速处理 PDF 的办公人员，无需安装桌面软件，浏览器即可完成。
开发者和自托管爱好者，可部署到自己的服务器或静态托管平台。

en.tag: Privacy-first, client-side PDF toolkit
en.what: BentoPDF is a powerful PDF toolkit that runs entirely in the browser, with no server-side processing, ensuring file privacy. It supports merging, splitting, editing, converting, encrypting, and many other PDF operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full web app source code, offering various PDF tools for organizing, editing, converting, securing, and optimizing PDFs. It supports Docker deployment, static hosting, and local self-hosting.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely with a frontend framework like React or Vue, using WebAssembly (WASM) for PDF processing, and supporting Docker and Podman deployment.
en.hot: Its privacy-first approach (files never leave the browser) and comprehensive features have gained popularity, with 14.9k stars indicating strong demand for local PDF tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want PDF processing entirely on-device to avoid data leaks.
Office workers needing quick PDF handling without installing desktop software, just using the browser.
Developers and self-hosting enthusiasts who can deploy to their own servers or static hosting platforms.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 为并行 AI 代理工作流打造的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，专注于简化 Git worktree 的管理。它专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计，使多个代理可以在隔离的工作树中同时工作，而不会相互干扰。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档（位于 docs/ 目录）、CI 配置（GitHub Actions）以及徽章等。主要提供 worktrunk 命令，用于创建、列出、切换和清理 worktree。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态，支持 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可证。
zh.hot: 自年初发布以来迅速成为最流行的 Git worktree 管理器，目前已有 6667 星，今日新增 44 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第二。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要并行运行多个 AI 代理进行代码生成或审查，隔离工作树避免冲突。
多任务开发者：同时处理多个功能分支或修复，需要高效管理多个工作树。
CI/CD 工程师：在自动化流水线中并行执行任务，需要隔离的 Git 工作目录。

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a Rust-based CLI tool that simplifies Git worktree management. It is designed for parallel AI agent workflows, allowing multiple agents to work in isolated worktrees simultaneously without interference.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (in docs/), CI configuration (GitHub Actions), and badges. It provides the worktrunk command for creating, listing, switching, and cleaning worktrees.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0.
en.hot: Since its release at the start of the year, it has quickly become the most popular Git worktree manager, now with 6,667 stars and 44 new stars today, ranking #2 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: need to run multiple AI agents in parallel for code generation or review, isolating worktrees to avoid conflicts.
Multi-tasking developers: handle multiple feature branches or fixes simultaneously, requiring efficient management of multiple worktrees.
CI/CD engineers: execute tasks in parallel in automated pipelines, needing isolated Git working directories.

zh.tag: 轻量级 Bitwarden 自托管服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 的第三方轻量级服务器实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方客户端。它允许用户在低资源环境下自托管密码管理器，替代官方资源密集型的服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Web Vault、API 和后台管理功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，使用 Rocket 框架，依赖 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 64,210 星标，是自托管密码管理领域的标杆项目。其轻量、安全且完全兼容官方客户端的特性，吸引了大量追求隐私和资源优化的用户。
uses: 个人用户 —— 在低配 VPS 或 NAS 上自托管密码管理器
小型团队 —— 无需付费订阅即可使用 Bitwarden 功能
隐私爱好者 —— 完全掌控密码数据，避免云服务依赖

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Rocket framework, supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, and offers Docker containerization.
en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.
uses: Individual users — self-host password manager on low-end VPS or NAS
Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: 本地模型网关，让 Cursor 接入任意 API

Users who need a consistent experience across shells, as zoxide supports bash, zsh, fish, and others.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的高性能模态编辑器，融合 Kakoune 与 Neovim 优点
zh.what: Helix 是一个用 Rust 编写的模态文本编辑器，受 Kakoune 和 Neovim 启发，采用 Kakoune 的编辑模型。它提供类似 Vim 的模态编辑、多光标选择、内置语言服务器支持，以及基于 tree-sitter 的智能增量语法高亮。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的编辑器源码、文档（docs/）、运行时查询（runtime/queries/）用于语法高亮和缩进，以及截图和 logo 等资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 tree-sitter 进行语法分析，通过语言服务器协议（LSP）提供代码智能，并计划使用 wgpu 实现自定义渲染器。
zh.hot: 凭借 46k+ 星标和今日新增 28 星，Helix 在 Rust 趋势榜登顶，因其现代设计、高性能和活跃社区而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢 Vim 但追求更现代、开箱即用体验的开发者
需要高效多光标编辑和内置 LSP 支持的终端用户
对 Rust 编辑器实现或 tree-sitter 集成感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A post-modern modal text editor in Rust, blending Kakoune and Neovim ideas
en.what: Helix is a modal text editor written in Rust, inspired by Kakoune and Neovim, with an editing model heavily based on Kakoune. It offers Vim-like modal editing, multiple selections, built-in language server support, and smart incremental syntax highlighting via tree-sitter.
en.content: The repository contains the full editor source code, documentation (docs/), runtime queries (runtime/queries/) for syntax highlighting and indentation, plus screenshots and logo assets.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging tree-sitter for syntax parsing, LSP for language intelligence, and planning a custom renderer using wgpu.
en.hot: With 46k+ stars and 28 new today, Helix tops the Rust trending list, gaining attention for its modern design, high performance, and active community.
uses: Developers who like Vim but want a more modern, out-of-the-box experience
Terminal users needing efficient multi-cursor editing and built-in LSP support
Developers interested in Rust editor implementation or tree-sitter integration

zh.tag: 为 git 等命令提供语法高亮的分页器
zh.what: delta 是一个命令行工具，作为 git、diff、grep 等命令的分页器，提供语法高亮和增强的差异显示。它支持词级差异高亮、并排视图、行号等功能，让代码审查更直观。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、安装脚本和配置文件。核心是一个可执行文件 delta，通过配置集成到 git 中。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 bat 的语法高亮主题，利用 Levenshtein 编辑推断算法实现词级差异。
zh.hot: 拥有 3.2 万 star，因其显著提升 git 输出可读性而广受欢迎，是开发者日常工具链的必备品。
uses: 开发者日常使用 git 命令行时，希望获得更清晰、高亮的 diff 输出。
需要高效审查大型代码变更，利用并排视图和导航键快速浏览。
喜欢自定义终端配色和样式，追求个性化开发环境的用户。

en.tag: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, and more
en.what: Delta is a command-line tool that acts as a pager for git, diff, grep, and other commands, providing syntax highlighting and enhanced diff display. It supports word-level diff highlighting, side-by-side view, line numbers, and more, making code review more intuitive.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, installation scripts, and configuration files. The core is an executable named delta, integrated into git via configuration.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it uses bat's syntax highlighting themes and a Levenshtein edit inference algorithm for word-level diffs.
en.hot: With 31,977 stars, it's popular for dramatically improving git output readability, making it a must-have in developers' daily toolchains.
uses: Developers who use git CLI daily and want clearer, syntax-highlighted diff output.
Those reviewing large code changes efficiently with side-by-side view and navigation keys.
Users who enjoy customizing terminal colors and styles for a personalized dev environment.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户的 Xray 管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器管理面板，提供多语言 Web 界面，支持部署、配置和监控多种代理协议。它支持单节点和多节点部署，并提供了丰富的用户管理功能，如流量限制、到期时间和 IP 限制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、多语言翻译文件、文档和自定义订阅模板。主要组件包括 Web 界面、RESTful API、Telegram 机器人以及内置的订阅服务器。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Xray-core 作为核心代理引擎。前端使用 Vue.js 和 Element Plus 构建，后端采用 Gin 框架，并支持 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 数据库。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 45k 星标，今日新增 86 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 8。其强大的功能、活跃的社区和持续的更新使其成为 Xray 面板的热门选择。
uses: 个人用户：搭建和管理自己的代理服务器，支持多种协议和用户管理
小型团队或组织：在多台服务器上部署统一管理面板，实现集中监控和配置
开发者：通过 RESTful API 集成到自己的应用或服务中，实现自动化管理

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user Xray management panel
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, offering a multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring various proxy protocols. It supports both single and multi-node setups, with per-client management including traffic quotas, expiry dates, and IP limits.
en.content: The repository contains the full panel source code, multi-language translation files, documentation, and custom subscription templates. Key components include a web interface, RESTful API, Telegram bot, and built-in subscription server.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Xray-core as the core proxy engine. The frontend is built with Vue.js and Element Plus, while the backend uses the Gin framework, with support for SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.
en.hot: With over 45k stars and 86 new stars today, ranking 8th on the Go trending list, its powerful features, active community, and continuous updates make it a popular choice for Xray panels.
uses: Individual users: set up and manage their own proxy servers with multi-protocol support and user management
Small teams or organizations: deploy a unified panel across multiple servers for centralized monitoring and configuration
Developers: integrate via RESTful API into their own applications or services for automated management

zh.tag: 高性能云原生向量数据库，支撑 AI 非结构化数据检索
zh.what: Milvus 是一个专为大规模向量相似性搜索设计的高性能向量数据库。它能够高效组织和检索文本、图像等多模态非结构化数据，为 AI 应用提供底层数据支撑。支持分布式部署与实时流式更新，可处理数十亿向量和数万级 QPS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Milvus 的完整源代码，采用 Go 和 C++ 编写，提供 Standalone 单机模式和分布式集群模式，并包含 Milvus Lite 轻量版（可通过 pip 安装）以及云服务 Zilliz Cloud 的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 和 C++，利用 CPU/GPU 硬件加速实现高性能向量搜索，架构完全分布式且原生支持 Kubernetes，便于水平扩展。
zh.hot: Milvus 是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的向量数据库之一，拥有 45.8k 星标，今日新增 22 星并登上 Go 语言趋势榜。随着 AI 应用对向量检索需求的爆发，其高性能和云原生特性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: AI 应用开发者：构建 RAG、语义搜索、推荐系统等需要向量检索的功能。
数据工程师：管理大规模非结构化数据，实现实时流式更新和高效查询。
云原生架构师：在 Kubernetes 集群中部署可水平扩展的向量数据库服务。
机器学习工程师：利用 Milvus Lite 快速原型验证，或通过 Zilliz Cloud 免运维使用。

en.tag: High-performance cloud-native vector database for scalable AI search
en.what: Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for large-scale vector similarity search. It efficiently organizes and retrieves unstructured data like text, images, and multi-modal information, powering AI applications. It supports distributed deployment and real-time streaming updates, handling billions of vectors and tens of thousands of queries per second.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Milvus, written in Go and C++, offering Standalone mode for single-machine deployment and distributed cluster mode, along with Milvus Lite (pip installable) and integration with Zilliz Cloud managed service.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go and C++, leveraging CPU/GPU hardware acceleration for high-performance vector search. The architecture is fully distributed and K8s-native, enabling horizontal scaling.
en.hot: Milvus is one of the most popular vector databases on GitHub with 45.8k stars, gaining 22 stars today and trending in the Go category. The surge in AI applications requiring vector search has made its high performance and cloud-native features highly attractive.
uses: AI developers building RAG, semantic search, recommendation systems, and other vector-based features.
Data engineers managing large-scale unstructured data with real-time streaming updates and efficient queries.
Cloud-native architects deploying horizontally scalable vector databases on Kubernetes.
ML engineers prototyping quickly with Milvus Lite or using Zilliz Cloud for zero-ops managed service.

zh.tag: 云原生 AI 原生 API 网关，支持 MCP 托管与多模型代理
zh.what: Higress 是一个基于 Istio 和 Envoy 的云原生 API 网关，专为 AI 场景设计。它支持通过 Go/Rust/JS 编写 Wasm 插件进行扩展，并提供开箱即用的控制台。其 AI 网关能力支持国内外主流模型提供商，并可通过插件机制托管 MCP 服务器，使 AI 代理能够轻松调用各种工具和服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Higress 的源代码、文档、示例和插件市场。核心组件包括基于 Envoy 的网关引擎、Wasm 插件运行时、控制台界面以及丰富的预置插件（如 AI 代理、限流、认证等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Istio 和 Envoy 构建，支持 Wasm 插件（Go/Rust/JS）。依赖 Kubernetes 生态，提供 Helm 部署方式。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF Sandbox 项目，Higress 在 AI 网关领域迅速走红，凭借对 MCP 的原生支持和多模型代理能力，吸引了大量开发者。目前 Star 数已达 9220，今日新增 22，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10 名。
uses: AI 应用开发者：需要统一接入多个大模型提供商，简化 API 管理和成本控制。
平台工程师：希望为微服务和 AI 服务提供高性能、可扩展的 API 网关，并支持 Wasm 插件定制。
MCP 服务提供者：需要快速将工具或服务暴露为 MCP 服务器，供 AI 代理调用。

en.tag: Cloud-native AI-native API gateway with MCP hosting and multi-provider AI proxy
en.what: Higress is a cloud-native API gateway based on Istio and Envoy, designed for AI scenarios. It can be extended with Wasm plugins written in Go/Rust/JS and provides an out-of-the-box console. Its AI gateway capabilities support all mainstream model providers, and it can host MCP servers via plugins, enabling AI agents to easily call various tools and services.
en.content: The repository contains Higress source code, documentation, examples, and a plugin hub. Core components include the Envoy-based gateway engine, Wasm plugin runtime, console UI, and dozens of ready-to-use plugins (e.g., AI proxy, rate limiting, authentication).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on Istio and Envoy, with Wasm plugin support (Go/Rust/JS). It leverages the Kubernetes ecosystem and offers Helm deployment.
en.hot: As a CNCF Sandbox project, Higress has gained rapid popularity in the AI gateway space, thanks to its native MCP support and multi-provider AI proxy capabilities. With 9,220 stars and 22 added today, it ranks #10 on the Go trending list.
uses: AI application developers: need to unify access to multiple LLM providers, simplifying API management and cost control.
Platform engineers: want a high-performance, scalable API gateway for microservices and AI services, with Wasm plugin customization.
MCP service providers: need to quickly expose tools or services as MCP servers for AI agents to call.

zh.tag: 把安卓手机变成短信网关，通过 HTTP API 收发短信
zh.what: httpSMS 是一个将 Android 手机变成短信网关的服务。你可以通过简单的 HTTP API 发送短信，手机收到的短信也会转发到你的 webhook 端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web UI、API 服务、Android 应用以及 Docker 自托管配置，支持端到端加密、Webhook、背压和消息过期等特性。
zh.stack: 后端主要使用 Go 编写，前端为 Web UI，Android 应用为原生开发，依赖 Firebase、SMTP 和 Cloudflare Turnstile 等服务。
zh.hot: 本周新增 374 星，总星数 4713，登上 Go 语言周榜第 6。它提供了一种低成本、可自托管的短信收发方案，受到开发者和自动化场景的欢迎。
uses: 开发者需要为应用集成短信通知或验证码功能，但不想依赖付费短信服务商。
个人或企业希望利用现有 Android 设备搭建私有短信网关，实现自动化消息处理。
需要接收短信并触发 webhook 的自动化流程，如工单系统、提醒服务等。

en.tag: Turn your Android phone into an SMS gateway with a simple HTTP API
en.what: httpSMS is a service that turns your Android phone into an SMS gateway. You can send SMS via a simple HTTP API, and incoming SMS are forwarded to your webhook.
en.content: The repo includes a web UI, API service, Android app, and Docker self-hosting setup, with features like end-to-end encryption, webhooks, back pressure, and message expiration.
en.stack: Backend is primarily Go, frontend is a web UI, Android app is native, with dependencies on Firebase, SMTP, and Cloudflare Turnstile.
en.hot: Gained 374 stars this week, reaching 4713 total and #6 on the Go weekly trending. It offers a low-cost, self-hostable SMS solution, popular among developers and automation use cases.
uses: Developers needing SMS notifications or OTP in their apps without relying on paid SMS providers.
Individuals or businesses wanting to build a private SMS gateway using existing Android devices for automated messaging.
Automation workflows that require receiving SMS and triggering webhooks, such as ticketing systems or alert services.

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 强大的系统容器与虚拟机管理器
zh.what: Incus 是一个现代、安全且强大的系统容器和虚拟机管理器，提供统一的体验来运行和管理完整的 Linux 系统。它支持多种 Linux 发行版镜像，并通过简单而强大的 REST API 进行管理，可从小型单机扩展到数据中心级集群。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Incus 的完整源代码、文档、测试和构建配置，主要用 Go 编写，并包含客户端库和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 LXC 和 QEMU 等底层虚拟化技术，通过 REST API 与客户端交互。
zh.hot: 作为 LXD 的社区分支，Incus 在 Canonical 接管后获得关注，本周新增 91 星，总星数 6099，位列 Go 周榜第 8。
uses: 开发人员希望容器化不同环境或运行虚拟机，以优化资源利用。
系统管理员需要管理从单机到集群的基础设施，构建小型私有云。
对开源社区项目感兴趣，希望参与无 CLA 限制的 Apache 2.0 许可项目。

en.tag: Powerful system container and virtual machine manager
en.what: Incus is a modern, secure, and powerful system container and virtual machine manager that provides a unified experience for running and managing full Linux systems. It supports images for many Linux distributions, is built around a simple yet powerful REST API, and scales from a single machine to a full data center cluster.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, tests, and build configuration for Incus, primarily written in Go, including client libraries and command-line tools.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging underlying virtualization technologies like LXC and QEMU, and interacting via a REST API.
en.hot: As a community fork of LXD, Incus gained attention after Canonical's takeover, adding 91 stars this week to reach 6099 total, ranking #8 on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Developers looking to containerize different environments or run VMs to optimize resource usage.
System administrators needing to manage infrastructure from single machines to clusters, building a small private cloud.
Those interested in open-source community projects without CLA restrictions, under Apache 2.0 license.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 模型网关与资产管理平台
zh.what: New API 是一个集中式 AI 模型网关，支持将多种 LLM 统一转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容格式，便于聚合与分发。它提供个人和企业级模型管理、认证、用量统计与成本核算，并支持私有化部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端（基于 React 等）、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英法日等）以及详细的文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能采用 React 等现代框架，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，并集成多种 LLM API 协议转换。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.5k 星标和日增 115 星，New API 成为 AI 基础设施的热门选择，因其解决了多模型统一接入的痛点，并支持私有化部署，深受开发者和企业青睐。
uses: 开发者：需要统一管理多个 LLM API 密钥和调用格式的开发者
企业：希望构建内部 AI 网关，实现成本控制和审计的企业
自托管用户：偏好私有化部署，避免依赖第三方服务的用户
AI 应用团队：需要将不同模型快速集成到现有应用中的团队

en.tag: Unified AI model gateway and asset management platform
en.what: New API is a centralized AI model gateway that aggregates and distributes various LLMs by converting them into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It offers personal and enterprise-grade model management, authentication, usage analytics, cost accounting, and supports private deployment.

zh.tag: 用 Markdown 定义 AI 代理工作流，安全运行于 GitHub Actions
zh.what: gh-aw 是 GitHub 官方的 CLI 扩展，让开发者用 Markdown 加 YAML frontmatter 定义 AI 代理工作流，并编译为标准的 GitHub Actions 工作流。它用于需要推理或解释的任务，如问题分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查等，补充而非替代传统 CI/CD。

zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为 GitHub CLI 扩展构建。内置 AI 引擎支持 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini 和 Pi，依赖 GitHub Actions 执行。

uses: 开发者希望用 AI 自动化仓库维护任务，如 issue 分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查。
团队需要在现有 CI/CD 流程中安全引入 AI 代理，且不牺牲安全性和可控性。
对 GitHub Actions 熟悉，想探索 AI 代理工作流最佳实践的技术负责人。

en.tag: Define AI agent workflows in Markdown, run securely on GitHub Actions
en.what: gh-aw is an official GitHub CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, compiling each workflow into a standard GitHub Actions workflow. It handles tasks requiring reasoning or interpretation, such as issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation, complementing rather than replacing traditional CI/CD.
en.content: The repository contains the CLI extension source, documentation (quick start, how it works, security), sample workflows, and community contributions. The core is the `gh aw compile` command that transforms Markdown source into `.lock.yml` workflows executed by GitHub Actions.

en.hot: Official GitHub project combining AI agents with Actions securely, gaining traction. With 56 new stars this week and nearly 5k total, ranking #19 on Go weekly trending, it reflects developer demand for AI-driven automation workflows.
uses: Developers looking to automate repo maintenance tasks like issue triage, PR review, and CI failure investigation with AI.
Teams wanting to safely integrate AI agents into existing CI/CD pipelines without compromising security and control.
Tech leads familiar with GitHub Actions who want to explore best practices for AI agent workflows.

zh.tag: 行业标准容器运行时，强调简单、稳健与可移植性
zh.what: containerd 是一个行业标准的容器运行时，专注于简单性、健壮性和可移植性。它以守护进程形式运行于 Linux 和 Windows，管理宿主机上容器的完整生命周期，包括镜像传输与存储、容器执行与监督、底层存储与网络挂载等。它被设计为嵌入到更大的系统中，而不是直接供开发者或最终用户使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 containerd 的源代码、构建配置、文档（包括架构设计文档）以及 CI/CD 工作流。项目采用 Go 语言编写，并遵循 CNCF 的治理模型，包含多个子项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux/Windows 系统调用，并集成 CNCF 生态工具。构建系统支持 Makefile 和 GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，containerd 是 Kubernetes 等主流平台的默认运行时，拥有 21168 颗星，持续获得社区关注。其稳定性与广泛采用使其成为容器基础设施的核心组件。
uses: 平台工程师：集成 containerd 以构建容器平台或 Kubernetes 节点，管理容器生命周期。
容器运行时开发者：基于 containerd 扩展或定制运行时功能，满足特定需求。
DevOps 团队：利用 containerd 的高效镜像管理和稳定运行，优化 CI/CD 流水线。
安全研究人员：审查和贡献安全补丁，参与 CNCF 安全顾问团队。

en.tag: Industry-standard container runtime emphasizing simplicity, robustness, and portability
en.what: containerd is an industry-standard container runtime with an emphasis on simplicity, robustness, and portability. It is available as a daemon for Linux and Windows, managing the complete container lifecycle of its host system: image transfer and storage, container execution and supervision, low-level storage and network attachments, etc. It is designed to be embedded into a larger system, rather than being used directly by developers or end-users.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build configuration, documentation (including architecture design docs), and CI/CD workflows for containerd. The project is written in Go and follows CNCF governance, with multiple subprojects.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux/Windows system calls and integrating with CNCF ecosystem tools. Build system supports Makefile and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, containerd is the default runtime for mainstream platforms like Kubernetes, with 21,168 stars and ongoing community attention. Its stability and widespread adoption make it a core component of container infrastructure.
uses: Platform engineers: Integrate containerd to build container platforms or Kubernetes nodes, managing container lifecycles.
Container runtime developers: Extend or customize runtime features based on containerd to meet specific needs.
DevOps teams: Leverage containerd's efficient image management and stable operation to optimize CI/CD pipelines.
Security researchers: Review and contribute security patches, participate in CNCF security advisor team.

zh.tag: 基于 rizin 的免费开源逆向工程平台
zh.what: Cutter 是一个由逆向工程师为逆向工程师打造的免费开源逆向工程平台，基于 rizin 引擎，提供高级且可定制的逆向分析功能，同时注重用户体验。它支持多种架构和文件格式，集成了反汇编、反编译、调试等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cutter 的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档（用户指南、贡献指南、开发者文档）、Docker 配置，以及支持 Python 和 C++ 插件的接口。还集成了 Ghidra 反编译器等社区插件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 构建图形界面，核心分析引擎基于 rizin（C 语言编写）。支持 Python 插件，并可选集成 Ghidra 反编译器。
zh.hot: 作为免费开源的逆向工程平台，Cutter 在安全研究社区广受欢迎，拥有近 2 万星标，本周新增 91 星，持续活跃。其易用性和强大的 rizin 后端使其成为商业工具的流行替代品。
uses: 安全研究人员分析恶意软件、漏洞研究和二进制审计
逆向工程师进行软件破解、协议逆向和固件分析
CTF 玩家用于解题和逆向挑战
开发人员学习汇编语言和程序内部工作原理

en.tag: Free & open-source reverse engineering platform powered by rizin
en.what: Cutter is a free and open-source reverse engineering platform powered by rizin, created by reverse engineers for reverse engineers. It aims to be an advanced and customizable RE platform while keeping user experience in mind, offering disassembly, decompilation, debugging, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts, documentation (user guide, contribution guidelines, developer docs), Docker configuration, and plugin interfaces for Python and C++ plugins. It also integrates community plugins like the Ghidra decompiler.
en.stack: Built primarily with C++ and Qt for the GUI, with the core analysis engine based on rizin (written in C). Supports Python plugins and optional integration with the Ghidra decompiler.
en.hot: As a free and open-source reverse engineering platform, Cutter is widely popular in the security research community, with nearly 20k stars and 91 new stars this week, remaining highly active. Its ease of use and powerful rizin backend make it a popular alternative to commercial tools.
uses: Security researchers analyzing malware, vulnerability research, and binary auditing
Reverse engineers performing software cracking, protocol reversing, and firmware analysis
CTF players solving challenges and reverse engineering tasks
Developers learning assembly language and how programs work internally

zh.tag: CUDA 高性能线性代数模板库与 Python DSL
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 开源的 CUDA 抽象集合，用于实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关计算，覆盖从底层硬件到上层应用的所有层级。它提供分层分解和数据移动策略，将复杂内核拆解为可复用的模块化组件，并支持多种数据类型和架构。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 模板库、CuTe DSL（Python 领域特定语言）、示例代码（如 GEMM 分解图）以及针对 Volta 到 Blackwell 架构的优化内核。
zh.stack: 基于 CUDA C++ 模板，支持 FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/块缩放/窄整数/二进制等数据类型，并集成 Python DSL（CuTe DSL）以简化开发。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方高性能计算库，CUTLASS 是 GPU 内核开发的基石，star 数超 1 万，今日新增 7 星，排名 C++ 日榜第五，持续受到性能工程师和 AI 研究者的关注。
uses: GPU 性能工程师：用于优化深度学习推理和训练中的矩阵运算，提升效率。
AI 研究人员：借助 CuTe DSL 快速原型设计新内核，无需深入 C++ 细节。
学生与教育者：学习 CUDA 编程和 GPU 架构的绝佳资源，降低入门门槛。
框架开发者：集成到 PyTorch 等框架中，无需编写胶水代码即可获得高性能内核。

en.tag: CUDA templates & Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is NVIDIA's open-source collection of CUDA abstractions for high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related computations across all levels and scales. It decomposes complex kernels into reusable modular components with hierarchical decomposition and data movement strategies, supporting diverse data types and architectures.
en.content: The repo contains C++ template library, CuTe DSL (Python domain-specific language), examples (e.g., GEMM decomposition diagram), and optimized kernels for Volta to Blackwell architectures.
en.stack: Built on CUDA C++ templates, supporting FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/block-scaled/narrow-int/binary data types, with Python DSL (CuTe DSL) for simplified development.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official high-performance computing library, CUTLASS is a cornerstone for GPU kernel development, with 10k+ stars and 7 new today, ranking #5 on C++ daily trending, consistently attracting performance engineers and AI researchers.
uses: GPU performance engineers: optimize matrix operations in deep learning inference and training for higher efficiency.
AI researchers: leverage CuTe DSL for rapid prototyping of new kernels without deep C++ expertise.
Students and educators: an excellent resource for learning CUDA programming and GPU architecture, lowering the entry barrier.
Framework developers: integrate into frameworks like PyTorch to obtain high-performance kernels without glue code.

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端，跨平台消息应用
zh.what: 这是 Telegram 官方桌面客户端的完整源代码，基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议构建。它提供了消息收发、语音通话、文件共享等核心功能，并支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、构建说明、多平台安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）以及旧版本兼容信息。还列出了第三方依赖如 Qt、OpenSSL 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 OpenSSL、WebRTC、zlib 等库，支持 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方桌面客户端，拥有 3.2 万星标，持续维护，是跨平台消息应用的重要参考实现。
uses: 开发者可学习大型 C++ 跨平台应用的架构与构建流程。
用户可下载官方客户端，享受安全、快速的即时通讯服务。
对 MTProto 协议感兴趣的开发者可研究其实现细节。

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client, cross-platform messaging app
en.what: This is the complete source code of the official Telegram desktop client, built on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol. It offers messaging, voice calls, file sharing, and more, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains full source code, build instructions, multi-platform installers (Windows, macOS, Linux), and legacy version compatibility info. Third-party dependencies like Qt and OpenSSL are listed.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, depends on OpenSSL, WebRTC, zlib, and others, built with CMake.
en.hot: As the official Telegram desktop client, it has 32k+ stars, actively maintained, and serves as a key reference for cross-platform messaging apps.
uses: Developers can learn architecture and build process of large-scale C++ cross-platform apps.
Users can download the official client for secure and fast instant messaging.
Developers interested in MTProto protocol can study its implementation details.

zh.tag: 本地 AI 服务器，让 GPU/NPU 秒变云端 API
zh.what: Lemonade 是一个本地 AI 服务器，提供与云端 API 相同的功能，但完全免费且私密。它支持在自有 NPU 和 GPU 上运行最新的聊天、编程、语音和图像生成模型。
zh.content: 包含 Lemonade Server（可连接数百个应用的服务）和 Embeddable Lemonade（可嵌入应用的可移植二进制文件），提供模型管理器、内置聊天/图像/语音界面，以及 Windows、Linux、macOS、Docker 和移动端支持。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 构建，针对 AMD Ryzen AI、Radeon 和 Strix Halo 进行了优化，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Ollama 标准 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 5532 颗星和今日新增 15 星，Lemonade 在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第三，其免费、私密且高性能的本地 AI 方案吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望在不牺牲隐私的前提下使用最新 AI 模型的个人开发者
需要将多模态 AI 集成到应用中的软件团队
寻求在自有硬件上运行 AI 以减少云成本的企业用户
对本地 AI 优化和硬件加速感兴趣的爱好者

en.tag: Local AI server turning your GPU/NPU into cloud-grade APIs
en.what: Lemonade is a local AI server that offers cloud-API capabilities, 100% free and private. It runs the latest models for chat, coding, speech, and image generation on your own NPU and GPU.
en.content: Includes Lemonade Server (a service for connecting to hundreds of apps) and Embeddable Lemonade (a portable binary for embedding), with a model manager, built-in chat/image/speech interfaces, and support for Windows, Linux, macOS, Docker, and mobile.
en.stack: Built in C++, optimized for AMD Ryzen AI, Radeon, and Strix Halo, supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama standard APIs.
en.hot: With 5,532 stars and 15 added today, Lemonade ranks #3 on the C++ trending list, attracting attention for its free, private, and high-performance local AI solution.
uses: Individual developers wanting to use the latest AI models without sacrificing privacy
Software teams needing to integrate multimodal AI into their applications
Enterprise users seeking to run AI on their own hardware to reduce cloud costs
Enthusiasts interested in local AI optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: MySQL 社区分支，功能丰富且兼容的开源关系型数据库
zh.what: MariaDB 是一个由 MySQL 原核心团队发起的开源关系型数据库，是 MySQL 的分支，保持高度兼容性，同时提供更多原生功能。它广泛应用于从小型应用到大规模生产系统的工作负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MariaDB 服务器的完整源代码，包括存储引擎（InnoDB、Aria、MyRocks 等）、复制与集群模块、SQL 解析器、向量搜索支持，以及构建和测试框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 MySQL 兼容的客户端协议，支持多种存储引擎，并集成 HNSW 索引等现代特性。
zh.hot: 作为 MySQL 的流行替代品，MariaDB 持续获得关注，今日新增 7 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 12 名，其原生向量搜索等新特性吸引了开发者。
uses: 需要从 MySQL 迁移且希望获得更多功能的企业级应用开发者
对原生向量搜索和多种存储引擎感兴趣的数据工程师
构建高可用集群或需要同步多主复制的系统架构师
学习数据库内部实现和参与开源贡献的开发者

en.tag: Community-developed MySQL fork, feature-rich and compatible open-source relational database
en.what: MariaDB is an open-source relational database, a fork of MySQL initiated by the original core team, maintaining high compatibility while offering additional native features. It powers workloads from small applications to large-scale production systems.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the MariaDB server, including storage engines (InnoDB, Aria, MyRocks, etc.), replication and clustering modules, SQL parser, vector search support, and build and test frameworks.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on MySQL-compatible client protocol, supports multiple storage engines, and integrates modern features like HNSW indexing.
en.hot: As a popular MySQL alternative, MariaDB continues to gain attention, with 7 stars today, ranking 12th on the C++ trending list, and its native vector search and other new features attract developers.
uses: Enterprise developers migrating from MySQL and seeking more features
Data engineers interested in native vector search and multiple storage engines
System architects building high-availability clusters or needing synchronous multi-primary replication
Developers learning database internals and contributing to open source

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面命令面板，支持 Raycast 生态扩展
zh.what: Vicinae 是一个面向桌面的原生命令面板，提供应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文本扩展、文件搜索、浏览器标签切换、表情选择、计算器、窗口切换等功能。它支持通过 React/TypeScript 扩展、脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单进行扩展，兼容 Raycast 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、文档（docs 目录）、扩展示例、截图和品牌资源。项目采用模块化设计，支持通过 Vicinae 商店和 Raycast 商店安装扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，扩展支持 React/TypeScript，兼容 Raycast 扩展 API。依赖包括 CMake、Node.js 等构建工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 9130 颗星和今日新增 77 颗，Vicinae 在 C++ 日榜排名第 12。其原生性能与 Raycast 生态兼容性吸引开发者，成为桌面效率工具的热门选择。
uses: 桌面用户寻求快速启动应用、搜索文件和管理剪贴板的一体化工具
开发者希望使用 React/TypeScript 构建自定义扩展，并复用 Raycast 生态
Linux 用户偏好 dmenu 风格的轻量级菜单交互

en.tag: Native high-performance desktop command palette with Raycast-compatible extensions
en.what: Vicinae is a native command palette for the desktop, offering app search, clipboard history, text expansion, file search, browser tab switching, emoji picking, calculator, and window switching. It can be extended via React/TypeScript extensions, script commands, and dmenu-style menus, compatible with the Raycast ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains C++ core source code, documentation (docs directory), extension examples, screenshots, and branding assets. The project is modular, supporting extensions from both the Vicinae store and the Raycast store.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with extensions in React/TypeScript, compatible with Raycast's extension API. Build dependencies include CMake, Node.js, etc.
en.hot: With 9,130 stars and 77 added today, Vicinae ranks #12 on the C++ daily trending list. Its native performance and Raycast ecosystem compatibility attract developers, making it a popular desktop productivity tool.
uses: Desktop users seeking an all-in-one tool for quick app launching, file search, and clipboard management
Developers who want to build custom extensions with React/TypeScript and reuse the Raycast ecosystem
Linux users who prefer dmenu-style lightweight menu interactions

zh.tag: 开源软件KVM，一套键鼠控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键鼠共享应用，让你用一台电脑的键盘、鼠标或触控板控制附近的多台电脑，实现无缝切换。它相当于一个软件 KVM（不含视频），默认启用 TLS 加密，支持 Wayland 和剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、安装包生成配置（如 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 Flathub），以及详细的 README 文档和社区讨论链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 等跨平台库，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Wayland。
zh.hot: 作为 Synergy 的开源继任者，Deskflow 在 2.8 万星基础上持续增长，本周新增 173 星，位列 C++ 周榜第 12。其免费开源、支持 TLS 和 Wayland 的特性吸引了大量寻求替代方案的用户。
uses: 多机办公用户：在台式机和笔记本之间共享键鼠，提升效率。
跨平台开发者：在 Windows、macOS、Linux 间无缝切换，统一操作。
开源爱好者：寻找 Synergy 的免费替代品，并参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source software KVM to share one keyboard/mouse across computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open-source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers using the keyboard, mouse, or trackpad of one machine. It acts as a software KVM (without video), with TLS encryption enabled by default, Wayland support, and clipboard sharing.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, build scripts, packaging configurations for Windows/macOS/Linux and Flathub, plus detailed README and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, leveraging cross-platform libraries like Qt, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and Wayland.
en.hot: As an open-source successor to Synergy, Deskflow has amassed over 28k stars and continues to grow, adding 173 stars this week and ranking #12 on the C++ weekly trending. Its free, open-source nature with TLS and Wayland support attracts users seeking an alternative.
uses: Multi-machine office workers: share keyboard/mouse between desktop and laptop for efficiency.
Cross-platform developers: seamlessly switch between Windows, macOS, Linux with unified control.
Open-source enthusiasts: seeking a free alternative to Synergy and contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 高颜值动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立开发的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器，注重外观和可定制性。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性，支持渐变边框、模糊、动画等视觉效果，并拥有强大的插件系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含合成器源代码、文档、配置示例和资源文件。主要目录包括 src（核心代码）、assets（图片和图标）、以及 wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Wayland 协议，不依赖 wlroots 等库。支持自定义布局（如 Lua）和插件。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，在 Linux 用户中广受欢迎。当前星标 38,298，今日新增 32，位居 C++ 趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: 追求美观和动态平铺体验的 Linux 桌面用户
喜欢深度定制窗口管理器的开发者或极客
需要高性能和低延迟的游戏玩家（支持撕裂控制）
对 Wayland 合成器开发感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: A beautiful, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that prioritizes aesthetics and customization. It offers the latest Wayland features, visual effects like gradient borders and blur, and a powerful plugin system.
en.content: The repository contains the compositor's source code, documentation, configuration examples, and assets. Main directories include src (core code), assets (images and icons), and links to the wiki.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it relies on Wayland protocols and does not depend on wlroots or similar libraries. Supports custom layouts (e.g., Lua) and plugins.
en.hot: Popular among Linux users for its stunning visuals and high customizability. Currently at 38,298 stars, with 32 added today, ranking 15th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users seeking a beautiful and dynamic tiling experience
Developers or enthusiasts who enjoy deep customization of window managers
Gamers needing high performance and low latency (with tearing control)
Learners interested in Wayland compositor development

zh.tag: ESP32 圆屏 ADS-B 飞机雷达固件
zh.what: 这是一个开源的 ESP32 固件，用于 1.28 英寸圆形显示屏，以声纳风格实时显示你所在位置附近的 ADS-B 飞机。它通过 WiFi 连接获取数据，并支持首次配置的 WiFiManager 门户。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、3D 打印外壳的 STL 文件（在 MakerWorld 上）以及发布版本。固件支持范围预设、单位切换、跑道叠加等自定义设置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 编写，使用 ESP32-C3 Super Mini 和 GC9A01 圆形显示屏（240×240），依赖 WiFiManager 和 adsb.fi 的开放数据 API。
zh.hot: 该项目将 DIY 硬件与实时航空数据结合，趣味性和实用性兼具，本周新增 36 星，登上 C++ 周榜。
uses: 航空爱好者：在桌面上实时查看周围飞机动态，体验雷达监控的乐趣。
DIY 玩家：学习 ESP32 固件开发、WiFi 配置和圆形显示屏驱动。
教育场景：用于演示 ADS-B 技术、无线通信和嵌入式系统。

en.tag: ESP32 round-display ADS-B aircraft radar firmware
en.what: This is an open-source ESP32 firmware for a 1.28-inch round display that shows live ADS-B aircraft around your location in a sonar-style radar view. It connects via WiFi and includes a WiFiManager captive portal for first-time setup.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, 3D-printed case STL files (on MakerWorld), and release binaries. The firmware supports range presets, unit toggling, runway overlays, and other customizations.
en.stack: Written in C++, targeting ESP32-C3 Super Mini and GC9A01 round display (240x240), using WiFiManager and adsb.fi open data API.
en.hot: It combines DIY hardware with real-time aviation data, appealing to makers and aviation enthusiasts, gaining 36 stars this week and trending on the C++ weekly list.
uses: Aviation enthusiasts: monitor live aircraft around you on a desktop radar display.
DIY hobbyists: learn ESP32 firmware development, WiFi setup, and round display driving.
Educational use: demonstrate ADS-B technology, wireless communication, and embedded systems.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上的机器学习数组框架
zh.what: MLX 是苹果机器学习研究团队推出的面向 Apple 芯片的数组框架，提供类似 NumPy 的 Python API 以及 C++、C、Swift 接口。它支持自动微分、自动向量化、惰性计算和动态图构建，并采用统一内存模型，使 CPU 和 GPU 上的操作无需数据拷贝。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MLX 核心库的 C++ 实现、Python 绑定、文档和示例，以及 mlx.nn 和 mlx.optimizers 等高级包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，提供 Python、C、Swift API，依赖 Metal 和 Accelerate 框架，支持 macOS 和 iOS。
zh.hot: MLX 是苹果官方推出的机器学习框架，专为 Apple 芯片优化，star 数已达 2.8 万，本周新增 119，因统一内存和易用 API 受到开发者关注。
uses: 希望在 Mac 上高效训练和部署模型的机器学习研究人员和工程师
需要利用 Apple 芯片 GPU 进行高性能计算的开发者
对 NumPy/PyTorch 熟悉，希望无缝迁移到 Apple 生态的 Python 用户

en.tag: Array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon
en.what: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, developed by Apple's ML research team. It offers a NumPy-like Python API and full-featured C++, C, and Swift APIs, with composable function transformations, lazy computation, dynamic graph construction, and a unified memory model that enables seamless CPU/GPU execution.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, Python bindings, documentation, and examples, along with higher-level packages like mlx.nn and mlx.optimizers.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with Python, C, and Swift APIs, leveraging Metal and Accelerate frameworks, supporting macOS and iOS.
en.hot: MLX is Apple's official ML framework optimized for Apple silicon, with 28k stars and 119 new this week, gaining attention for its unified memory and familiar APIs.
uses: ML researchers and engineers who want to train and deploy models efficiently on Mac
Developers needing high-performance computing on Apple silicon GPU
Python users familiar with NumPy/PyTorch looking to migrate seamlessly to Apple ecosystem

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 邮箱账号关联查询 OSINT 工具
zh.what: holehe 是一个 OSINT 工具，用于检查邮箱是否在 Twitter、Instagram 等 120 多个网站上注册过账号。它利用“忘记密码”功能来获取相关信息，且不会向目标邮箱发送任何通知。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包和命令行工具，支持通过 PyPI、GitHub 或 Docker 安装。提供 CLI 和 Python API，模块化设计，每个模块返回标准化的 JSON 格式数据。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3，使用 trio 和 httpx 进行异步 HTTP 请求，依赖少量第三方库。
zh.hot: star 数达 12k+，今日新增 195，因其在 OSINT 和隐私研究领域的高效性和隐蔽性而广受欢迎。
uses: 安全研究人员进行账号枚举和足迹分析
隐私保护者检查自己的邮箱暴露范围
调查记者或社工场景下的信息收集
开发者集成到自定义 OSINT 工具链

en.tag: OSINT tool to check email registrations across sites
en.what: holehe is an OSINT tool that checks if an email is registered on over 120 websites like Twitter and Instagram. It retrieves information via the forgotten password function without alerting the target email.
en.content: The repo contains a Python package and CLI tool, installable via PyPI, GitHub, or Docker. It offers both CLI and Python API, with modular design returning standardized JSON data.
en.stack: Built on Python 3, uses trio and httpx for async HTTP requests, with minimal third-party dependencies.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 195 new today, it's popular for its efficiency and stealth in OSINT and privacy research.
uses: Security researchers for account enumeration and footprinting
Privacy-conscious individuals checking their email exposure
Investigative journalists or social engineering info gathering
Developers integrating into custom OSINT pipelines

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。
zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，主要使用 Markdown 编写。主语言标记为 Python，但实际内容不涉及代码。
zh.hot: 该仓库拥有超过 46 万 star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的资源列表之一。今日新增 2260 star，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了免费 API 的集中索引，节省了开发者搜索和筛选的时间。
uses: 开发者寻找免费 API 用于个人项目或原型开发
技术爱好者探索不同领域的 API，学习集成方法
产品经理或创业者调研可用的 API 服务，评估可行性
教育场景中作为教学资源，帮助学生了解 API 生态

en.tag: A curated list of free public APIs for developers
en.what: This is a community-maintained collection of free public APIs, covering a wide range of categories such as Animals, Anime, Anti-Malware, Art & Design, Authentication & Authorization, Blockchain, Books, Business, Calendar, Cloud Storage & File, and more. It provides developers with a rich resource of APIs to quickly find and integrate into their projects.
en.content: The repository is primarily a README that lists all APIs by category, with each API including name, description, auth, HTTPS, and CORS. It also includes contribution guidelines and API submission requirements.
en.stack: The repository is documentation-only, written in Markdown. The primary language is marked as Python, but there is no actual code.
en.hot: With over 460k stars, this is one of the most popular resource lists on GitHub. Today it gained 2260 stars, remaining a go-to for developers as it provides a centralized index of free APIs, saving time on searching and filtering.
uses: Developers looking for free APIs for personal projects or prototyping
Tech enthusiasts exploring APIs across domains to learn integration
Product managers or entrepreneurs researching available API services for feasibility
Educational use as a teaching resource to understand the API ecosystem

zh.tag: 基于 tmux 的 AI 代理编排平台，让代理群协作如专业工程师
zh.what: SwarmForge 是一个协调多个 AI 代理的工具，通过 git worktree、tmux 会话和消息传递，让代理在同一项目上协作而不互相干扰。它提供了角色提示词、工作树分配和消息传递的共享结构，并强调纪律性开发流程。
zh.content: 主分支包含文档、共享操作脚本和默认宪法条款；可运行的工作流分支（如 two-pack、four-pack）包含项目配置、角色提示词和本地宪法条款。two-pack 是快速后端工作流，four-pack 是紧凑规范工作流，每个分支定义了特定的代理角色和流程。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Clojure，但核心依赖 tmux 和 git worktree，用于会话管理和并行开发。角色提示词和配置以文本文件形式存在，通过共享脚本组装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1568 星，总星数 2936，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 22 名。它提供了一种纪律化的多代理协作方式，解决了代理互相干扰的问题，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望让多个 AI 代理协作完成同一项目的开发者，避免冲突并提高效率。
需要快速后端开发或规范驱动开发的工作流，如 two-pack 和 four-pack 分支。
对 tmux 和 git worktree 熟悉的用户，愿意采用纪律化流程管理代理。

en.tag: A disciplined tmux-based agent orchestration platform turning AI swarms into reliable engineers
en.what: SwarmForge is a tool for coordinating multiple AI agents, using git worktrees, tmux sessions, and message passing to enable agents to collaborate on the same project without stepping on each other. It provides a shared structure for role-specific prompts, worktree assignment, and message passing, emphasizing disciplined development workflows.
en.content: The main branch holds documentation, shared operational scripts, and default constitution articles; runnable workflow branches (like two-pack, four-pack) contain project-facing configurations, role prompts, and local constitution articles. two-pack is a quick backend workflow, four-pack is a compact specification workflow, each defining specific agent roles and flows.
en.stack: Primarily written in Clojure, but heavily relies on tmux and git worktree for session management and parallel development. Role prompts and configurations are stored as text files, assembled via shared scripts.
en.hot: Gained 1568 stars this month, reaching 2936 total, ranking #22 on GitHub Trending monthly. It offers a disciplined multi-agent collaboration approach, solving the problem of agents stepping on each other, attracting significant attention.
uses: Developers who want multiple AI agents to collaborate on the same project without conflicts and with higher efficiency.
Teams needing quick backend development or specification-driven workflows, as offered by the two-pack and four-pack branches.
Users familiar with tmux and git worktree, willing to adopt disciplined processes for managing agents.

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供长期记忆，实现跨工具无缝交接
zh.what: ai-memory 是一个为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）提供长期记忆的解决方案。它允许你在一个代理中开始任务，中途退出后，用另一个代理在相同目录继续，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试或未决问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心二进制、MCP 配置和生命周期钩子，支持多种代理和平台（Linux、macOS、Windows/WSL2）。提供安装脚本、Docker 镜像、原生二进制和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 1.95+，使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol）集成代理，通过生命周期钩子捕获会话。支持 Docker 和原生二进制分发。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2520 星，总星数 4411，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 9。它解决了 AI 编码代理缺乏长期记忆的痛点，让不同代理间切换变得无缝，引发开发者广泛关注。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望在切换工具时保留上下文
需要跨会话维护项目架构和决策记录的技术团队
对 AI 辅助编程工具链感兴趣，希望提升代理效率的开发者

en.tag: Long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless handoff across tools
en.what: ai-memory is a solution for long-term memory in AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex, etc.). It lets you start a task with one agent, quit mid-task, and continue with another agent in the same directory without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core binary, MCP configs, and lifecycle hooks, supporting multiple agents and platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows/WSL2). Includes install scripts, Docker images, native binaries, and docs.
en.stack: Built with Rust 1.95+, uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) for agent integration, and lifecycle hooks to capture sessions. Distributed via Docker and native binaries.
en.hot: Gained 2520 stars this week (total 4411), ranking #9 on GitHub Trending weekly. It addresses the pain point of AI coding agents lacking long-term memory, enabling seamless switching between agents, which has attracted wide developer attention.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents who want to preserve context when switching tools
Technical teams needing to maintain project architecture and decision records across sessions
Developers interested in AI-assisted programming toolchains and improving agent efficiency

zh.tag: 把技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能，按需加载、即问即答
zh.what: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍、文档文件夹或资料集合转化为统一的代理技能（Agent Skill），供 GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp 或 Claude Code 等工具使用。它提取书中的框架、决策规则和反模式，生成按章节组织的文件，使代理能按需加载相关章节并基于真实内容回答，避免幻觉。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 命令行工具、文档（安装、使用、FAQ、性能、架构）以及示例技能输出。核心功能是三步流程：指定文件/文件夹/glob，提炼为技能，代理按需加载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX、MD、HTML、RTF、MOBI 等格式。依赖包括文档解析库和与 Claude Code 等代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3903 stars，总星数达 17689，登上 GitHub 周榜第 5。它解决了 AI 代理使用技术书籍时的上下文爆炸问题，声称比直接导入书籍节省 24×–51× 的 token，并保证基于真实内容回答，因此受到开发者追捧。

Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

Technical interviewers — reference questions and answers to design interview problems.
Computer science students — as supplementary material for system design courses.

企业安全团队：扫描 AI 基础设施和代理，防范潜在攻击
开发者：集成 MCP 扫描和 LLM 越狱测试到 CI/CD 流程

en.what: A.I.G is a full-stack AI red teaming platform developed by Tencent Zhuque Lab to secure AI ecosystems. It performs agent scans, skill scans, MCP scans, AI infrastructure scans, and LLM jailbreak evaluations to detect and mitigate security vulnerabilities in AI systems.

Developers: to integrate MCP scanning and LLM jailbreak testing into CI/CD pipelines

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。
