zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。
zh.hot: 该项目月增 16,488 Star 跃至 GitHub 月榜第 5 名，总星数突破 42,318；其“AI + 动态 PoC 验证”模式精准击中了传统静态扫描误报率高、人工渗透测试成本高的痛点，成为安全左移趋势下的热门方案。
uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上原生多 token 预测加速的本地 LLM 运行器
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，用于在 Apple Silicon 上运行本地大语言模型。它利用模型内置的多 token 预测（MTP）头，通过自推测解码和精确拒绝采样，在保持输出分布不变的情况下显著加速生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具（brew/pip 安装），提供模型推荐、自动下载、引擎配置、风扇控制等功能。内置针对 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的优化版本，并附有详细的 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架，依赖 Apple Silicon 的 Metal 性能。应用层采用原生 Mac 技术，CLI 支持 Homebrew 和 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 714 星，总星数 1824，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Python）第 18 名。其宣称的 2 倍加速和无需外部草稿模型的特性，吸引了大量 Apple Silicon 用户的关注。
uses: 在 Mac 上本地运行 LLM 的开发者，希望获得更快的推理速度而不牺牲输出质量。
需要离线或隐私保护的 AI 编码助手，特别是使用 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的场景。
对推测解码技术感兴趣的研究者，希望参考其实现或进行二次开发。

en.tag: Native multi-token prediction LLM runner for Apple Silicon, ~2x faster
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI for running local LLMs on Apple Silicon. It leverages built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads to speculatively draft and verify multiple tokens per step, achieving up to 2.24x speedup while preserving the exact output distribution.
en.content: The repo provides a full Mac app (DMG) and CLI (brew/pip), featuring hardware checking, model recommendation, auto-download, engine setup, and fan control. It includes optimized builds for models like Qwen 3.8 27B, along with comprehensive docs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with the MLX framework, leveraging Apple Silicon's Metal performance. The app uses native Mac technologies, and the CLI is installable via Homebrew or pip.
en.hot: Gained 714 stars this month (total 1824), ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Python) monthly. Its claimed ~2x speedup and no-external-drafter design have attracted significant attention from Apple Silicon users.
uses: Developers running LLMs locally on Macs who want faster inference without compromising output quality.
AI coding assistants needing offline/private operation, especially with models like Qwen 3.8 27B.
Researchers interested in speculative decoding techniques for reference or further development.

Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果

希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的核心框架，提供 CLI 工具、交互式终端 UI、IDE 插件、桌面应用、守护进程模式、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=22），支持多种 API 协议（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen），可接入第三方或本地模型（Ollama/vLLM）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.

Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: AI 代理数据抓取服务器，连接数千现成爬虫工具
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）实现，让 AI 代理能够从社交媒体、搜索引擎、地图、电商等网站提取数据。它利用 Apify Store 中数千个现成的抓取器、爬虫和自动化工具，支持 OAuth 认证，可轻松从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的源代码、文档、配置示例，以及用于构建和测试的脚本。它提供托管服务器（https://mcp.apify.com）和本地运行选项，并支持代理支付功能。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 MCP SDK 实现协议，依赖 Apify 平台 API。支持 Streamable HTTP 传输，兼容多种 MCP 客户端。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3065 星，总星数达 5443，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。其核心价值在于将 AI 代理与海量现成爬虫工具无缝连接，极大简化了数据获取流程，且支持托管服务，开箱即用。
uses: 开发者构建 AI 代理时，需要从网页或社交媒体提取数据，可快速集成现成爬虫。
数据分析师使用 AI 助手从电商、地图等网站抓取结构化数据，用于市场研究或监控。
自动化爱好者希望利用 MCP 协议，让 AI 代理执行复杂的网络数据采集任务。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to scrape any website via thousands of ready-made tools
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a Model Context Protocol implementation that enables AI agents to extract data from social media, search engines, maps, e-commerce sites, and any other website. It leverages thousands of ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools from the Apify Store, supports OAuth, and can be connected from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, configuration examples, and build/test scripts for the MCP server. It offers a hosted server (https://mcp.apify.com) and local running options, with support for agentic payments.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the MCP SDK to implement the protocol, and relies on the Apify platform API. Supports Streamable HTTP transport and is compatible with various MCP clients.
en.hot: Gained 3,065 stars this month, reaching 5,443 total, and hit #15 on the monthly TypeScript trending list. Its core value lies in seamlessly connecting AI agents with thousands of ready-made scrapers, simplifying data extraction, and offering a hosted service for instant use.
uses: Developers building AI agents that need to extract data from web pages or social media can quickly integrate ready-made scrapers.
Data analysts use AI assistants to scrape structured data from e-commerce, maps, etc., for market research or monitoring.
Automation enthusiasts want to leverage the MCP protocol to have AI agents perform complex web data collection tasks.

zh.tag: 开源可观测性平台，替代 Datadog/Splunk，成本降低 140 倍
zh.what: OpenObserve 是一个云原生的可观测性平台，统一处理日志、指标、追踪、前端监控和 LLM 可观测性。它旨在以极低的存储成本和简单的部署方式，替代 Datadog、Splunk 和 Elasticsearch 等传统工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、文档、架构说明和快速入门指南。支持单二进制部署，并集成了 OpenTelemetry 原生支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，后端基于 Rust 构建，利用 Parquet 列式存储和 S3 原生架构实现高性能和低成本。
zh.hot: 凭借 140 倍存储成本降低和单二进制部署的卖点，吸引了大量关注，本月新增 1100 星，总星数突破 2.1 万，成为可观测性领域的热门开源项目。
uses: 寻求替代昂贵商业可观测性工具的中小团队，希望降低成本而不牺牲功能。
需要统一管理日志、指标、追踪和前端监控的 DevOps 或 SRE 团队。
对 LLM 应用进行可观测性监控的 AI 工程师，需要追踪模型调用和性能。
希望快速部署自托管可观测性平台，且要求简单运维的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source observability platform, a cost-effective alternative to Datadog/Splunk with 140x lower storage cost
en.what: OpenObserve is a cloud-native observability platform that unifies logs, metrics, traces, frontend monitoring, and LLM observability. It aims to replace traditional tools like Datadog, Splunk, and Elasticsearch with dramatically lower storage costs and simple deployment.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, documentation, architecture overview, and quickstart guides. It supports single-binary deployment and has native OpenTelemetry integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with a Rust-based backend. It leverages Parquet columnar storage and an S3-native architecture for high performance and low cost.
en.hot: With its 140x storage cost reduction and single-binary deployment, it has gained significant traction, adding 1,100 stars this month and surpassing 21,000 total stars, making it a hot open-source project in the observability space.
uses: Small to medium teams looking for a cost-effective alternative to expensive commercial observability tools without sacrificing features.
DevOps or SRE teams needing to unify logs, metrics, traces, and frontend monitoring in one platform.
AI engineers monitoring LLM applications, requiring tracing of model calls and performance.
Developers who want a self-hosted observability platform with simple deployment and low operational overhead.

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，支持 IDE、终端与 SDK
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，可以在 IDE 或终端中运行，帮助开发者自动完成编码任务。它支持创建文件、运行命令、浏览网页，并通过人工审批循环使用工具。此外，它还提供 SDK，允许开发者构建自定义的 AI 代理和集成。

uses: 开发者可在 VS Code 或 JetBrains IDE 中使用 Cline 作为 AI 编程助手，提升编码效率。
团队可利用 Kanban 模式并行运行多个代理，自动化处理复杂任务，如代码审查或重构。
技术爱好者可以通过 SDK 构建自定义 AI 代理，集成到自己的应用中，实现自动化工作流。

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and SDK
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that runs in your IDE or terminal, helping developers automate coding tasks. It can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval. It also offers an SDK for building custom AI agents and integrations.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: SDK, CLI, Kanban board, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin. The SDK provides a Node.js programmatic API, the CLI supports interactive chat and headless mode, and Kanban allows running many agents in parallel.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, built on the Node.js ecosystem. It relies on VS Code and JetBrains plugin APIs, and npm for package management.
en.hot: Cline has over 67k stars on GitHub, with 2,198 added this month, ranking 18th in the TypeScript monthly list. Its versatility (IDE extension, CLI, SDK) and open-source nature attract many developers, making it a star project in autonomous coding agents.

Teams can leverage Kanban mode to run multiple agents in parallel, automating complex tasks like code review or refactoring.

zh.tag: 本地 GPU 驱动的图像/文字转 3D 模型桌面应用
zh.what: Modly 是一款开源的桌面应用，利用本地 AI 模型将照片或文字提示转换为 3D 网格模型。它完全在 GPU 上运行，无需云端服务，支持 Windows、Linux 和 Apple Silicon macOS。

zh.hot: 本月新增 2564 星，总星数达 7330，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。因其将 AI 3D 生成本地化，保护隐私且免费，吸引了大量创作者和开发者。
uses: 3D 设计师和游戏开发者，快速从照片或文字生成原型模型。
隐私敏感用户，希望在本地处理数据，避免上传到云端。
AI 爱好者，探索本地运行 3D 生成模型的技术实践。

en.tag: Desktop app for local GPU-powered image/prompt to 3D mesh generation
en.what: Modly is an open-source desktop app that converts photos or text prompts into 3D mesh models using local AI models. It runs entirely on your GPU, no cloud needed, supporting Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron frontend (TypeScript) and a Python backend (API), with an extension system supporting models like Hunyuan3D and TripoSG. Users can download installers from Releases or clone and run directly.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Electron for the desktop app, with a Python backend (e.g., FastAPI), managed via npm and pip, leveraging GPU-accelerated inference.
en.hot: Gained 2,564 stars this month, reaching 7,330 total, trending on GitHub. Its local-first approach to AI 3D generation, ensuring privacy and zero cost, attracts creators and developers.
uses: 3D designers and game developers quickly prototyping models from photos or text.
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local processing over cloud uploads.
AI enthusiasts exploring local 3D generation models.

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。

en.tag: Open-source low-code platform for building internal tools and AI agents
en.what: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for rapidly building internal tools, dashboards, business applications, and workflows. Enterprises seeking self-hosted low-code solutions

zh.tag: 为AI代理设计的极速共享浏览器，零配置

自动化测试工程师：希望在不干扰用户标签页的情况下并行运行测试。

en.tag: Fastest shared browser for AI agents, zero config
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for AI agents to run browser automation in parallel with users. Agents operate in their own Spaces, while users keep their tabs, and logins are shared seamlessly without extra setup.

en.stack: Built with JavaScript, leveraging browser technologies, currently supports macOS, with Windows and Linux on roadmap.
en.hot: Gained 2288 stars this week, total 11863, popular for solving login-sharing pain in AI browser automation.

Automation testers: want parallel test runs without disturbing user tabs.
Personal users: want AI agents to handle web tasks while keeping their own session.

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz是一个自托管的团队协作空间，人类和AI代理可以在同一频道中共同工作。所有消息、操作和事件都记录在Nostr中继上，形成统一的审计日志。它让代理像人类队友一样参与代码审查、工作流运行和项目管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust实现的核心中继、客户端界面、文档（愿景、架构等）以及截图示例。提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，并支持代理自主操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust编写，基于Nostr协议，依赖大量Rust crate。前端可能使用Web技术，但核心是Rust后端。
zh.hot: 在GitHub Trending月榜排名第一，28.7k星，本月新增301星。它解决了AI代理协作中的信任和审计问题，提供统一的事件日志，吸引了开发者和团队。
uses: 团队希望让AI代理参与开发流程，同时保持完整审计记录。
开发者需要自托管的协作平台，数据完全掌控。
对Nostr协议感兴趣，想探索去中心化社交与工作结合。
研究AI代理安全与权限管理的场景。

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hosted team workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels. Every message, action, and event is recorded on a Nostr relay, creating a unified audit trail. Agents can participate in code review, workflow runs, and project management like human teammates.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-implemented core relay, client UI, documentation (vision, architecture, etc.), and screenshot examples. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agent autonomy.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol, with a suspicious number of Rust crates. The frontend may use web technologies, but the core is Rust backend.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending monthly with 28.7k stars and +301 this month. It addresses trust and audit in AI agent collaboration with a unified event log, attracting developers and teams.
uses: Teams wanting AI agents in dev workflows with full audit trails.
Developers needing self-hosted collaboration with data ownership.
Those interested in Nostr and decentralized social-work integration.
Researchers exploring AI agent security and permissioning.

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级微虚拟机运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不可信代码，如 AI 代理、用户脚本、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、示例、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心是一个可嵌入的库，允许在代码中直接生成虚拟机，无需守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或插件。
CI/CD 工程师：在隔离环境中运行测试或构建任务，防止恶意代码影响主机。
安全研究人员：分析不可信二进制或脚本，利用硬件隔离降低风险。
平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, CI jobs, and automation. It offers hardware-level isolation with Docker-like workflows and average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, examples, integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server, and build/release configurations. The core is an embeddable library that spawns VMs directly in code without a daemon.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker), supports OCI container images, and is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and untrusted code execution, developers need fast, secure isolation. Microsandbox offers sub-100ms boot times and hardware-level isolation, quickly gaining traction with 959 stars this month, reaching 8,021 total.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute user code or plugins.
CI/CD engineers: run tests or build tasks in isolated environments to prevent malicious code from affecting the host.
Security researchers: analyze untrusted binaries or scripts with hardware isolation to reduce risk.
Platform engineers: embed microVMs into applications for multi-tenant isolation or dynamic code execution.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，基于 GPUI 构建跨平台应用
zh.what: 这是一个基于 GPUI 的 Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，提供 60+ 跨平台组件，包括表格、列表、图表、代码编辑器等。它分为两层：gpui-component 提供开箱即用的样式组件，gpui-base 提供无样式的基础行为与基础设施，让开发者可以自由定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的组件库源码、文档、示例和测试。核心是 gpui-component 和 gpui-base 两个 crate，以及用于展示的 website 目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPUI 框架，以及 Tree Sitter 用于语法高亮，支持 Markdown 渲染和虚拟化列表/表格。
zh.hot: 凭借丰富的组件、高性能和双层架构设计，在 Rust 社区迅速走红，今日新增 123 星，总星数达 12809，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: Rust 开发者：希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，需要现成 UI 组件。
桌面应用团队：需要高性能表格、编辑器等复杂组件，同时希望保持设计一致性。
设计系统开发者：希望基于 gpui-base 构建自己的设计系统，同时复用交互逻辑。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library for building cross-platform apps with GPUI
en.what: This is a Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI, offering 60+ cross-platform components including tables, lists, charts, and a code editor. It is structured in two layers: gpui-component provides styled, ready-to-use components, while gpui-base offers unstyled behavior and infrastructure for full customization.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the component library, documentation, examples, and tests. The core is two crates: gpui-component and gpui-base, along with a website directory for showcasing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the GPUI framework, with Tree Sitter for syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering, and virtualized lists/tables.
en.hot: With its rich components, high performance, and two-layer architecture, it has quickly gained popularity in the Rust community, adding 123 stars today and reaching 12,809 total, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending for Rust today.
uses: Rust developers: Want to build cross-platform desktop apps with Rust and need ready-made UI components.
Desktop app teams: Need high-performance complex components like tables and editors while maintaining design consistency.
Design system developers: Want to build their own design system on gpui-base while reusing interaction logic.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持多智能体协作
zh.what: OpenPencil 是全球首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持并发智能体团队。用户可以用自然语言描述界面，实时生成到无限画布上，并通过对话修改设计。它采用 Design-as-Code 理念，是 Pencil 的现代替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心引擎、桌面应用（op-host-desktop）、内置 MCP 服务器、多模型支持，以及多语言 README 和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架用于桌面应用，集成 MCP 服务器和多模型 AI 能力。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，概念新颖，结合 AI 代理团队和实时生成，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 32 星，总星数达 4772，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
uses: 设计师和开发者：快速将想法转化为 UI 原型，提升设计效率。
产品经理：用自然语言描述需求，即时生成界面方案。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体协作在创意工具中的应用。
开源社区：参与开发，扩展 MCP 服务器和模型集成。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native vector design tool with concurrent agent teams
en.what: OpenPencil is the world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent agent teams. Users can describe UI in natural language and watch it appear on an infinite canvas in real-time, then modify designs through chat. It embraces Design-as-Code and serves as a modern alternative to Pencil.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust-based core engine, desktop app (op-host-desktop), built-in MCP server, multi-model intelligence, along with multilingual READMEs and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar for the desktop app, integrating MCP server and multi-model AI capabilities.
en.hot: As the first open-source AI-native vector design tool, its novel concept combining AI agent teams and real-time generation attracts attention. With 32 stars today and 4772 total, it ranks #3 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Designers and developers: quickly turn ideas into UI prototypes, boosting design efficiency.
Product managers: describe requirements in natural language and get instant interface proposals.
AI enthusiasts: explore multi-agent collaboration in creative tools.
Open-source community: contribute to development, extend MCP server and model integrations.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档和插件接口，以及用于扩展的 I/O 和表达式插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 实现，利用多线程和 SIMD 向量化执行，采用 Apache Arrow 列式格式进行零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: Polars 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性在数据科学社区广受欢迎，star 数接近 4 万，今日新增 13 个，持续活跃。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师：处理大型数据集，进行快速数据清洗和转换。
数据工程师：构建高效的数据管道，处理超出内存的数据。
Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。
需要 GPU 加速查询的用户：利用 NVIDIA GPU 加速数据处理。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Polars is highly popular in the data science community for its outstanding performance and ease of use, with nearly 40k stars and 13 new stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: for fast data cleaning and transformation on large datasets.
Data engineers: building efficient data pipelines handling larger-than-RAM data.
Python/R/Node.js developers: leveraging high-performance DataFrame operations in their preferred language.
Users needing GPU acceleration: accelerating data processing with NVIDIA GPUs.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的编程语言，让代理少犯错
zh.what: BAML 是一种专为 AI 代理设计的编程语言，它看起来像 TypeScript，但内置了类型安全、运行时类型、静态错误分析等特性，帮助开发者构建更可靠的代理应用。它提供了代理专用的标准库和测试框架，并支持从多种主流语言调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 BAML 编译器的 Rust 实现、命令行工具（baml）、IDE 插件、Python 包（baml-py）以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python 绑定（baml-py），并支持从 TypeScript、Python、Go、C#、Java 等语言调用。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理开发热潮，BAML 提供了更严谨的编程范式，解决了代理开发中常见的错误问题，因此迅速获得关注，近 9000 星且持续增长。
uses: AI 代理开发者，希望用类型安全的方式构建复杂代理逻辑
需要从多种语言调用代理功能的团队，BAML 支持多语言互操作
对代理可靠性要求高的场景，如自动化工作流、智能客服等

en.tag: A programming language for AI agents, designed to reduce agent mistakes
en.what: BAML is a programming language designed specifically for AI agents. It looks like TypeScript but includes type safety, runtime types, static error analysis, and other features to help developers build more reliable agent applications. It provides an agent-specific standard library and testing framework, and can be called from multiple mainstream languages.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust implementation of the BAML compiler, command-line tools (baml), IDE plugins, Python package (baml-py), and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings (baml-py), and callable from TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java, etc.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agent development, BAML offers a more rigorous programming paradigm that addresses common errors in agent development, quickly gaining attention with nearly 9k stars and growing.
uses: AI agent developers who want to build complex agent logic with type safety
Teams needing to call agent functions from multiple languages, as BAML supports interop
Scenarios requiring high reliability, such as automated workflows and intelligent customer service

zh.tag: 零配置、高性能的终端 IDE 级文本编辑器
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代化的终端文本编辑器，提供 IDE 级功能，如多光标编辑、LSP 支持、命令面板和模糊查找，同时保持零配置和熟悉的键位。它专为处理超大文件而优化，内存开销低，输入延迟小。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的编辑器核心、命令行安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF，以及用于展示功能（如 Orchestrator 多任务、主题定制）的博客文章。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 客户端，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置和 VS Code 般的体验，在开发者中迅速走红，本月新增 617 星，总星数达 8589，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 20 名。
uses: 喜欢终端工作流但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者
需要处理超大日志或数据文件的工程师
希望在不离开终端的情况下获得 IDE 功能的程序员
对 Rust 高性能终端应用感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: Zero-config, high-performance terminal IDE-grade text editor
en.what: Fresh is a modern terminal text editor with IDE-level features like multi-cursor editing, LSP support, command palette, and fuzzy finder, while maintaining zero configuration and familiar keybindings. It is optimized for huge files with low memory overhead and low-latency input.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based editor core, a command-line install script, documentation and demo GIFs, plus blog posts showcasing features like the Orchestrator multitasking and theme customization.
en.stack: Written in Rust, using terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP client, cross-platform.
en.hot: Rapidly gained popularity among developers for its zero-config and VS Code-like experience, adding 617 stars this month to reach 8589 total, ranking #20 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers who love terminal workflows but don't want to learn complex shortcuts
Engineers who need to handle huge log or data files
Programmers who want IDE features without leaving the terminal
Developers interested in high-performance Rust terminal applications

zh.tag: Rust 编写的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，极致性能与多会话支持
zh.what: jcode 是一款基于 Rust 的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，旨在提升 AI 编程助手的技能上限。它专为多会话工作流、无限可定制性与极致性能而设计，能够在本地以极低资源消耗运行复杂编程任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、跨平台 CLI 安装脚本（Linux/macOS/Windows），以及展示内存与启动速度优势的基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，强调零成本抽象与资源效率；支持可选本地嵌入模型，通过 Bash/PowerShell 脚本实现一键跨平台安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程工具同质化严重的背景下，jcode 凭借 8421 Star 和 Rust 日榜第 11 名的热度，以单会话 27.8 MB 的超低内存占用和多会话架构，精准击中开发者对高性能本地 Agent 的需求。
uses: 追求本地低内存、高性能 AI 编程体验的核心开发者
需要长期运行多会话复杂工作流的高级用户
希望深度定制 Coding Agent 行为与工具链的极客与团队

en.tag: Next-gen coding agent harness in Rust for multi-session, low-RAM workflows
en.what: jcode is a next-generation coding agent harness built in Rust to raise the skill ceiling of AI coding assistants. It is designed for multi-session workflows, infinite customizability, and extreme performance, allowing complex coding tasks to run locally with minimal resource usage.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core runtime, cross-platform CLI installers for Linux/macOS/Windows, and benchmark data highlighting its memory and boot-up speed advantages.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with zero-cost abstraction and resource efficiency in mind; supports optional local embeddings and one-click cross-platform installation via Bash/PowerShell scripts.
en.hot: With 8,421 stars and a spot at #11 on GitHub's Rust daily trending list, jcode stands out in the crowded AI coding space by delivering an ultra-low 27.8 MB RAM footprint per session and a multi-session architecture that meets developers' demand for high-performance local agents.
uses: Core developers seeking local, low-memory, high-performance AI coding experiences
Power users running long-term, complex multi-session workflows
Hackers and teams wanting infinite customizability of their coding agent behavior and toolchain

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 无需客户端的全能堡垒机/PAM，透明代理 SSH、HTTPS、K8s 等
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒主机，支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC，无需客户端软件或 SSH 包装器。它部署在 DMZ 中，可管理用户并分配访问权限，同时记录所有会话供实时查看或回放。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心服务、内置 Web 管理界面、浏览器端 SSH/RDP/VNC 客户端，以及 Docker 部署文件和完整文档。
zh.stack: 使用 100% 安全 Rust 编写，单二进制无依赖；支持 TOTP 和 OpenID Connect 实现 2FA/SSO，内置暴力破解防护（IP 封禁和用户锁定）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 338 星，总星数 7757，位列 Rust 月榜第 20。其独特卖点是无需客户端即可透明代理多种协议，并内置会话录制和 Web 访问，极大简化了堡垒机部署。
uses: 企业安全团队：在 DMZ 中部署统一访问入口，集中管控 SSH、数据库和 Web 服务，并审计所有会话。
DevOps 工程师：无需安装额外客户端即可安全访问 Kubernetes 集群和内部服务，支持浏览器直接操作。
远程办公场景：通过内置 2FA/SSO 和暴力破解防护，为远程员工提供安全的 RDP/VNC 访问。

en.tag: Clientless bastion/PAM with transparent proxying for SSH, HTTPS, K8s, DBs, RDP/VNC
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host for SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP, and VNC that requires no client app or SSH wrapper. Deployed in your DMZ, it manages user accounts and assigns access to specific hosts/URLs, recording every session for live viewing or later replay.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core service, a built-in web admin UI, browser-based SSH/RDP/VNC clients, Docker deployment files, and full documentation.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust as a single dependency-free binary; supports TOTP and OpenID Connect for 2FA/SSO, with built-in brute-force protection (IP blocking and user lockout).
en.hot: Gained 338 stars this month (total 7,757), ranking #20 on the Rust monthly trending. Its unique selling point is transparent proxying for multiple protocols without client software, plus built-in session recording and web access, greatly simplifying bastion deployment.
uses: Enterprise security teams: deploy a unified access gateway in the DMZ to centrally manage SSH, databases, and web services with session auditing.
DevOps engineers: securely access Kubernetes clusters and internal services without extra clients, with browser-based operation.
Remote work scenarios: provide secure RDP/VNC access for remote employees with built-in 2FA/SSO and brute-force protection.

zh.tag: DeepSeek 原生终端 AI 编程代理，专注前缀缓存稳定性
zh.what: DeepSeek-Reasonix 是一款面向终端的 AI 编程代理，深度集成 DeepSeek 模型，通过保持前缀缓存稳定来降低推理成本并提升响应速度。它可常驻运行，持续辅助开发者完成编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心代理、npm 包发布、CI 工作流、扩展机制、ACP 协议支持、详细文档（指南、扩展、规格）以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，通过 npm 分发（reasonix 包），支持扩展和 ACP 协议，集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 DeepSeek 原生优化和前缀缓存稳定性，在 GitHub 月榜 Go 类排名第 9，star 数达 3.5 万，月增 8020，深受开发者青睐。
uses: 终端重度用户：希望在命令行中直接获得 AI 编程辅助，无需切换 IDE。
DeepSeek 用户：利用 DeepSeek 模型的高效推理，降低 API 成本。
自动化工作流：需要常驻运行的 AI 代理，持续处理编码任务。

en.tag: DeepSeek-native terminal AI coding agent engineered for prefix-cache stability
en.what: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a terminal-based AI coding agent deeply integrated with DeepSeek models. It leverages prefix-cache stability to reduce inference costs and improve response times, and is designed to run persistently to assist developers with coding tasks.
en.content: The repo includes the Go-based core agent, npm package releases, CI workflows, extension mechanism, ACP protocol support, comprehensive docs (guide, extensions, spec), and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, distributed via npm (reasonix package), supports extensions and ACP protocol, with GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With DeepSeek-native optimization and prefix-cache stability, it ranks #9 in Go on GitHub's monthly trending, amassing 35k stars with 8k added this month, gaining strong developer traction.
uses: Terminal power users who want AI coding assistance directly in the CLI without switching IDEs.
DeepSeek users leveraging efficient inference to reduce API costs.
Automation workflows requiring a persistent AI agent to handle coding tasks continuously.

zh.tag: App Store Connect 的极速脚本化 CLI，自动化发布全流程
zh.what: 这是一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，用于与 App Store Connect API 交互。它允许开发者从终端、IDE 或 CI/CD 管道自动化 iOS、macOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的发布流程，包括 TestFlight、构建、提交、签名、分析、截图和订阅管理等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个名为 `asc` 的二进制文件，支持 Homebrew 安装和脚本安装。它还包含 `asc install-skills` 命令，用于安装 23 个 agent skills，这些 skills 可以自动化构建、TestFlight、元数据同步等任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store Connect API。支持 Homebrew 和脚本安装，并集成 agent skills 功能。
zh.hot: 该工具在 GitHub 上获得 6324 颗星，本周新增 295 颗，位列 Go 语言周榜第 6。其受欢迎的原因在于它简化了 App Store 发布流程，提供了脚本化和可自动化的解决方案，深受独立开发者和 CI/CD 用户的喜爱。
uses: 独立开发者或小团队希望自动化 App Store 发布流程，减少手动操作。
需要将 TestFlight 分发、构建上传和元数据同步集成到 CI/CD 管道中的开发团队。
喜欢用命令行工具管理多个应用或频繁发布的应用开发者。
对 agent skills 感兴趣，希望用 AI 辅助自动化发布任务的开发者。

en.tag: Fast, scriptable CLI for App Store Connect API, automating release workflows
en.what: A Go-based CLI for the App Store Connect API, enabling automation of release workflows for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps from terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipelines, including TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, and subscriptions.
en.content: The repo provides the `asc` binary with Homebrew and script installation. It also includes `asc install-skills` to install 23 agent skills for automating builds, TestFlight, metadata sync, and more.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, leveraging the App Store Connect API. Supports Homebrew and script installation, and integrates agent skills.
en.hot: With 6,324 stars and 295 added this week, ranking #6 in Go trending, it's popular for simplifying App Store releases with a scriptable, automatable solution, appealing to indie devs and CI/CD users.
uses: Indie developers or small teams wanting to automate App Store releases and reduce manual steps.
Teams integrating TestFlight distribution, build uploads, and metadata sync into CI/CD pipelines.
Developers who prefer CLI tools to manage multiple apps or frequent releases.
Developers interested in agent skills to automate release tasks with AI assistance.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: AI 工程化开源控制平面，编排跨工具工作流
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个面向 AI 驱动工程的开源自动化引擎，用于编排跨 Git、LLM、CI/CD、可观测性等工具的工作流。它提供持久执行、审批和操作 UI，确保人类与 AI 安全地交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎（Go 编写）、命令行工具、文档和示例。核心概念包括应用（Apps）、画布（Canvases）、组件（Components）和事件驱动编排，支持自托管或使用云服务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Git、Docker 等，支持与 CI/CD、可观测性、事件响应等工具集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1444 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 3，因其为 AI 代理提供安全护栏和持久执行，解决工程自动化痛点。
uses: 平台工程团队：统一编排跨工具链的自动化流程，增强 AI 代理的安全性。
DevOps 工程师：将复杂运维任务转化为可审批、可审计的工作流。
AI 应用开发者：为代理添加人工审批和策略检查，确保可控执行。

en.tag: Open-source control plane for agentic engineering, orchestrating workflows across your stack
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source automation engine for AI-driven engineering, orchestrating workflows across tools like Git, LLMs, CI/CD, observability, and more. It provides durable execution, approvals, and an operational UI to ensure safe human-AI interaction.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine (written in Go), CLI, documentation, and examples. Key concepts include Apps, Canvases, Components, and event-driven orchestration, with options for self-hosting or using the cloud service.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with dependencies on Git, Docker, and integrations with CI/CD, observability, incident tools, etc.
en.hot: Gained 1,444 stars this month, ranking #3 on the Go trending list, as it provides guardrails and durable execution for AI agents, addressing pain points in engineering automation.
uses: Platform engineering teams: unify automation across toolchains with enhanced AI agent safety.
DevOps engineers: turn complex ops tasks into approvable, auditable workflows.
AI app developers: add human approvals and policy checks to agents for controlled execution.

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。
zh.hot: 拥有 64k+ star，是云原生领域最受欢迎的反向代理之一。其自动服务发现和动态配置特性极大简化了微服务路由管理，因此持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的开源门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证与授权服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）。它作为反向代理的前端，保护应用免受未授权访问，支持多种认证方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Authelia 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置、Docker 镜像构建文件以及测试套件。项目采用 Go 编写，提供可执行二进制文件和容器化部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库，如用于 Web 框架的 Gin、用于配置管理的 Viper 等。支持多种数据库后端（如 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL）和 LDAP/Active Directory 集成。
zh.hot: Authelia 因其强大的安全功能和对 OpenID Connect 的官方认证而受到广泛关注，star 数接近 2.9 万。本周新增 98 个 star，持续活跃在 GitHub 趋势榜上，表明社区对自托管身份认证解决方案的需求旺盛。
uses: 自托管服务提供商：为个人或组织自托管的 Web 应用添加统一登录和二次验证，提升安全性。
家庭实验室爱好者：在 NAS 或家庭服务器上部署，保护各类服务（如媒体、监控）的访问。
企业 IT 管理员：需要为内部应用实现集中身份认证和访问控制，且希望避免商业 IAM 成本。
开发者：希望集成 OIDC 或 SAML 认证到自己的应用中，并需要一个开源参考实现。

en.tag: Open-source SSO and MFA portal for web apps, OpenID Certified
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as a front-end for reverse proxies, protecting apps from unauthorized access and supporting various authentication methods.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, Docker image build files, and test suites for Authelia. Written in Go, it provides executable binaries and containerized deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging open-source libraries like Gin for web framework and Viper for configuration management. Supports multiple database backends (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and LDAP/Active Directory integration.
en.hot: Authelia gains attention for its robust security features and official OpenID Connect certification, with nearly 29k stars. Adding 98 stars this week, it remains active on GitHub Trending, reflecting strong community demand for self-hosted identity solutions.
uses: Self-hosters: Add unified login and two-factor verification to self-hosted web apps for enhanced security.
Home lab enthusiasts: Deploy on NAS or home servers to protect access to services like media and monitoring.
Enterprise IT admins: Implement centralized authentication and access control for internal apps without commercial IAM costs.
Developers: Integrate OIDC or SAML authentication into their apps and need an open-source reference implementation.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方命令行工具，将 PR、Issue 等带到终端
zh.what: gh 是 GitHub 官方推出的命令行工具，让你在终端中直接管理仓库、PR、Issue、Actions 等。它与 git 无缝协作，支持 GitHub.com、GitHub Enterprise Cloud 和 Server。
zh.content: 仓库包含 gh 的完整源码、安装脚本、文档以及用于编码代理的 Agent skill。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 GitHub API。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方 CLI，拥有 45k+ Star，是开发者日常高频使用的工具。今日新增 16 Star，持续活跃。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中快速管理 GitHub 仓库、PR、Issue 等
DevOps 工程师 —— 集成到 CI/CD 脚本中自动化 GitHub 操作
编码代理 —— 通过 Agent skill 让 AI 代理直接调用 gh 命令

en.tag: GitHub's official CLI, bringing PRs, issues, and more to your terminal
en.what: gh is GitHub's official command-line tool that lets you manage repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions, and more directly from your terminal. It works seamlessly with git and supports GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and Server.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and an Agent skill for coding agents. It supports multiple installation methods on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depends on git and the GitHub API.
en.hot: As the official GitHub CLI, it has over 45k stars and is a daily essential for developers. It gained 16 stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Developers — manage GitHub repos, PRs, issues quickly from the terminal
DevOps engineers — automate GitHub operations in CI/CD scripts
Coding agents — use the Agent skill to let AI agents invoke gh commands

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个快速、可扩展、跨平台的 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认启用 TLS，自动为站点配置 HTTPS 证书。它旨在让 HTTPS 成为每个网站的默认配置，简化部署和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。核心是一个基于 Go 的模块化服务器，通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置，支持丰富的插件和中间件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 CertMagic 库进行自动 HTTPS 证书管理，支持多种平台（Windows、macOS、Linux 等）。
zh.hot: Caddy 因其自动 HTTPS 和易用性而广受欢迎，本月新增近千 star，总 star 数超过 7.4 万，在 Go 语言趋势榜中名列前茅。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速部署静态网站或反向代理，无需手动配置证书
需要自动 HTTPS 和 HTTP/3 支持的生产环境 Web 服务器
作为微服务或容器化应用的反向代理和负载均衡器
学习和研究 Go 语言高性能服务器开发的参考项目

en.tag: Fast, extensible web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is a fast, extensible, multi-platform web server supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, with TLS enabled by default and automatic HTTPS certificate management. It aims to make HTTPS the default for every site, simplifying deployment and operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, and build scripts for Caddy. The core is a modular Go-based server configured via Caddyfile or JSON, supporting a rich ecosystem of plugins and middleware.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the CertMagic library for automatic HTTPS certificate management, and supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Caddy is popular for its automatic HTTPS and ease of use, gaining nearly a thousand stars this month and over 74k total, ranking high on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly deploying static sites or reverse proxies without manual certificate setup
Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生作业队列与准入管理
zh.what: Kueue 是一组 API 和控制器，用于 Kubernetes 中的作业队列管理。它决定作业何时被准入（开始创建 Pod）以及何时停止（删除活跃 Pod），支持优先级、公平共享和抢占等策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kueue 的源代码、文档站点（site/）、示例和配置。核心是控制器和 API 定义，支持多种作业类型（如 BatchJob、Kubeflow、RayJob 等）和高级资源管理功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 构建，集成 Prometheus 指标和 cluster-autoscaler 的 provisioningRequest。
zh.hot: Kueue 在 GitHub Trending 月榜（Go）排名第 14，本月新增 166 星，总星数达 2926。它解决了 Kubernetes 中作业排队和资源管理的痛点，是云原生批处理领域的热门项目。
uses: 平台工程师：为 Kubernetes 集群实现多租户作业队列和资源配额管理。
MLOps 团队：管理 Kubeflow、Ray 等训练作业的排队和调度，优化 GPU 资源利用率。
批处理用户：通过优先级和公平共享策略，确保关键作业优先运行。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native job queueing and admission control
en.what: Kueue is a set of APIs and controllers for job queueing in Kubernetes. It decides when a job should be admitted (start creating pods) and when it should stop (delete active pods), supporting policies like priorities, fair sharing, and preemption.
en.content: The repository contains Kueue's source code, documentation site (site/), examples, and configurations. The core is the controller and API definitions, supporting various job types (e.g., BatchJob, Kubeflow, RayJob) and advanced resource management features.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on Kubernetes controller-runtime, integrating Prometheus metrics and cluster-autoscaler's provisioningRequest.
en.hot: Kueue ranks #14 on GitHub Trending monthly (Go) with 166 new stars this month, totaling 2926 stars. It addresses the pain point of job queueing and resource management in Kubernetes, making it a popular project in cloud-native batch processing.
uses: Platform engineers: implement multi-tenant job queueing and resource quota management for Kubernetes clusters.
MLOps teams: manage queueing and scheduling for training jobs like Kubeflow and Ray, optimizing GPU utilization.
Batch processing users: ensure critical jobs run first with priority and fair sharing policies.

zh.tag: K8s 全生命周期安全平台，从开发到运行时
zh.what: Kubescape 是一个开源的 Kubernetes 安全平台，覆盖 IDE、CI/CD 和集群，提供风险分析、安全合规和错误配置扫描。它帮助 Kubernetes 用户和管理员节省时间、精力和资源。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubescape CLI、核心扫描引擎、与 IDE 和 CI/CD 的集成，以及 Kubernetes 安全态势管理的相关组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API 和 OPA 策略引擎，支持多种输出格式和集成。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 孵化项目，Kubescape 在 GitHub 上拥有 11.7k 星标，本月新增 160 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 14 名，因其全面的安全功能和活跃的社区而受到关注。
uses: Kubernetes 管理员：用于集群安全合规检查和风险态势管理。
DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 流程中集成安全扫描，确保部署安全。
安全团队：用于持续监控和运行时安全防护。

en.tag: Comprehensive Kubernetes security platform from dev to runtime
en.what: Kubescape is an open-source Kubernetes security platform covering IDE, CI/CD, and clusters, offering risk analysis, security compliance, and misconfiguration scanning. It saves Kubernetes users and administrators time, effort, and resources.
en.content: The repository contains the Kubescape CLI, core scanning engine, integrations with IDEs and CI/CD, and components for Kubernetes security posture management.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes APIs and OPA policy engine, supporting multiple output formats and integrations.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project, Kubescape has 11.7k stars on GitHub, with 160 new stars this month, ranking 14th in the Go trending list, gaining attention for its comprehensive security features and active community.
uses: Kubernetes administrators: for cluster security compliance checks and risk posture management.
DevOps engineers: integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines to ensure deployment safety.
Security teams: for continuous monitoring and runtime security protection.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 编排平台，用 Python 可靠编排 ML 管道、模型与智能体
zh.what: Flyte 是一个开源的可扩展 AI 编排平台，用于协调数据、模型和计算资源，构建 AI 工作流。它支持以纯 Python 方式定义和运行机器学习管道、模型服务及智能体，并提供本地开发、云端运行等模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Flyte 2 的核心代码，提供 Python SDK（flyte 包）、CLI 工具、任务环境定义、示例代码（如 hello world 和模型服务）以及文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，但提供 Python SDK 和 CLI。依赖 FastAPI 用于模型服务，支持 asyncio 异步编程，并可通过 uv 安装。
zh.hot: Flyte 2 正式发布，带来更简洁的 Python 原生体验，且作为 LF AI & Data 基金会毕业项目，在 AI 编排领域备受关注，今日新增 36 星。
uses: 数据科学家和 ML 工程师，用于构建和运行可复现的机器学习管道。
AI 应用开发者，需要编排模型服务和智能体工作流。
平台团队，寻求可扩展、弹性的 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI orchestration platform for reliable ML pipelines, models, and agents in pure Python
en.what: Flyte is an open-source, scalable AI orchestration platform for coordinating data, models, and compute to build AI workflows. It enables defining and running ML pipelines, model serving, and agents in pure Python, with local and cloud execution modes.
en.content: The repository contains the core code for Flyte 2, including the Python SDK (flyte package), CLI tool, task environment definitions, example code (e.g., hello world and model serving), and documentation links.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, but offers a Python SDK and CLI. It depends on FastAPI for model serving, supports asyncio for async programming, and can be installed via uv.
en.hot: Flyte 2's general availability brings a simpler Python-native experience, and as a graduated LF AI & Data Foundation project, it garners attention in AI orchestration, gaining 36 stars today.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers building reproducible ML pipelines.
AI application developers orchestrating model serving and agent workflows.
Platform teams seeking scalable and resilient AI infrastructure.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方堆叠 PR 管理 CLI 扩展
zh.what: gh-stack 是 GitHub 官方的 CLI 扩展，用于管理堆叠分支和拉取请求。它将大型变更拆分为一系列相互依赖的小型 PR，并自动化创建分支、保持 rebase、设置正确的 PR 基础分支等繁琐操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 扩展，提供 init、add、push、view、submit 等命令，以及 AI 代理技能安装。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，依赖 GitHub CLI (gh) v2.0+，使用 JSON 文件存储堆栈元数据，并启用 git rerere 解决冲突。
zh.hot: 本月新增 821 星，登上 GitHub Trending Go 月榜第 13 名，因其解决了大型 PR 评审痛点，并集成 AI 代理技能。
uses: 大型项目维护者：将大功能拆分为可独立评审的小 PR，提升代码审查效率。
AI 编程助手用户：通过安装 skill，让 AI 代理理解并操作堆叠 PR。
频繁 rebase 的开发者：自动化 rebase 和基础分支设置，减少手动操作。

en.tag: Official GitHub CLI extension for managing stacked PRs
en.what: gh-stack is an official GitHub CLI extension for managing stacked branches and pull requests. It breaks large changes into a chain of small, reviewable PRs that build on each other, automating branch creation, rebasing, and setting correct PR base branches.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI extension with commands like init, add, push, view, submit, and an AI agent skill.
en.stack: Built with Go, requires GitHub CLI (gh) v2.0+, stores stack metadata in JSON, and enables git rerere for conflict resolution.
en.hot: Gained 821 stars this month, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending Go monthly, because it solves the pain of large PR reviews and integrates with AI agents.
uses: Maintainers of large projects: break big features into small reviewable PRs, improving code review efficiency.
AI coding assistant users: install the skill to let AI agents work with stacked PRs.
Developers who rebase often: automate rebasing and base branch setup, reducing manual work.

zh.tag: 本地一键运行开源大模型，支持主流模型与多端集成
zh.what: Ollama 是一个本地运行开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供简洁的命令行和 REST API，让用户轻松下载、运行和与模型交互，并支持与 Claude Code、Copilot 等现有工具集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、命令行工具、REST API 服务、Python 和 JavaScript 库，以及 Docker 镜像，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 等推理后端，提供 REST API 和多种编程语言 SDK。
zh.hot: 凭借 179k 的 star 数和月增 3k 的持续热度，Ollama 已成为本地运行大模型的事实标准，其易用性和对最新模型（如 Kimi-K2.6、GLM-5.2）的快速支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者本地快速测试和原型验证，无需 GPU 云服务
隐私敏感场景，如内部文档分析或代码审查
教育学习，探索不同开源模型的性能差异
与 Claude Code、Copilot 等工具集成，增强本地 AI 能力

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command, supporting major models and multi-platform integrations
en.what: Ollama is a tool for running open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Gemma. It offers a simple CLI and REST API for easy model download, running, and interaction, with integrations for existing tools like Claude Code and Copilot.
en.content: The repo includes install scripts, CLI tool, REST API server, Python and JavaScript libraries, and Docker image, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging llama.cpp and other inference backends, offering REST API and SDKs for multiple languages.
en.hot: With 179k stars and ~3k monthly additions, Ollama has become the de facto standard for running LLMs locally, attracting developers with its ease of use and rapid support for latest models like Kimi-K2.6 and GLM-5.2.
uses: Developers quickly testing and prototyping locally without cloud GPU services
Privacy-sensitive scenarios like internal document analysis or code review
Educational purposes to explore performance differences among open-source models
Integrating with tools like Claude Code and Copilot to enhance local AI capabilities

zh.tag: 现代化跨平台任务运行器，Make 的替代品
zh.what: Task 是一个受 Make 启发的构建工具，但专为现代工作流设计。它使用简单的 YAML 文件定义任务，支持跨平台运行，无需依赖 shell。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码、文档网站源码（位于 website 目录）以及示例和配置文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 YAML 解析库，支持通过 Homebrew、Scoop 等方式安装。
zh.hot: 作为 Make 的现代替代品，Task 凭借简洁的 YAML 配置和跨平台特性吸引了大量开发者，Star 数已达 1.6 万，本月新增 204。
uses: 开发者希望用更简洁、可读的 YAML 替代 Makefile 来管理项目任务
跨平台团队需要统一的构建和任务执行工具，避免 shell 差异
CI/CD 流程中需要可重复、可组合的任务定义

en.tag: A modern cross-platform task runner, a Make replacement
en.what: Task is a build tool inspired by Make, but designed for modern workflows. It uses a simple YAML file to define tasks and runs cross-platform without relying on shell.
en.content: The repository contains the Go source code for the CLI tool, the documentation website source (in the website directory), and examples/config files.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, depends on YAML parsing libraries, and can be installed via Homebrew, Scoop, etc.
en.hot: As a modern Make replacement, Task attracts many developers with its simple YAML config and cross-platform nature, reaching 16k stars with 204 added this month.
uses: Developers who want a simpler, more readable YAML alternative to Makefile for project tasks
Cross-platform teams needing a unified build and task execution tool to avoid shell differences
CI/CD pipelines requiring reproducible and composable task definitions

zh.tag: 免费自托管的现代 Web 文件管理器
zh.what: FileBrowser Quantum 是一个免费、开源的网页文件管理器，用户可以通过浏览器轻松访问和管理服务器上的文件。它提供现代化的响应式界面，支持用户管理、访问控制、文件分享、预览和编辑等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 FileBrowser Quantum 源代码、文档、配置示例和 Docker 镜像。项目是一个大型 fork，改进了多源配置、OIDC/LDAP/JWT 登录支持、实时搜索、缩略图生成等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖前端框架（如 React/Vue）和多种认证协议（OIDC、LDAP、JWT）。支持 Docker 部署，配置通过 YAML 文件管理。
zh.hot: 本月新增 434 星，总星数 7888，进入 GitHub 趋势榜 Go 语言第 10 名。它作为免费开源替代品，提供了比商业工具更丰富的功能，且安装配置简单，受到自托管社区欢迎。
uses: 个人用户：自建私有云盘，随时随地通过浏览器管理文件。
团队协作：为团队成员提供文件共享和权限控制，支持多种登录方式。
开发者：作为轻量级文件管理组件嵌入到自己的应用中，或用于服务器文件管理。

en.tag: Free self-hosted modern web file manager
en.what: FileBrowser Quantum is a free, open-source web-based file manager that lets users easily access and manage files on a server through a browser. It offers a modern responsive interface with advanced features like user management, access control, sharing, file preview, and editing.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, documentation, configuration examples, and Docker images for FileBrowser Quantum. It's a massive fork with improvements like multi-source configuration, OIDC/LDAP/JWT login support, real-time search, and thumbnail generation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend frameworks (like React/Vue) and support for multiple auth protocols (OIDC, LDAP, JWT). Deployable via Docker, configured through YAML files.
en.hot: Gained 434 stars this month, reaching 7888 total, ranking 10th in Go trending. As a free open-source alternative with richer features than commercial tools and simple setup, it's popular among self-hosters.
uses: Individual users: self-host a private cloud drive to manage files from anywhere via browser.
Team collaboration: provide file sharing and permission control for team members, supporting multiple login methods.
Developers: embed as a lightweight file management component in their apps, or use for server file management.

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: Cloudflare Workers 开源运行时，自托管与本地开发
zh.what: workerd 是 Cloudflare Workers 背后的 JavaScript/Wasm 服务器运行时，基于 V8 构建。它允许你在自己的服务器上运行 Workers 应用，或作为开发工具进行本地测试，也可用作可编程 HTTP 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时源码、文档、示例配置以及用于构建和测试的工具。核心是 C++ 实现的服务器运行时，支持基于能力的绑定、多线程和兼容性日期机制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 V8 引擎，支持 JavaScript 和 WebAssembly。构建系统基于 Bazel，并支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare Workers 的开源核心，吸引了大量开发者和企业关注。本月新增 222 星，总星数达 8608，在 C++ 月度趋势榜排名第 20，热度持续上升。
uses: 自托管 Workers 应用：在自有服务器上运行为 Cloudflare Workers 设计的代码
本地开发与测试：在部署前于本地模拟 Workers 环境
可编程 HTTP 代理：拦截、修改和路由网络请求
学习 Workers 运行时原理：研究其设计原则和实现

en.tag: Open-source runtime powering Cloudflare Workers for self-hosting and local dev
en.what: workerd is the JavaScript/Wasm server runtime that powers Cloudflare Workers, built on V8. It lets you self-host Workers applications, develop and test locally, or use it as a programmable HTTP proxy.
en.content: The repo contains runtime source code, documentation, example configs, and build/test tooling. Core is a C++ server runtime with capability bindings, multi-threading, and compatibility dates.
en.stack: Primarily C++, depends on V8 engine, supports JavaScript and WebAssembly. Build system uses Bazel, supports Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: As the open-source core of Cloudflare Workers, it attracts developers and enterprises. Gained 222 stars this month, total 8608, ranking #20 on C++ monthly trending, with rising popularity.
uses: Self-host Workers apps: run code designed for Cloudflare Workers on your own servers
Local development and testing: simulate Workers environment locally before deployment
Programmable HTTP proxy: intercept, modify, and route network requests
Learn Workers runtime internals: study its design principles and implementation

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队
需要跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）统一推理解决方案的企业
研究模型优化和硬件加速的 AI 基础设施工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台，保护端点与云负载
zh.what: Wazuh是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测和响应。它由部署在监控系统上的端点安全代理和收集分析代理数据的管理服务器组成，并已与Elastic Stack集成，提供搜索和数据可视化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含Wazuh的核心组件，包括代理（agent）、管理服务器（manager）、规则集、文档和安装脚本。支持入侵检测、日志分析、文件完整性监控和漏洞检测等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，依赖Elastic Stack（Elasticsearch、Kibana）进行数据存储和可视化，支持跨平台部署（Linux、Windows、macOS等）。
zh.hot: 本月新增431星，总星数达16485，位列C++趋势榜第25。作为开源安全平台的代表，其统一XDR和SIEM能力受到广泛关注。
uses: 安全运维团队：用于集中监控和管理企业安全事件，实现威胁检测与响应。
合规审计人员：利用文件完整性监控和日志分析满足PCI DSS等合规要求。
云原生环境：保护容器和云工作负载，集成威胁情报识别风险。
开源爱好者：学习大型C++安全项目架构和实现。

en.tag: Open-source unified XDR and SIEM platform for endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open-source security platform for threat prevention, detection, and response. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes agent data, fully integrated with the Elastic Stack for search and visualization.
en.content: The repository contains core components of Wazuh, including agents, manager, rulesets, documentation, and installation scripts. It supports intrusion detection, log analysis, file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability detection.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) for data storage and visualization, and supports cross-platform deployment (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.).
en.hot: With 431 stars added this month and a total of 16,485, it ranks 25th on the C++ trending list. As a leading open-source security platform, its unified XDR and SIEM capabilities attract significant attention.
uses: Security operations teams: for centralized monitoring and management of security events, enabling threat detection and response.
Compliance auditors: leveraging file integrity monitoring and log analysis to meet regulatory requirements like PCI DSS.
Cloud-native environments: protecting containers and cloud workloads with integrated threat intelligence.
Open-source enthusiasts: learning the architecture and implementation of a large-scale C++ security project.

zh.tag: 开源游戏串流客户端，支持多平台与 Sunshine
zh.what: Moonlight PC 是一款开源的 PC 客户端，用于连接 NVIDIA GameStream 和 Sunshine 服务，实现游戏串流。它支持硬件加速解码、HDR、7.1 环绕声等特性，让用户可以在不同设备上流畅游玩 PC 游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源码、构建配置、文档和翻译资源，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 Steam Link 等平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 FFmpeg 进行视频解码，支持多种编解码器（H.264、HEVC、AV1）。
