zh.hot: 随着 Sunshine 的流行，Moonlight 作为其官方推荐的客户端，用户需求大增，本月新增 433 星，总星数达 1.8 万，位列 C++ 趋势榜第九。
uses: 游戏玩家：在局域网或互联网上串流玩 PC 游戏，享受低延迟和高画质。
远程办公用户：通过 Moonlight 远程控制桌面，处理工作任务。
开发者与爱好者：研究游戏串流技术，或为 Moonlight 贡献代码和翻译。

en.tag: Open-source game streaming client for PC, supporting Sunshine and more
en.what: Moonlight PC is an open-source client for NVIDIA GameStream and Sunshine, enabling game streaming. It features hardware-accelerated decoding, HDR, and 7.1 surround sound, allowing smooth gameplay across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full client source code, build configurations, documentation, and translation resources, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and Steam Link.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, leveraging FFmpeg for video decoding, supporting H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codecs.
en.hot: With the rise of Sunshine, Moonlight as its recommended client has seen increased demand, gaining 433 stars this month and reaching 18.5k total, ranking 9th in C++ trending.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games over LAN or internet with low latency and high quality.
Remote workers: use Moonlight for remote desktop control and productivity.
Developers and enthusiasts: study game streaming tech or contribute code and translations.

zh.tag: 统一跨平台AI客户端，无缝切换云端与本地离线模型
zh.what: PrivateLM 是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，离线可用），并可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久会话、自动配置和任务管理功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，涵盖 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云端调用、模型下载）以及 Firebase 集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 状态管理、Hive 本地存储、Dio 网络库，以及 flutter_background_service 和 Firebase Messaging 实现后台任务与推送。
zh.hot: 本月新增 366 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 15 名。它解决了 AI 聊天中隐私与云端能力的两难，提供真正的本地离线推理，同时支持主流云 API，吸引了注重隐私和灵活性的开发者。
uses: 隐私敏感用户：希望在不联网的情况下使用 AI 聊天，确保数据不出设备。
开发者：需要跨平台 AI 客户端参考实现，或想集成本地 GGUF 推理与云 API 切换。
移动端用户：在 Android 手机上体验 GPU 加速的本地模型，如 Qwen2-VL 多模态。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client with seamless cloud-to-on-device model switching
en.what: PrivateLM is a production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android (GPU-accelerated, offline) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, auto-configuration, and task management.
en.content: The repository contains the full Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud calls, model download), and Firebase integration.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), using GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and flutter_background_service plus Firebase Messaging for background tasks and push notifications.
en.hot: Gained 366 stars this month, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending C++ monthly. It addresses the privacy-vs-cloud dilemma in AI chat by offering true on-device offline inference while supporting major cloud APIs, appealing to privacy-conscious and flexible developers.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want AI chat without internet, ensuring data stays on-device.
Developers seeking a cross-platform AI client reference implementation with local GGUF inference and cloud API switching.
Mobile users who want to experience GPU-accelerated local models like Qwen2-VL on Android.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎，社区驱动
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能全面的跨平台游戏引擎，提供统一的界面来创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置了丰富的常用工具，用户无需重复造轮子，可以专注于游戏开发。游戏可一键导出到多个平台，包括桌面、移动、网页和主机。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、文档和示例项目。主要目录包括核心引擎代码（C++）、场景系统、渲染器、脚本语言（GDScript）、编辑器界面以及导出模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种脚本语言（如 GDScript、C#、VisualScript）。依赖包括 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染、音频库等，并支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: Godot 因其完全免费、开源且无版税的特点而广受欢迎，社区活跃，持续更新。本月新增 1876 星，总星数达 116k，在 C++ 趋势榜中排名第 17，显示出其强大的吸引力和用户基础。
uses: 独立游戏开发者：利用 Godot 的免费开源特性，低成本开发并发布跨平台游戏。
教育场景：作为教学工具，学习游戏开发、编程和引擎架构。
游戏工作室：用于原型设计和快速迭代，支持从 2D 到 3D 的多样化项目。
开源贡献者：参与引擎开发，通过社区协作改进功能和修复问题。

en.tag: Free & open-source cross-platform 2D/3D game engine, community-driven
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel. Games can be exported with one click to multiple platforms, including desktop, mobile, web, and consoles.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, editor, documentation, and demos. Key directories include core engine code (C++), scene system, renderers, scripting language (GDScript), editor UI, and export templates.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with support for multiple scripting languages (e.g., GDScript, C#, VisualScript). Dependencies include OpenGL/Vulkan rendering, audio libraries, and cross-platform build support.
en.hot: Godot is popular for being completely free, open-source, and royalty-free, with an active community and continuous updates. With 1,876 new stars this month and 116k total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list, it demonstrates strong appeal and a solid user base.
uses: Indie game developers: Leverage Godot's free and open-source nature to develop and publish cross-platform games at low cost.
Educational settings: Use as a teaching tool to learn game development, programming, and engine architecture.
Game studios: For prototyping and rapid iteration, supporting diverse projects from 2D to 3D.
Open-source contributors: Participate in engine development, improving features and fixing issues through community collaboration.

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ClickHouse 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件以及文档。提供 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的安装方式，并有丰富的社区资源如教程、文档、视频和 Slack 群组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 LLVM、libcxx、zlib-ng 等底层库，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Data engineers — building real-time OLAP data pipelines and dashboards
DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: 面向移动端与边缘设备的混合云边 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: Cactus 是一个专为移动设备、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人设计的混合边缘-云 AI 引擎。它提供 OpenAI 兼容的 API，支持文本、语音和视觉任务，并具备本地推理与云端卸载能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cactus Engine（引擎）、Cactus Graph（零拷贝计算图）、Cactus Kernels（CPU/GPU 内核）和 Cactus Quants（基于旋转的量化技术）。提供 C++ API 和命令行工具，支持快速部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖硬件加速（Apple、Samsung、Pixel 等），支持多种精度（FP16、INT8），并集成自动 RAG 和流式生成。
zh.hot: 随着边缘 AI 需求增长，Cactus 提供了高效的移动端推理方案，月增 425 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 17 名，受到开发者关注。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在手机或平板上部署本地 AI 模型，实现离线文本生成、语音识别等功能。
嵌入式/机器人工程师：为资源受限的设备（如智能家居、机器人）集成 AI 推理能力。
边缘计算研究者：探索混合云边架构和量化技术，优化模型在边缘设备上的性能。

en.tag: Hybrid edge-cloud AI inference engine for mobile, wearables, smart home and robots
en.what: Cactus is a hybrid edge-cloud AI engine designed for mobile devices, wearables, smart home and robots. It offers OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision, with local inference and cloud handoff capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains Cactus Engine, Cactus Graph (zero-copy computation graph), Cactus Kernels (CPU/GPU kernels), and Cactus Quants (rotation-based quantization). It provides C++ APIs and CLI tools for quick deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leverages hardware acceleration (Apple, Samsung, Pixel, etc.), supports multiple precisions (FP16, INT8), and integrates auto-RAG and streaming generation.
en.hot: With rising edge AI demand, Cactus offers an efficient on-device inference solution, gaining 425 stars this month and ranking #17 on GitHub Trending C++ monthly, attracting developer attention.
uses: Mobile app developers: deploy on-device AI models for offline text generation, speech recognition, etc.
Embedded/robotics engineers: integrate AI inference into resource-constrained devices like smart home and robots.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid cloud-edge architectures and quantization techniques to optimize performance on edge devices.

zh.tag: 用 React 构建原生移动应用的跨平台框架
zh.what: React Native 允许开发者使用 JavaScript 和 React 构建真正的原生应用，代码可复用于 Android、iOS 等多个平台。它通过原生 UI 组件渲染，提供接近原生的性能和体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、文档、示例应用以及贡献指南，主要目录包括 ReactAndroid、ReactCommon 和 Libraries 等。
zh.stack: 核心使用 C++ 实现，通过 JavaScript 引擎（如 Hermes）与 React 交互，支持原生模块扩展。
zh.hot: 作为移动开发的主流框架，拥有 12.6 万 star，本月新增 333，持续活跃，社区庞大。
uses: 移动应用开发者：快速构建跨平台原生应用，节省开发成本。
React 开发者：复用现有技能，将 Web 知识扩展到移动端。
创业团队：以较低成本同时覆盖 iOS 和 Android 市场。

en.tag: A cross-platform framework for building native mobile apps with React
en.what: React Native lets developers build truly native apps using JavaScript and React, with code reusable across Android, iOS, and more. It renders with native UI components, delivering near-native performance and experience.
en.content: The repository contains the framework's core source code, documentation, sample apps, and contribution guidelines, with main directories like ReactAndroid, ReactCommon, and Libraries.
en.stack: Core implemented in C++, interacts with React via JavaScript engines like Hermes, and supports native module extensions.
en.hot: As a mainstream mobile framework, it has 126k stars with 333 added this month, remaining highly active with a large community.
uses: Mobile app developers: quickly build cross-platform native apps, saving development costs.
React developers: reuse existing skills to extend web knowledge to mobile.
Startups: cover both iOS and Android markets at lower cost.

zh.tag: ARM64 Linux 上运行 x86 应用的高性能模拟器
zh.what: FEX 是一个快速的用户态模拟器，允许在 ARM64 Linux 设备上运行 x86 和 x86-64 应用程序。它兼容 32 位和 64 位二进制，可与 Wine/Proton 结合运行 Windows 游戏，并支持将 API 调用转发到宿主系统库以减少模拟开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、FEXConfig 图形配置工具、FEXRootFSFetcher 根文件系统下载工具，以及详细的文档和 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ARMv8.0+ 硬件，支持多种 Linux 发行版，并利用 OpenGL/Vulkan 等宿主库进行 API 转发。
zh.hot: 随着 ARM 设备（如树莓派、ARM 服务器）的普及，用户对在 ARM 上运行 x86 应用的需求增加。FEX 提供了高性能解决方案，本月新增 172 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 23 名。
uses: ARM64 Linux 用户希望在 ARM 设备上运行 x86 专属软件或游戏
开发者测试 x86 应用在 ARM 环境下的兼容性
游戏玩家通过 Wine/Proton 在 ARM 设备上玩 Windows 游戏

en.tag: High-performance x86/x86-64 emulator for ARM64 Linux
en.what: FEX is a fast usermode emulator that allows running x86 and x86-64 applications on ARM64 Linux devices. It supports both 32-bit and 64-bit binaries, can be used with Wine/Proton to play Windows games, and forwards API calls to host libraries to reduce overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator core source, FEXConfig GUI tool, FEXRootFSFetcher for downloading RootFS, and extensive documentation with wiki links.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, requires ARMv8.0+ hardware, supports multiple Linux distributions, and leverages host libraries like OpenGL/Vulkan for API forwarding.
en.hot: With the rise of ARM devices (e.g., Raspberry Pi, ARM servers), there's growing demand to run x86 apps on ARM. FEX offers a high-performance solution, gaining 172 stars this month and ranking #23 on the C++ trending list.
uses: ARM64 Linux users wanting to run x86-only software or games on ARM devices
Developers testing x86 app compatibility on ARM environments
Gamers playing Windows games on ARM devices via Wine/Proton

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: Nextcloud 官方桌面同步客户端，跨平台文件同步工具
zh.what: Nextcloud 桌面客户端是一款用于将 Nextcloud 服务器上的文件与本地计算机同步的应用，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。它提供文件同步、文件夹选择、活动状态显示等核心功能，并集成虚拟文件支持。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面客户端的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档（如开发指南和用户手册）、以及用于图标生成的 Inkscape 文件。目录结构涵盖 src（核心逻辑）、doc（文档）、以及用于打包和发布的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架（Qt6 自 3.14 版本起，旧版本用 Qt5），依赖 OpenSSL、QtKeychain、SQLite，并支持 CMake 构建。macOS 构建需要 Xcode。
zh.hot: 作为 Nextcloud 官方客户端，拥有稳定的用户基础和持续更新，本月新增 54 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 18 名，体现了其在自托管云同步领域的持续热度。
uses: 个人用户：在本地电脑与 Nextcloud 服务器之间同步文件，实现数据备份和跨设备访问。
企业团队：通过集中管理文件同步，确保团队成员使用最新版本的文件，并支持协作。
开发者：为 Nextcloud 桌面客户端贡献代码，或基于其代码库学习跨平台桌面应用开发。

en.tag: Official Nextcloud desktop sync client for Windows, macOS, and Linux
en.what: The Nextcloud Desktop Client is an app to synchronize files from Nextcloud Server with your computer, available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides file sync, selective folder sync, activity status, and virtual file support.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop client, build scripts, documentation (developer guides and user manuals), and Inkscape files for icon generation. The directory structure includes src (core logic), doc (documentation), and packaging/release configurations.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework (Qt6 since 3.14, Qt5 for earlier versions), dependencies include OpenSSL, QtKeychain, SQLite, and built with CMake. macOS builds require Xcode.
en.hot: As the official Nextcloud client, it has a stable user base and continuous updates, gaining 54 stars this month and ranking #18 on the C++ monthly trending list, reflecting its sustained popularity in self-hosted cloud sync.
uses: Individual users: sync files between local computer and Nextcloud server for backup and cross-device access.
Enterprise teams: centrally manage file sync to ensure team members use the latest file versions and support collaboration.
Developers: contribute code to the Nextcloud desktop client or learn cross-platform desktop app development from its codebase.

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。
zh.content: skills/ 目录下 6 个技能：baseline-ui、improve-ui、fixing-accessibility、fixing-metadata、fixing-motion-performance、ui-skills-root；另有 bin/（CLI 入口）和配套网站（Astro + Cloudflare Workers）。
zh.stack: TypeScript，CLI 走 npx 分发，MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，官网 ui-skills.com。
zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills
